# AGNT SDK Tools/Functions Reference

Based on the API documentation provided, here are the available tools and functions:

## Authentication & User Management

**authenticateToken**
- Validates JWT tokens and extracts user information
- Parameters: JWT token (string)
- Returns: User data including id, email, auth_type

**Get User Stats**
- Retrieves user statistics
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Agent count, workflow count, tool count, goal count, execution count, storage used

**Get User Settings**
- Fetches user preferences
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Theme, language, notification preferences

**Update User Settings**
- Modifies user preferences
- Parameters: Theme, language, notification settings (objects)
- Returns: Updated settings object

**Sync Token**
- Synchronizes user token across services
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Success confirmation

## Agent Operations

**Get All Agents**
- Retrieves agents for authenticated user
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Array of agent objects with configuration details

**Save/Update Agent**
- Creates or modifies agent
- Parameters: id (optional), name, description, config (object)
- Returns: Agent object with timestamps

**Get Agent by ID**
- Retrieves specific agent
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Complete agent object

**Update Agent**
- Modifies existing agent
- Parameters: id (path), name, description, config (body)
- Returns: Updated agent object

**Delete Agent**
- Removes agent from system
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success message

**Chat with Agent**
- Sends message to agent
- Parameters: id (path), message (string), context (object)
- Returns: Response string and metadata

**Stream Chat with Agent**
- Real-time agent conversation
- Parameters: id (path), message (string), context (object)
- Returns: Server-sent events stream

**Get Agent Suggestions**
- Generates contextual suggestions
- Parameters: id (path), context (string)
- Returns: Array of suggestion strings

## Workflow Management

**Get All Workflows**
- Lists user workflows
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Array of workflow objects with nodes and edges

**Save Workflow**
- Creates new workflow
- Parameters: name, description, nodes (array), edges (array), config (object)
- Returns: Workflow object with generated id

**Get Workflow by ID**
- Retrieves specific workflow
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Complete workflow object

**Update Workflow**
- Modifies workflow configuration
- Parameters: id (path), name, description, nodes, edges, config (body)
- Returns: Updated workflow object

**Delete Workflow**
- Removes workflow
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success message

**Rename Workflow**
- Changes workflow title
- Parameters: id (path), name (string, body)
- Returns: Updated workflow object

**Get Workflow Status**
- Checks current state
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Status, last execution time, execution count, error count

**Start Workflow**
- Activates workflow
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success confirmation

**Stop Workflow**
- Deactivates workflow
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success confirmation

## Content Output Management

**Get All Content Outputs**
- Lists user content outputs
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Array of content output objects

**Save/Update Content Output**
- Creates or modifies output
- Parameters: id (optional), title, content, workflowId, toolId
- Returns: Content output object with timestamps

**Get Content Output by ID**
- Retrieves specific output
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Complete output object

**Update Content Output**
- Modifies existing output
- Parameters: id (path), title, content (body)
- Returns: Updated output object

**Rename Content Output**
- Changes output title
- Parameters: id (path), title (string, body)
- Returns: Updated output object

**Delete Content Output**
- Removes output
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success message

**Get Content Outputs by Workflow**
- Filters outputs by workflow
- Parameters: workflowId (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Array of relevant outputs

**Get Content Outputs by Tool**
- Filters outputs by tool
- Parameters: toolId (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Array of relevant outputs

## Custom Tools

**Get All Custom Tools**
- Lists user-created tools
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Array of custom tool objects

**Save/Update Custom Tool**
- Creates or modifies tool
- Parameters: id (optional), name, description, config (object)
- Returns: Custom tool object with timestamps

**Get Custom Tool by ID**
- Retrieves specific tool
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Complete tool object

**Update Custom Tool**
- Modifies tool
- Parameters: id (path), name, description, config (body)
- Returns: Updated tool object

**Delete Custom Tool**
- Removes tool
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success message

## Custom Providers

**Get All Custom Providers**
- Lists provider configurations
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Array with provider count and provider objects

**Create Custom Provider**
- Adds new provider
- Parameters: provider_name, base_url, api_key (string)
- Returns: Provider object with encryption confirmation

**Get Custom Provider by ID**
- Retrieves provider details
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Complete provider object

**Update Custom Provider**
- Modifies provider configuration
- Parameters: id (path), provider_name, base_url, api_key (body)
- Returns: Updated provider object

**Delete Custom Provider**
- Removes provider
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success message

**Test Custom Provider Connection**
- Validates provider connectivity
- Parameters: base_url, api_key (body)
- Returns: Connection status, latency (ms), available models array

**Get Provider Models**
- Retrieves available models
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Array of model objects with pricing information

## Goal Management

**Get All Goals**
- Lists user goals
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Array of goal objects with status and priority

**Create Goal**
- Adds new goal
- Parameters: title, description, priority, config (object)
- Returns: Goal object with generated id

**Execute Goal**
- Runs goal
- Parameters: goalId (path), executionConfig (object, body)
- Returns: Execution id and success confirmation

**Get Goal by ID**
- Retrieves specific goal
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Complete goal object

**Get Goal Status**
- Checks goal progress
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Status, progress percentage, last/next execution timestamps

**Pause Goal**
- Halts goal execution
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success message

**Resume Goal**
- Restarts paused goal
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success message

**Delete Goal**
- Removes goal
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success message

**Evaluate Goal**
- Assesses goal performance
- Parameters: id (path), evaluationCriteria (object, body)
- Returns: Score, metrics, recommendations

**Get Evaluation Report**
- Retrieves historical evaluations
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Array of evaluation objects with timestamps

**Save as Golden Standard**
- Creates reference goal
- Parameters: id (path), name, description (body)
- Returns: Golden standard object with source reference

**Get Golden Standards**
- Lists reference goals
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Array of golden standard objects

## Execution Tracking

**Get All Executions**
- Lists execution history
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Array with type, status, start/end times

**Get Agent Activity Data**
- Retrieves agent interactions
- Parameters: agentId, timeRange with start/end (object, body)
- Returns: Activities array with timestamps and summary

**Get Execution Details**
- Retrieves specific execution
- Parameters: id (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Detailed execution object with logs and output

## Model Management

**Get Models by Provider**
- Fetches available models
- Parameters: provider (path), category (query, optional), useCache (query, optional), format (query, optional)
- Returns: Array of model objects with pricing

**Refresh Models Cache**
- Updates cached models
- Parameters: provider (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Model array, count, success message

**Get Model Categories**
- Lists model classifications
- Parameters: None
- Returns: Array of category objects

## MCP Server Management

**Get All MCP Servers**
- Lists MCP servers
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Array of server objects with status

**Add MCP Server**
- Creates server configuration
- Parameters: name, description, url, config (object)
- Returns: Server object with creation timestamp

**Update MCP Server**
- Modifies server
- Parameters: name (path), description, url, config (body)
- Returns: Updated server object

**Delete MCP Server**
- Removes server
- Parameters: name (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success message

**Get Server Capabilities**
- Lists server features
- Parameters: name (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Tools, resources, prompts arrays

**Test MCP Server Connection**
- Validates server
- Parameters: name (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Status, latency (ms), capabilities object

## NPM Package Management

**Search MCP Servers**
- Queries NPM packages
- Parameters: q (string, query), limit (optional, query)
- Returns: Array of package objects with metadata

**Get Popular Servers**
- Lists trending packages
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Array of popular packages with ratings

**Get Package Details**
- Retrieves package information
- Parameters: packageName (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Detailed package object with download statistics

**Test Package**
- Validates package
- Parameters: packageName, version (string, body)
- Returns: Compatibility status, issues array, recommendations

## Plugin Management

**Get Installed Plugins**
- Lists active plugins
- Parameters: None
- Returns: Array with plugin stats

**Get Installed Plugin Details**
- Retrieves plugin information
- Parameters: name (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Plugin object with tool list

**Get Plugin Source Code**
- Retrieves plugin files
- Parameters: name (string, path parameter)
- Returns: File objects (manifest, package.json, index.js)

**Get Plugin Package**
- Exports plugin as file
- Parameters: name (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Base64-encoded package, size, filename

**Get Marketplace Plugins**
- Lists available plugins
- Parameters: None
- Returns: Array of marketplace plugin objects

**Install Plugin from Marketplace**
- Adds plugin from store
- Parameters: name, version (string, body)
- Returns: Success confirmation with plugin object

**Install Plugin from File**
- Adds plugin from upload
- Parameters: name, fileData (base64), fileName (body)
- Returns: Success confirmation with plugin object

**Uninstall Plugin**
- Removes plugin
- Parameters: name (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success message

**Get Plugin Tools**
- Lists plugin-provided tools
- Parameters: None
- Returns: Array of tool objects with metadata

**Generate Plugin with AI**
- Creates plugin via AI
- Parameters: description, provider, model, options (object, body)
- Returns: Server-sent events stream

**Regenerate Plugin File**
- Updates plugin code
- Parameters: fileName, instructions, currentManifest, currentCode, provider, model (body)
- Returns: Generated file content

**Build Generated Plugin**
- Packages generated plugin
- Parameters: manifest, toolCode, packageJson, installAfterBuild (body)
- Returns: Plugin name, output file path, installation status

**Reload Plugins**
- Reinitializes plugins
- Parameters: None
- Returns: Success message with stats and reload confirmations

## Speech Processing

**Transcribe Audio**
- Converts audio to text
- Parameters: audio (file, multipart)
- Returns: Transcript string

**Get Speech Service Status**
- Checks service readiness
- Parameters: None
- Returns: Status, model name, initialization flag

**Initialize Speech Service**
- Prepares service
- Parameters: None
- Returns: Success message

## Tool Registry

**Get All Tool Schemas**
- Lists available tools
- Parameters: None
- Returns: Organized arrays (triggers, actions, utilities)

**Get Tool Schema by Type**
- Retrieves tool specification
- Parameters: toolType (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Tool object with JSON schema

**Get Schemas by Category**
- Filters tools by category
- Parameters: category (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Array of tool objects

**Get Registry Statistics**
- Counts tools
- Parameters: None
- Returns: Total count, category breakdown, update timestamp

**Get Tool Metadata**
- Retrieves tool source info
- Parameters: toolType (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Metadata with source, plugin, version, author

**Reload Registry**
- Updates tool catalog
- Parameters: None
- Returns: Success message with updated stats

## Tools Retrieval

**Get Orchestrator Tools**
- Lists all available tools
- Parameters: None
- Returns: Array with id, name, category, builtin flag

**Get Workflow Tools**
- Retrieves workflow-specific tools
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Organized by type (triggers, actions, utilities, custom)

**Get Plugin Tools Only**
- Lists plugin-only tools
- Parameters: None
- Returns: Plugin tools organized by category with count

## Orchestrator Interface

**Universal Chat**
- Handles all interaction types
- Parameters: message (string), files (file array, multipart)
- Returns: Server-sent events stream

**Agent Chat**
- Directs message to agent
- Parameters: agentId, message (string), files (file array, multipart)
- Returns: Server-sent events stream

**Workflow Chat**
- Directs message to workflow
- Parameters: workflowId, message (string), files (file array, multipart)
- Returns: Server-sent events stream

**Tool Chat**
- Directs message to tool
- Parameters: toolId, message (string), files (file array, multipart)
- Returns: Server-sent events stream

**Goal Chat**
- Directs message to goal
- Parameters: goalId, message (string), files (file array, multipart)
- Returns: Server-sent events stream

**Get Suggestions**
- Generates contextual suggestions
- Parameters: context (string), type (agent|workflow|tool|goal, body)
- Returns: Array of suggestion strings

## Streaming Operations

**Start Tool Forge Stream**
- Begins tool generation
- Parameters: prompt (string), files (file array, multipart)
- Returns: Server-sent events stream

**Cancel Tool Forge Stream**
- Halts tool generation
- Parameters: streamId (string, body)
- Returns: Success confirmation

**Start Chat Stream**
- Initiates conversation stream
- Parameters: message (string), files (file array, multipart)
- Returns: Server-sent events stream

**Cancel Chat Stream**
- Stops conversation stream
- Parameters: streamId (string, body)
- Returns: Success confirmation

**Generate Tool**
- Creates tool specification
- Parameters: description, provider, model (object, body)
- Returns: Tool object

**Generate Workflow**
- Creates workflow specification
- Parameters: description, provider, model (object, body)
- Returns: Workflow object with nodes/edges

**Generate Agent**
- Creates agent specification
- Parameters: description, provider, model (object, body)
- Returns: Agent object with config

## Webhook Management

**Get All Webhooks**
- Lists configured webhooks
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Array of webhook objects

**Get Webhook by Workflow ID**
- Retrieves workflow webhook
- Parameters: workflowId (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Webhook object or null

**Delete Webhook by Workflow ID**
- Removes workflow webhook
- Parameters: workflowId (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Success message

## Connection Health

**Get Connection Health**
- Checks provider status
- Parameters: None (requires auth)
- Returns: Overall status, per-provider health with timestamps

**Get Single Provider Health**
- Checks one provider
- Parameters: providerId (string, path parameter)
- Returns: Provider status with latency and details

**Get Connection Health Stream**
- Real-time health updates
- Parameters: token (query parameter)
- Returns: Server-sent events stream

## Health Checks

Multiple services provide health endpoints returning `{"status": "OK"}`:
- Agent service
- Content output service
- Custom tool service
- Goal service
- Orchestrator service
- Stream service
- Workflow service
- User service
- Speech service
- Plugin service
- Tool schema service

---

**Note**: The documentation lists approximately 150+ endpoints across local and remote APIs. Parameters marked as "requires auth" need valid JWT tokens in the Authorization header. File uploads use multipart/form-data with 20MB limits. Server-sent events endpoints return real-time streaming data.

# AGNT Repository Structure & Tool Information

## Directory Organization

Based on the repository structure visible in the README, AGNT is organized into these key directories:

- **`/backend`** - Node.js backend services
- **`/frontend`** - Vue.js frontend application
- **`/build`** - Build configuration and scripts
- **`/docs`** - Documentation files
- **`/scripts`** - Utility and setup scripts
- **`/.github/workflows`** - CI/CD automation
- **`/tests/e2e`** - End-to-end testing suites

## Built-in Tools & Capabilities

The platform provides agents with extensive capabilities through what the documentation describes as:

**"50+ built-in tools"** including triggers, actions, utilities, and widgets. The specific tools directory structure isn't explicitly detailed in the provided content, but the system supports:

- Webhook integration and HTTP triggers
- Conditional logic branching
- Multi-provider AI model access (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, Cerebras, DeepSeek, etc.)
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) server support
- Custom tool creation via "Tool Forge"

## Extensibility System

AGNT implements a **VSCode/Figma-style plugin distribution model** using `.agnt` packages. The platform includes an "AI Plugin Generator" allowing users to describe needed functionality and have the system automatically generate plugins with bundled dependencies.

## Development Resources

The repository includes comprehensive documentation:
- `/docs/_API-DOCUMENTATION.md` - Full REST API reference
- `/docs/SELF_HOSTING.md` - Deployment guidance
- `/docs/_LINUX-BUILD-INSTRUCTIONS.md` - Platform-specific setup

The codebase uses Playwright for testing infrastructure and supports WebSocket streaming for real-time agent updates.

# WebSearch Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `web-search` (WebSearch)

**Description:** "This action node performs a web search using Google Custom Search API and returns the top results."

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `searchQuery` | string | Yes | The search query to be executed |
| `numResults` | text | No | Number of results to return (default: 3) |
| `sort` | string (select) | No | Sort order for results; options: 'date' or 'relevance' (default: 'relevance') |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `results` | array | Search result objects containing title, link, and snippet |
| `error` | string | Error message if the search operation fails |

The tool returns a formatted output object with `success` boolean, `results` array, and `error` string fields.

# Web Scrape Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `web-scrape`

**Category:** action

**Description:** "Scrapes a URL to extract main text content, all links, AND all code snippets on the page. Use the returned `links` array for recursive research and `codeContent` to build documentation."

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `url` | string | Yes | "The URL to scrape." |

## Output Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `success` | boolean | Operation success status |
| `textContent` | string | "The main text content extracted from the page" |
| `links` | array | "Array of all links found on the page" |
| `codeContent` | string | "All code snippets found on the page" |
| `error` | string | "Error message if the scraping failed" |

## Key Features

- Automatically prepends `https://` protocol if missing from URLs
- Uses headless browser (Puppeteer) with stealth plugin to appear as legitimate user
- Removes UI clutter (headers, footers, sidebars, ads, banners) before text extraction
- Extracts code blocks in markdown format with language detection
- Resolves relative URLs to absolute paths
- Returns deduplicated link list for recursive crawling

# Custom API Request Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `custom-api` (CustomApiRequest)

**Category:** Action

**Description:** "This action node makes a custom API request to any endpoint with configurable method, headers, and authentication."

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| url | string | Yes | The URL of the API endpoint |
| method | string (select) | Yes | HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH |
| authType | string (select) | No | Authentication approach: None, Basic, Bearer, Webhook |
| query | string | No | Query parameters (e.g., 'key1=value1&key2=value2') |
| headers | string (codearea) | No | Optional headers as JSON object |
| body | object (codearea) | Conditional* | Request payload; required for POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH |
| authToken | string | Conditional* | Token for Bearer or Webhook auth |
| username | string | Conditional* | Username for Basic authentication |
| password | string (password) | Conditional* | Password for Basic authentication |

*Conditional parameters appear based on method and authType selections.

## Output/Returns

| Output | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| success | boolean | Whether the API request succeeded |
| status | number | HTTP status code |
| result | object | Data returned by the API |
| headers | object | Response headers |
| error | string | Error message if request failed |

# Send Email Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `send-email`

**Category:** Action

**Description:** "This action node sends an email to a specified recipient with a customizable subject and body."

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `to` | string | Yes | Recipient's email address |
| `subject` | string | Yes | Email subject line |
| `body` | string | Yes | Email content (textarea input) |
| `isHtml` | boolean | No | Whether body uses HTML formatting |
| `attachments` | array | No | Collection of attachment objects (textarea input) |

## Output/Returns

| Output | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `success` | boolean | Indicates successful email transmission |
| `content` | object | The email parameters that were sent |
| `messageId` | string | Unique identifier for the sent message |
| `serverResponse` | object | Response details including status, statusText, data, and headers |
| `error` | null | Error information if sending failed |

## Validation Requirements

The tool enforces that `to`, `subject`, and `body` parameters must be provided; missing any will trigger an error.

# Google Sheets Operation Tool Schema

**Tool Type:** `google-sheets-api`

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `operation` | string (select) | Yes | Operation to perform: Read, Write, Append, or Clear |

| `range` | string | Yes | Cell range to interact with (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:B5') |
| `values` | array | Conditional | Comma-separated values for Write/Append operations only |

**Authentication:** OAuth required via Google provider

| Output | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `success` | boolean | Indicates whether the operation succeeded |
| `result` | array | Data returned by the operation (primarily for Read operations) |
| `error` | string | Error message if the operation failed |

# Text to Speech Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `text-to-speech`

**Category:** Utility

**Description:** "Converts text to speech using OpenAI's TTS API."

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `text` | string | Yes | The text to convert to speech (max 4096 characters) |
| `voice` | string | Yes | Voice selection from: alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer (default: alloy) |
| `speed` | number | No | Audio generation speed between 0.25 and 4.0 (default: 1) |

## Output/Returns

The tool returns an object containing:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `success` | boolean | Indicates whether the action completed successfully |
| `result` | object | Contains `audioContent` (base64-encoded audio) and `contentType` ("audio/mpeg") on success |
| `error` | string | Error message if the action failed |

## Authentication

**Required:** OpenAI API key via AuthManager

# GitHub API Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `github-api`

**Category:** Action

**Description:** "Interact with GitHub to perform various operations on repositories, issues, pull requests, and more."

**Authentication:** OAuth via GitHub provider

**Input Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| action | string (select) | Yes | The GitHub operation to execute. Options: CREATE_ISSUE, CREATE_PR, GET_REPO_INFO, CREATE_BRANCH, MERGE_PR, LIST_PRS, GET_PR_CHANGES, ADD_LABELS, REMOVE_LABELS, GET_FILE_CONTENT, GET_REPO_CONTENTS, CREATE_FILE, UPDATE_FILE, CREATE_RELEASE, LIST_COMMITS |
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner username |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| title | string | Conditional* | Issue or pull request title |
| body | string | Conditional* | Issue or pull request description |
| head | string | Conditional* | Source branch for pull request |
| base | string | Conditional* | Target branch for pull request |
| baseBranch | string | Conditional* | Source branch for new branch creation |
| newBranch | string | Conditional* | Name of branch to create |
| pullNumber | string | Conditional* | Pull request identifier |
| mergeMethod | string (select) | Conditional* | Merge strategy: merge, squash, rebase |
| state | string (select) | Conditional* | PR filter: open, closed, all |
| labels | array | Conditional* | Labels to add/remove |
| filePath | string | Conditional* | File path in repository |
| content | string | Conditional* | File content |
| commitMessage | string | Conditional* | Commit description |
| tagName | string | Conditional* | Release tag identifier |
| releaseName | string | Conditional* | Release name |
| releaseNotes | string | Conditional* | Release documentation |
| branch | string | Conditional* | Branch for commit listing |

*Conditional parameters required based on selected action

**Output Schema:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| success | boolean | Operation completion status |
| result | object | Action-specific result data |
| error | string | Error message if unsuccessful |

# Notion API Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `notion-api`

**Description:** "Interact with Notion databases, pages, and blocks."

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| operation | string (select) | Yes | Operation to perform: `search`, `getDatabaseList`, `queryDatabase`, `getPageContent`, `createPage` |
| query | string | Conditional* | Search query text |
| databaseId | string | Conditional* | ID of the database to query |
| pageId | string | Conditional* | ID of the page to retrieve |
| parentId | string | Conditional* | ID of the parent database or page |
| parentType | string (select) | Conditional* | Type of parent: `database` or `page` (default: database) |
| properties | string (JSON) | Conditional* | New page properties in JSON format |
| content | string (JSON) | Conditional* | Content blocks for new page in JSON format |
| filter | string (JSON) | Conditional* | Filter criteria in JSON format |
| sorts | string (JSON) | Conditional* | Sort criteria in JSON format |

*Conditional parameters depend on the selected operation.

## Outputs

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| success | boolean | Whether the operation succeeded |
| result | object | Operation result data |
| error | string | Error message if operation failed |

# Stripe Invoice Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `stripe-invoice`

**Description:** "Create and send a Stripe invoice with support for single or multiple line items"

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `customerEmail` | string | Yes | Email address of the customer to bill |
| `dueDate` | string | Yes | Due date for the invoice (YYYY-MM-DD format) |
| `currency` | string | Yes | Currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY); defaults to USD |
| `amount` | number | No | Amount in cents for single item (e.g., 1000 = $10.00) |
| `description` | string | No | Description for single item invoice |
| `lineItems` | array | No | Array of line items with description and amount (cents) |

*Note: Either (`amount` + `description`) OR a valid `lineItems` array is required.*

## Output/Returns

The tool returns an object containing:
- `success` (boolean)
- `invoiceId`, `invoiceNumber`, `invoiceUrl`, `invoicePdf`
- `customerEmail`, `currency`
- `subtotal`, `total`, `amountDue`, `amountPaid` (all in cents)
- `status`, `dueDate`, `createdAt`
- `itemCount`, `lineItems` (array with description, amount, quantity, currency)
- `customer` (object with id, email, name)
- `totalTax`, `taxes` (if applicable)
- `error`, `type`, `code` (on failure)

# Twitter API Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `twitter-api`

**Category:** Action

**Description:** "This action node interacts with Twitter to post tweets, delete tweets, retrieve user tweets, search tweets, and fetch user profiles."

**Authentication:** OAuth required with Twitter provider

---

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `action` | string (select) | Yes | Operation to perform: POST, DELETE, REPLY, LIKE, GET_TWEETS, GET_TIMELINE, SEARCH, GET_PROFILE, MONITOR_REPLIES, CHECK_MENTIONS, FOLLOW, UNFOLLOW, BULK_UNFOLLOW |
| `text` | string (textarea) | Conditional* | Tweet or reply content (max 280 chars) |
| `tweetId` | string | Conditional* | Tweet identifier for delete, reply, like, or monitoring |
| `userId` | string | Conditional* | User ID or username for retrieving tweets/timeline/profile |
| `targetUserId` | string | Conditional* | Target user ID/username for follow/unfollow operations |
| `userIds` | array | Conditional* | Array of usernames for bulk unfollow (max 100) |
| `maxResults` | number | Optional | Result limit; default 10 |
| `query` | string | Conditional* | Search query string |
| `sortOrder` | string (select) | Optional | Sort by RECENCY or POPULARITY; default RECENCY |

*Conditional based on selected action

---

## Output Parameters

Returns an object containing:
- `success` (boolean): Operation success indicator
- Action-specific fields: `tweetId`, `deletedTweetId`, `replyTweetId`, `likedTweetId`, `tweets`, `timeline`, `searchResults`, `userProfile`, `replies`, `mentions`, `followedUserId`, `unfollowedUserId`, `summary`
- `error` (string): Error message if operation fails

# YouTube API Tool Schema

## Tool Information
- **Name/Type:** `youtube-api`
- **Category:** action
- **Icon:** youtube
- **Description:** "Interact with the YouTube API to manage videos, comments, playlists, and more."
- **Auth Required:** OAuth with Google provider

## Actions Supported
ADD_VIDEO_TO_PLAYLIST, COMMENT_ON_VIDEO, CREATE_PLAYLIST, DISLIKE_VIDEO, GET_MY_SUBSCRIPTIONS, GET_PLAYLIST_ITEMS, GET_TRANSCRIPTION, GET_VIDEO_DETAILS, LIKE_VIDEO, LIST_CHANNEL_VIDEOS, REPLY_TO_COMMENT, SEARCH_VIDEOS, SUBSCRIBE_TO_CHANNEL, UNSUBSCRIBE_FROM_CHANNEL, UPDATE_VIDEO_METADATA, UPLOAD_VIDEO

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Conditional | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|-------------|
| action | string (select) | Yes | — | The YouTube operation to execute |
| query | string | No | SEARCH_VIDEOS | Search query text |
| videoId | string | No | Multiple actions | Video ID or full URL (auto-converts URLs to IDs) |
| fallbackMethod | string (select) | No | GET_TRANSCRIPTION | Method: 'all', 'api', 'ytdlp', or 'whisper'; default 'all' |
| channelId | string | No | Channel operations | YouTube channel identifier |
| text | string | No | Comment operations | Comment or reply content |
| commentId | string | No | REPLY_TO_COMMENT | Target comment ID |
| title | string | No | Playlist/video operations | Playlist or video title |
| description | string | No | Playlist/video operations | Playlist or video description |
| tags | string | No | Video operations | Comma-separated tag list |
| playlistId | string | No | Playlist operations | Playlist identifier |
| videoPath | string | No | UPLOAD_VIDEO | Local file path to video |
| maxResults | number | No | List operations | Result count limit (default: 10) |

## Outputs

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| success | boolean | Operation completion status |
| result | object | Action result data |
| error | string | Failure message if applicable |

# Firecrawl API Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `firecrawl-api`

**Category:** Action

**Description:** "Scrape web content using Firecrawl API"

**Authentication:** Requires API key from Firecrawl provider

**Input Parameters:**
1. **url** (string, required)
   - Description: "The URL to scrape"
   - Input type: text field

2. **format** (string, optional)
   - Description: "The desired output format"
   - Input type: dropdown selection
   - Options: Markdown, HTML
   - Default: Markdown

**Output/Returns:**
- **success** (boolean): "Indicates whether the scraping was successful"
- **result** (object): "The scraped content in the selected format"
- **error** (string): "Error message if the scraping failed"

The tool uses axios to POST requests to the Firecrawl API endpoint and returns structured responses indicating success status, scraped content, or error details.

# UnsplashAPI Tool Schema

## Tool Name
`unsplash-api`

## Tool Type
BaseAction (extends BaseAction.js)

## Description
Integrates with the Unsplash API to search, retrieve, and manage photos. Supports operations including photo search, random photo selection, collection browsing, user profiles, and download tracking.

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| action | string | Yes | Operation to perform: SEARCH_PHOTOS, GET_RANDOM_PHOTO, GET_PHOTO, LIST_PHOTOS, GET_COLLECTIONS, GET_COLLECTION_PHOTOS, GET_USER_PROFILE, GET_USER_PHOTOS, DOWNLOAD_PHOTO |
| query | string | Conditional | Required for SEARCH_PHOTOS and GET_RANDOM_PHOTO actions |
| photoId | string | Conditional | Required for GET_PHOTO and DOWNLOAD_PHOTO actions |
| collectionId | string | Conditional | Required for GET_COLLECTION_PHOTOS |
| username | string | Conditional | Required for GET_USER_PROFILE and GET_USER_PHOTOS |
| page | number | No | Pagination page (1-1000, default: 1) |
| perPage | number | No | Results per page (1-30, default: 10) |
| orderBy | string | No | Sort order: 'latest', 'oldest', 'popular', 'relevant' |
| orientation | string | No | Photo orientation: 'landscape', 'portrait', or 'squarish' |
| color | string | No | Color filter options including black, white, red, blue, green, etc. |
| featured | boolean | No | Retrieve featured photos only |
| count | number | No | Number of random photos to return |

## Output/Return Format

Returns a formatted object containing:
- `success` (boolean): Operation success status
- `result` (object): Action-specific data including photo metadata, collections, user profiles, or download URLs
- `error` (string|null): Error message if operation fails

Photo data includes URLs, dimensions, EXIF data, user info, tags, and attribution helpers.

# Zapier Webhook Action Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `zapier-action`

**Category:** Action

**Description:** "Send data to 6,000+ apps via Zapier webhooks. Trigger actions like sending emails, creating tasks, posting to social media, and more by sending JSON data to your Zap's webhook URL."

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `zapWebhookUrl` | string | Yes | The webhook URL provided by Zapier after setting up a 'Catch Hook' trigger in a Zap |
| `payload` | string | Yes | JSON data sent to Zapier webhook; becomes available for mapping within the Zap (e.g., user email, name, amount) |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `success` | boolean | Indicates successful webhook triggering |
| `zapResponse` | object | Data returned by Zapier webhook |
| `triggeredZaps` | array | List of activated Zaps including status and timestamp |
| `error` | string | Error message if webhook fails |

## Additional Output Fields

The tool may also return: `zaps`, `count`, `zapId`, `zapTitle`, `actions` (when available in the response)

# MCP Client Action Tool Schema

## Tool Identification
- **Tool Name/Type:** `mcp-client`
- **Category:** action
- **Icon:** claude

## Description
"Connect to MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. Automatically discovers servers from mcp.json. WORKFLOW: 1) List Servers to see available MCPs, 2) Get Server Capabilities to see what tools/resources a server offers, 3) Use Server to call those tools/resources."

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| operation | string (select) | No | Determines the MCP operation: List Servers, Get Server Capabilities, Use Server, Connect to Remote URL, Close Connection, or Close All Connections. Default: List Servers |
| serverUrl | string | Conditional* | Remote MCP server endpoint URL (e.g., https://mcp.notion.com/mcp) |
| authToken | string (password) | Conditional* | Optional Bearer token for authentication |
| serverName | string | Conditional* | Identifier of discovered MCP server from List Servers output |
| action | string (select) | Conditional* | Action type: List Tools, Call Tool, List Resources, Read Resource, List Prompts, or Get Prompt |
| toolName | string | Conditional* | Name of tool to invoke |
| toolArgs | string (textarea) | Conditional* | JSON string of tool parameters |
| resourceUri | string | Conditional* | Resource identifier for reading (e.g., file:///path/to/file.txt) |
| promptName | string | Conditional* | Name of prompt template to retrieve |
| promptArgs | string (textarea) | Conditional* | JSON object of template arguments |

*Conditional parameters depend on selected operation and action values.

## Output Schema

Returns object containing:
- **success** (boolean): Operation completion status
- **servers** (array): Available MCP servers with name, transport, and source
- **count** (number): Server count
- **serverName** (string): Target server identifier
- **capabilities** (object): Tools, resources, and prompts arrays
- **toolCount, resourceCount, promptCount** (numbers): Capability counts
- **result** (object): Action result data
- **serverInfo** (object): Version and capability metadata
- **error** (string): Failure message if unsuccessful

# Tool Schema: Generate With AI LLM

## Tool Identity
- **Name/Type:** `generate-with-ai-llm`
- **Category:** Action
- **Icon:** Magic

## Description
"This action node uses AI models for text generation, vision analysis, and image generation. Supports multiple providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Grok."

## Input Parameters

### Core Configuration
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `mode` | string (select) | Yes | Operation mode: Text Generation, Vision (Image → Text), or Image Generation |
| `provider` | string (select) | Yes | AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, etc.) |
| `model` | string (select) | Yes | Specific model identifier for the chosen provider |

### Text Generation Mode
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `prompt` | string (textarea) | Conditional | Input text/instructions for the LLM |
| `maxTokens` | number | Optional | Maximum tokens to generate |
| `temperature` | number | Optional | Randomness control (0.0-1.0) |
| `parseJson` | boolean | Optional | Parse output as JSON format |

### Vision Mode
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `visionPrompt` | string (textarea) | Conditional | Question/instruction about image(s) |
| `visionImage` | string (textarea) | Conditional | Base64-encoded image data |
| `maxTokens` | number | Optional | Maximum tokens to generate |
| `temperature` | number | Optional | Randomness control |

### Image Generation Mode
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `imagePrompt` | string (textarea) | Conditional | Description of desired image |
| `imageOperation` | string (select) | Optional | Generate, Edit, or Variation |
| `referenceImage` | string (textarea) | Conditional | Base64 image for Edit/Variation |
| `numberOfImages` | number | Optional | Image count (1-10) |
| `responseFormat` | string (select) | Optional | URL or b64_json format |

### Provider-Specific Options
| Parameter | Type | Provider(s) |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `imageSize` | string (select) | OpenAI |
| `imageQuality` | string (select) | OpenAI |
| `imageStyle` | string (select) | OpenAI |
| `aspectRatio` | string (select) | Gemini |
| `imageResolution` | string (select) | Gemini |
| `useGoogleSearch` | boolean | Gemini |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `generatedText` | string | LLM-generated text response |
| `tokenCount` | integer | Token count in generated text |
| `generatedImages` | array | Generated image data (URLs or base64) |
| `firstImage` | string | First generated image (convenience access) |
| `revisedPrompt` | string | Auto-enhanced prompt (Grok only) |
| `imageMetadata` | object | Image specs (size, format, model) |
| `groundingMetadata` | object | Google Search grounding data (Gemini) |
| `error` | string | Error message if operation fails |

# AIBrowserUse Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `ai-browser-use`

**Category:** Action

**Description:** "Executes instructions using Browser Use to run browser automation tasks."

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `instructions` | string (textarea) | Yes | Directions for the browser automation task |
| `provider` | string (select) | No | LLM provider choice: OpenAI, Gemini, or DeepSeek; defaults to OpenAI |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `result` | string | Text output from the automation execution |
| `gifPath` | string | File path or URL referencing the generated GIF recording |
| `error` | string | Error message if the tool encounters failure |

## Key Features

- Supports three LLM providers with provider-specific model hardcoding (gpt-4o, gemini-2.0-flash, deepseek-reasoner)
- Manages Python virtual environment and required package installation automatically
- Generates animated GIF recordings of browser activities
- Implements optional browser session reuse for persistent automation workflows

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Conditional | Description |

| `roleId` | string | No | When action is `ASSIGN_ROLE` | Role identifier to assign |
| `memberIds` | string | No | When action is `ASSIGN_ROLE` | Comma-separated user identifiers receiving the role |
| `fileName` | string | No | When action is `UPLOAD_FILE` | Name for the uploaded file |
| `fileData` | string | No | When action is `UPLOAD_FILE` | Base64-encoded file contents |

## Outputs

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `success` | boolean | Operation completion status |

# Gmail API Tool Schema

**Tool Name/Type:** `gmail-api`

**Category:** Action

**Description:** "A powerful tool to send, reply, read, organize, and manage attachments in Gmail."

**Authentication:** OAuth with Google provider required

---

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `operation` | string (select) | Yes | Specifies the Gmail action: Search and Read Emails, Send Email, Reply to Email, Read Email, Modify Email, or Get Attachments |
| `searchQuery` | string | Conditional* | Gmail search syntax for filtering emails (e.g., `from:user is:unread`); omit to fetch recent messages |
| `maxResults` | number | Conditional* | Maximum emails to retrieve (default: 10) |
| `to` | string | Conditional* | Recipient email address |
| `subject` | string | Conditional* | Email subject line |
| `body` | string | Conditional* | Email content in plain text or HTML format |
| `attachments` | string | Conditional* | JSON array of attachment objects with filename, mimetype, and base64 content |
| `messageId` | string | Conditional* | Identifier for the email message to process |
| `addLabelIds` | string | Conditional* | Comma-separated label IDs to apply (e.g., STARRED, UNREAD) |
| `removeLabelIds` | string | Conditional* | Comma-separated label IDs to remove |

*Conditional parameters depend on the selected operation.

---

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `success` | boolean | Operation completion status |
| `result` | object | Operation outcome: email list, single email object, attachment data, or API confirmation |
| `error` | string | Error message if operation fails |

## Summary of Common Patterns

All 13 tools share the same base architecture (extending `BaseAction`), and follow a consistent output contract:

- **`success`** (boolean) -- always present
- **`result`** or action-specific fields -- contains the response data
- **`error`** (string) -- present on failure

Most tools use an **`action`** or **`operation`** select parameter as the primary dispatch mechanism, with additional parameters becoming conditionally required based on the selected action. Authentication varies: some use OAuth (GitHub, Google, Twitter, Dropbox, Notion), some use API keys (Stripe, Firecrawl, Unsplash), one uses webhook URLs (Zapier), and MCP Client supports optional Bearer tokens.

## Summary of Common Patterns

All 13 tools share the same base architecture (extending `BaseAction`), and follow a consistent output contract:

- **`success`** (boolean) -- always present
- **`result`** or action-specific fields -- contains the response data
- **`error`** (string) -- present on failure

Most tools use an **`action`** or **`operation`** select parameter as the primary dispatch mechanism, with additional parameters becoming conditionally required based on the selected action. Authentication varies: some use OAuth (GitHub, Google, Twitter, Dropbox, Notion), some use API keys (Stripe, Firecrawl, Unsplash), one uses webhook URLs (Zapier), and MCP Client supports optional Bearer tokens.

Base directory for this skill: /Users/ajaxdavis/repos/tpmjs/tpmjs/.claude/skills/tpmjs-tool-creator

# TPMJS Tool Creator

Create production-ready tools for the TPMJS registry using the blocks CLI. Tools are npm packages following the AI SDK v6 pattern, validated by blocks, and automatically synced to tpmjs.com.

## Workflow

1. Define the tool block in `packages/tools/official/blocks.yml`
2. Create the tool package directory
3. Implement the tool using AI SDK v6 `tool()` + `jsonSchema()`
4. Validate with `pnpm blocks run <tool-name>`
5. Build and publish to npm

## Step 1: Define in blocks.yml

Add to the `blocks:` section of `packages/tools/official/blocks.yml`:

```yaml
blocks:
  category.toolName:
    type: utility
    description: "LLM-friendly description of what the tool does"
    path: "tool-directory-name"
    domain_rules:
      - id: rule_name
        description: "What this implementation must do"
    inputs:
      - name: inputName
        type: string
        description: "Description for LLMs"
      - name: optionalInput
        type: number
        optional: true
        description: "Optional parameter"
    outputs:
      - name: result
        type: ResultType
        description: "What the tool returns"
        measures: [working_implementation, valid_output_structure, proper_error_handling, ai_sdk_compliance]
```

**Category prefix** (before the dot): `research`, `web`, `data`, `documentation`, `engineering`, `security`, `statistics`, `ops`, `agent`, `sandbox`, `utilities`, `html`, `compliance`, `finance`, `legal`, `hr`, `marketing`, `cx`, `edu`, `sales`.

For domain entities and quality measures, see [references/domain.md](references/domain.md).

## Step 2: Create Package Directory

Create `packages/tools/official/<tool-name>/`:

```
<tool-name>/
├── package.json
├── tsconfig.json
├── tsup.config.ts
├── README.md
└── src/
    └── index.ts
```

**package.json:**
```json
{
  "name": "@tpmjs/official-<tool-name>",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Short description",
  "type": "module",
  "keywords": ["tpmjs", "<category>", "ai"],
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
      "default": "./dist/index.js"
    }
  },
  "files": ["dist"],
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsup",
    "dev": "tsup --watch",
    "type-check": "tsc --noEmit",
    "clean": "rm -rf dist .turbo"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@tpmjs/tsconfig": "workspace:*",
    "tsup": "^8.5.1",
    "typescript": "^5.9.3"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "ai": "6.0.49"
  },
  "publishConfig": { "access": "public" },
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/tpmjs/tpmjs.git",
    "directory": "packages/tools/official/<tool-name>"
  },
  "homepage": "https://tpmjs.com",
  "license": "MIT",
  "tpmjs": {
    "category": "<category>",
    "frameworks": ["vercel-ai"],
    "tools": [
      {
        "name": "toolName",
        "description": "Clear description (20+ chars)."
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

**tsconfig.json:**
```json
{
  "extends": "@tpmjs/tsconfig/react-library.json",
  "compilerOptions": { "outDir": "dist", "rootDir": "src" },
  "include": ["src/**/*.ts"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist"]
}
```

**tsup.config.ts:**
```typescript
import { defineConfig } from 'tsup';

export default defineConfig({
  entry: ['src/index.ts'],
  format: ['esm'],
  dts: true,
  clean: true,
  sourcemap: true,
  target: 'es2022',
});
```

## Step 3: Implement the Tool

Every tool follows this AI SDK v6 pattern in `src/index.ts`:

```typescript
import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';

interface MyToolInput {
  param1: string;
  param2?: number;
}

export interface MyToolResult {
  data: string;
  metadata: { processedAt: string };
}

export const myTool = tool({
  description: 'Clear LLM-friendly description of what this tool does.',
  parameters: jsonSchema<MyToolInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      param1: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'What param1 is for',
      },
      param2: {
        type: 'number',
        description: 'Optional: what param2 is for',
      },
    },
    required: ['param1'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  execute: async (input): Promise<MyToolResult> => {
    if (!input.param1) {
      throw new Error('param1 is required and must be non-empty');
    }

    try {
      const result = await processData(input.param1);
      return {
        data: result,
        metadata: { processedAt: new Date().toISOString() },
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(
        `Failed to process: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`
      );
    }
  },
});

export default myTool;
```

**Hard rules:**
- No stubs, TODOs, or placeholders — every tool must be fully working
- Single-shot: one call in, one structured result out
- Validate inputs before processing
- Try-catch with descriptive errors including context
- `additionalProperties: false` on jsonSchema
- Description on every schema property
- Export as both named and default export
- Output interface must be exported

### Multi-Tool Packages

For packages with multiple tools, add root-level files:

**block.ts:**
```typescript
import { toolA, toolB } from './src/index.js';
export const block = { name: 'package-name', tools: { toolA, toolB } };
export default block;
```

**index.ts (root):**
```typescript
export * from './src/index.js';
export { default } from './src/index.js';
```

Each tool gets its own entry in blocks.yml (same `path`) and in `tpmjs.tools` array.

## Step 4: Validate

The blocks CLI domain validator requires an OpenAI API key. Source it from `.env.local` before running:

```bash
cd packages/tools/official

# Load the OpenAI API key for domain validation
source ../../../.env.local
export OPENAI_API_KEY

pnpm blocks run <tool-name>            # Validate (schema → shape → domain)
pnpm blocks run <tool-name> --force    # Force full validation (skip cache)
pnpm blocks run <tool-name> --json     # JSON output for debugging
pnpm blocks run --all                  # Validate all tools
```

**Common errors:**
- `Tool "X" not found in exports` → Export name must match blocks.yml
- `Required file not found` → Check package root has all required files
- `invalid tpmjs field` → Category must be valid, tools array required

## Step 5: Build and Publish

```bash
pnpm --filter=@tpmjs/official-<tool-name> build
cd packages/tools/official/<tool-name> && npm publish --access public
```

The tool syncs to tpmjs.com automatically via the changes feed (every 2 min) and keyword search (every 15 min). To trigger immediately:

```bash
source apps/web/.env.local
curl -X POST https://tpmjs.com/api/sync/keyword \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET"
```

## README Template

Every tool needs a README:

```markdown
# @tpmjs/official-<tool-name>

Short description.

## Installation

npm install @tpmjs/official-<tool-name>

## Usage

\`\`\`typescript
import { myTool } from '@tpmjs/official-<tool-name>';

const result = await myTool.execute({ param1: 'example' });
\`\`\`

## Parameters

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description        |
|--------|--------|----------|--------------------|
| param1 | string | Yes      | What param1 is for |

## Output

| Field | Type   | Description          |
|-------|--------|----------------------|
| data  | string | The processed result |

## License

MIT
```

file.content:
name: "tpmjs-official-tools"
root: "."

# AI Configuration
ai:
  provider: "openai"
  model: "gpt-4o-mini"

# =============================================================================
# PHILOSOPHY - Core principles that guide all tool development
# =============================================================================
philosophy:
  - "Every tool MUST be a working, production-ready implementation - no stubs, no TODOs"
  - "Tools use AI SDK v6 tool() + jsonSchema() pattern exclusively"
  - "Each tool does ONE thing exceptionally well (single-shot, one call in, one result out)"
  - "Tools return structured, typed outputs that agents can reliably parse"
  - "Error handling is explicit - throw meaningful errors, never silently fail"
  - "All async operations use proper error boundaries"
  - "Dependencies are minimal and production-stable (no alpha/beta packages unless necessary)"
  - "Tools are deterministic where possible - same input yields same output"
  - "Network I/O is async but tools are single-shot (no streaming, no multi-step orchestration inside)"

# =============================================================================
# DOMAIN - Entities, signals, and measures that define the problem space
# =============================================================================
domain:
  entities:
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Core web entities
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    url:
      fields: [href, domain, protocol, path, query, fragment]
      description: "A fully qualified URL with parsed components"

    webpage:
      fields: [url, title, html, text, metadata]
      description: "A fetched webpage with extracted content"

    redirect_chain:
      fields: [steps, finalUrl, statusCodes]
      description: "Full redirect trace from origin to destination"

    meta_tags:
      fields: [title, description, canonical, ogTags, twitterTags]
      description: "Extracted metadata for previews and SEO"

    json_ld:
      fields: [type, data, context]
      description: "Structured data extracted from JSON-LD blocks"

    link_catalog:
      fields: [internal, external, anchors, resolved]
      description: "Categorized links from a page"

    html_table:
      fields: [headers, rows, caption]
      description: "Normalized table data from HTML"

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Research & content entities
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    text_content:
      fields: [raw, sentences, paragraphs, wordCount]
      description: "Processed text with structural analysis"

    claim:
      fields: [statement, confidence, needsCitation, category, suggestedEvidence]
      description: "A factual assertion that can be verified"
      categories: [factual, statistical, quote, attribution, prediction]

    timeline_event:
      fields: [date, description, confidence, source, dateType]
      description: "A dated event with provenance"
      dateTypes: [specific, partial, relative, range]

    page_brief:
      fields: [url, title, summary, keyPoints, claims]
      description: "A summarized view of a webpage"

    comparison_result:
      fields: [agreements, conflicts, uniqueToA, uniqueToB, similarity]
      description: "Side-by-side analysis of two sources"

    credibility_score:
      fields: [score, signals, warnings, recommendations, confidence]
      description: "Trust assessment of a source"

    claim_checklist:
      fields: [claims, citedCount, uncitedCount, byPriority]
      description: "Extracted claims with citation status"

    timeline:
      fields: [events, dateRange, gaps, eventCount]
      description: "Chronological event sequence"

    rss_feed:
      fields: [title, link, items, lastBuildDate]
      description: "Parsed RSS/Atom feed with normalized items"

    rss_item:

Create the source files for 4 TPMJS tools in /Users/ajaxdavis/repos/tpmjs/tpmjs/packages/tools/official/. Each tool needs a package.json, README.md, and src/index.ts.

Follow these EXACT patterns from the existing discord tool:
- Use `import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';` 
- Use `inputSchema: jsonSchema<Type>({...})` (NOT `parameters:`)
- Export each tool as both named export AND include in default export object
- Export all interfaces
- `additionalProperties: false` on all schemas
- Description on every property
- Try-catch with descriptive errors in every execute function
- Get API keys from environment variables with clear error messages

---

## Tool 1: agnt-google-search

**Directory:** agnt-google-search/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-search
**Description:** Search the web using Google Custom Search API. Requires GOOGLE_SEARCH_API_KEY and GOOGLE_SEARCH_ENGINE_ID environment variables.
**Category:** research

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[{"name": "googleSearch", "description": "Search the web using Google Custom Search API and return top results."}]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Tool name: `googleSearch`
- Env vars: `GOOGLE_SEARCH_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_SEARCH_ENGINE_ID`
- Parameters:
  - `query` (string, required) - Search query
  - `numResults` (number, optional) - Number of results (1-10, default 3)
  - `sort` (string, optional) - Sort order: "date" or "relevance"
- Uses `https://www.googleapis.com/customsearch/v1` endpoint
- Returns array of `{title, link, snippet}`

---

## Tool 2: agnt-http-request

**Directory:** agnt-http-request/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-http-request
**Description:** Make HTTP requests to any API endpoint with configurable method, headers, auth, and body.
**Category:** utilities

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[{"name": "httpRequest", "description": "Make an HTTP request to any API endpoint with configurable method, headers, and authentication."}]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Tool name: `httpRequest`
- No required env vars (auth is per-request)
- Parameters:
  - `url` (string, required) - API endpoint URL
  - `method` (string, required) - HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH
  - `headers` (string, optional) - JSON string of headers
  - `body` (string, optional) - Request body as JSON string
  - `authType` (string, optional) - "none", "basic", "bearer"
  - `authToken` (string, optional) - Bearer token
  - `username` (string, optional) - Basic auth username
  - `password` (string, optional) - Basic auth password
  - `query` (string, optional) - Query parameters as key=value&key=value
- Returns `{success, status, statusText, data (parsed JSON or text), headers}`

---

## Tool 3: agnt-openai-tts

**Description:** Read, write, append, and clear Google Sheets data. Requires GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY or GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** data

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "readSheet", "description": "Read data from a Google Sheets range."},
  {"name": "writeSheet", "description": "Write data to a Google Sheets range."},
  {"name": "appendSheet", "description": "Append rows to a Google Sheet."},
  {"name": "clearSheet", "description": "Clear data from a Google Sheets range."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` (JSON string of service account credentials) — parse it to get `client_email` and `private_key`, then create a JWT to get an access token from `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token` with scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets`
- Base URL: `https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets`
- Shared helper: `async function getAccessToken()` and `async function sheetsRequest<T>(method, path, body?)`

Helper for JWT: Create a JWT with header `{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT"}`, payload `{"iss": client_email, "scope": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets", "aud": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", "exp": now+3600, "iat": now}`. Sign with the private key using Node's `crypto.createSign('RSA-SHA256')`. Then exchange for access token via POST to `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token` with `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer&assertion={jwt}`.

### readSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:B5")
- GET `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}`
- Returns `{range, values: string[][], rowCount, columnCount}`

### writeSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required), `values` (string, required - JSON array of arrays)
- PUT `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED` with body `{values: parsed}`
- Returns `{updatedRange, updatedRows, updatedColumns, updatedCells}`

### appendSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required), `values` (string, required - JSON array of arrays)
- POST `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:append?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED` with body `{values: parsed}`
- Returns `{updatedRange, updatedRows, updatedColumns, updatedCells}`

- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required)

4. Build Authorization header: `OAuth oauth_consumer_key="...", oauth_nonce="...", oauth_signature="...", oauth_signature_method="HMAC-SHA1", oauth_timestamp="...", oauth_token="...", oauth_version="1.0"`

```json
[
```
```json
  {"name": "searchEmails", "description": "Search Gmail emails using Gmail search syntax."},

]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env vars: `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` (JSON string), `GMAIL_USER_EMAIL` (email to impersonate)
- Use service account with domain-wide delegation: create JWT with `sub` = GMAIL_USER_EMAIL, scope = `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify`
- Base URL: `https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me`

JWT auth helper (same pattern as google-sheets): parse the service account JSON for `client_email` and `private_key`. Create JWT with `{"iss": client_email, "sub": userEmail, "scope": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify", "aud": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", "exp": now+3600, "iat": now}`. Sign with RS256 using `crypto.createSign('RSA-SHA256')`. Exchange at `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token`.

### searchEmails
- Parameters: `query` (string, required - Gmail search syntax e.g. "from:user@example.com is:unread"), `maxResults` (number, optional, default 10)
- GET `/messages?q={query}&maxResults={maxResults}`
- For each message ID returned, GET `/messages/{id}?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=From&metadataHeaders=To&metadataHeaders=Subject&metadataHeaders=Date`
- Returns `{messages: [{id, threadId, from, to, subject, date, snippet}], resultCount}`

### readEmail
- Parameters: `messageId` (string, required)
- GET `/messages/{messageId}?format=full`
- Parse headers for From, To, Subject, Date. Extract body from payload (handle multipart/alternative, get text/plain or text/html)
- Returns `{id, threadId, from, to, subject, date, body, snippet, labels}`

### sendGmail
- Parameters: `to` (string, required), `subject` (string, required), `body` (string, required), `isHtml` (boolean, optional, default false)
- Create RFC 2822 email message: `From: {userEmail}\r\nTo: {to}\r\nSubject: {subject}\r\nContent-Type: {text/plain or text/html}; charset=utf-8\r\n\r\n{body}`
- Base64url encode the message
- POST `/messages/send` with body `{raw: base64urlMessage}`
- Returns `{messageId, threadId}`

      - name: path

        optional: true

      - name: maxDepth

ools/official/agnt-http-request/README.md","content":"# @tpmjs/official-agnt-http-request

Make HTTP requests to any API endpoint with configurable method, headers, authentication, and body.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-http-request
```

## Setup

No environment variables required. Authentication credentials are provided per-request.

## Usage

```typescript
import { httpRequest } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-http-request';

// Simple GET request
const get = await httpRequest.execute({ url: 'https://api.example.com/data', method: 'GET' });

// POST with JSON body
const post = await httpRequest.execute({
  url: 'https://api.example.com/items',
  method: 'POST',
  body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'New Item' }),
  headers: JSON.stringify({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
});

// Authenticated request
const auth = await httpRequest.execute({
  url: 'https://api.example.com/protected',
  method: 'GET',
  authType: 'bearer',
  authToken: 'your-token-here',
});
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| httpRequest | Make an HTTP request to any API endpoint with configurable method, headers, and authentication |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| url | string | Yes | The full URL of the API endpoint to call |
| method | string | Yes | HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, or PATCH |
| headers | string | No | Additional HTTP headers as a JSON string |
| body | string | No | Request body as a JSON string (ignored for GET) |
| authType | string | No | Authentication type: "none", "basic", or "bearer" (default: none) |
| authToken | string | No | Bearer token (required when authType is "bearer") |
| username | string | No | Username for Basic auth (required when authType is "basic") |
| password | string | No | Password for Basic auth (required when authType is "basic") |
| query | string | No | Query parameters as key=value&key=value string |

## Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| success | boolean | Whether the request returned a 2xx status code |
| status | number | HTTP status code |
| statusText | string | HTTP status text |
| data | unknown | Response body (parsed as JSON if possible, otherwise raw text) |
| headers | object | Response headers as key-value pairs |

## License

MIT

```json
[{"name": "createStripeInvoice", "description": "Create and send a Stripe invoice with support for single or multiple line items."}]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Tool name: `createStripeInvoice`
- Env var: `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`
- Parameters:
  - `customerEmail` (string, required) - Customer email
  - `dueDate` (string, required) - Due date YYYY-MM-DD
  - `currency` (string, optional) - USD, EUR, GBP, JPY (default: USD)
  - `description` (string, optional) - Description for single item
  - `amount` (number, optional) - Amount in cents for single item
  - `lineItems` (string, optional) - JSON array of {description, amount} for multiple items
- Uses Stripe API (`https://api.stripe.com/v1/...`) with form-encoded body:
  1. Create customer (POST /v1/customers)
  2. Create invoice items (POST /v1/invoiceitems) 
  3. Create invoice (POST /v1/invoices)
  4. Finalize invoice (POST /v1/invoices/{id}/finalize)
  5. Send invoice (POST /v1/invoices/{id}/send)
- Returns `{invoiceId, invoiceNumber, invoiceUrl, invoicePdf, status, total, currency}`

    12→const BASE_URL = 'https://discord.com/api/v10';

    14→// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    15→
    16→function getApiKey(): string {
    17→  const key = process.env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN;
    18→  if (!key) {
    19→    throw new Error(
    20→      'DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN environment variable is required. Get your token from https://discord.com/developers/applications'
    21→    );
    22→  }
    23→  return key;
    24→}
    25→
    26→async function apiRequest<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    27→  const key = getApiKey();
    28→
    29→  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    30→    Authorization: `Bot ${key}`,
    31→    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    32→  };
    33→
    34→  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
    35→  if (body !== undefined) {
    36→    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, options);
    40→
    41→  if (!response.ok) {
    42→    await handleApiError(response);
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (response.status === 204) {
    46→    return { success: true } as T;
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  const text = await response.text();
    50→  if (!text) {
    51→    return {} as T;
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
    55→}

    57→async function handleApiError(response: Response): Promise<never> {
    58→  let errorMessage: string;
    59→  try {
    60→    const errorData = (await response.json()) as { message?: string; code?: number };
    61→    errorMessage = errorData.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    62→    if (errorData.code) {
    63→      errorMessage = `${errorMessage} (Discord Error Code: ${errorData.code})`;
    64→    }
    65→  } catch {
    66→    errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  switch (response.status) {
    70→    case 400:
    71→      throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
    72→    case 401:
    73→      throw new Error('Authentication failed: Invalid Discord bot token. Check DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.');
    74→    case 403:
    75→      throw new Error(`Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}`);
    76→    case 404:
    77→      throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}`);
    78→    case 429:
    79→      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
    80→    default:
    81→      throw new Error(`Discord API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    82→  }
    83→}

    85→function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>): string {
    86→  const entries = Object.entries(params).filter(
    87→    ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''
    88→  );
    89→  if (entries.length === 0) return '';
    90→  return (
    91→    '?' +
    92→    entries.map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`).join('&')
    93→  );
    94→}

// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getApiKey(): string {
  const key = process.env.GOOGLE_SEARCH_API_KEY;
  if (!key) {

      'GOOGLE_SEARCH_API_KEY environment variable is required. Get your API key from https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials'

  return key;
}

function getSearchEngineId(): string {
  const id = process.env.GOOGLE_SEARCH_ENGINE_ID;
  if (!id) {
    throw new Error(

    );

  return id;

  title: string;
  link: string;
  snippet: string;

        }
      }

        items?: Array<{ title: string; link: string; snippet: string }>;
        searchInformation?: { totalResults: string; searchTime: number };

      },

        description:

      },

  }),
  async execute(input: TextToSpeechInput): Promise<TextToSpeechResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.text || input.text.trim().length === 0) {
        throw new Error('text is required and must be non-empty');
      }

      if (input.text.length > 4096) {

        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },

          input: input.text,

  },

async function stripeRequest<T>(
  method: string,
  path: string,
  body?: Record<string, string>
): Promise<T> {
  const key = getApiKey();

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,

    await handleStripeError(response);

  return (await response.json()) as T;
}

async function handleStripeError(response: Response): Promise<never> {

  inputSchema: jsonSchema<CreateStripeInvoiceInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      customerEmail: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Email address of the customer to invoice.',
      },
      dueDate: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Invoice due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.',
      },
      currency: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'Three-letter currency code: USD, EUR, GBP, or JPY (default: USD).',
      },
      description: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'Description for a single line item. Use this with "amount" for simple invoices.',
      },
      amount: {
        type: 'number',
        description:
          'Amount in smallest currency unit (e.g. cents) for a single line item. Use with "description".',
      },
      lineItems: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'JSON array of line items for multi-item invoices. Each item: {"description": "...", "amount": 1000}. Amounts in smallest currency unit.',
      },
    },
    required: ['customerEmail', 'dueDate'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: CreateStripeInvoiceInput): Promise<StripeInvoiceResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.customerEmail || input.customerEmail.trim().length === 0) {
        throw new Error('customerEmail is required and must be non-empty');
      }

      if (!input.dueDate || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(input.dueDate)) {
        throw new Error('dueDate is required and must be in YYYY-MM-DD format');
      }

      const currency = (input.currency ?? 'USD').toLowerCase();
      if (!VALID_CURRENCIES.includes(currency)) {
        throw new Error(`currency must be one of: ${VALID_CURRENCIES.map((c) => c.toUpperCase()).join(', ')}`);
      }

      // Parse line items
      let items: StripeLineItem[] = [];

      if (input.lineItems) {
        try {
          items = JSON.parse(input.lineItems) as StripeLineItem[];
        } catch {
          throw new Error(
            'lineItems must be a valid JSON array (e.g. \'[{"description": "Service", "amount": 5000}]\')'
          );

        if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('lineItems must be a non-empty array');
        }

        for (const item of items) {
          if (!item.description || typeof item.amount !== 'number') {
            throw new Error(

            );
          }
          if (item.amount <= 0) {
            throw new Error('Each line item amount must be greater than 0');
          }

      } else if (input.description && input.amount !== undefined) {
        if (input.amount <= 0) {
          throw new Error('amount must be greater than 0');

      } else {
        throw new Error(
          'Provide either "description" + "amount" for a single item, or "lineItems" JSON array for multiple items'
        );
      }

      const customer = await stripeRequest<StripeCustomer>('POST', '/customers', {

      const dueDateTimestamp = Math.floor(new Date(input.dueDate).getTime() / 1000);

        currency,

Search the web using Google Custom Search API. Returns structured results with titles, links, and snippets.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-search
```

## Setup

Set the following environment variables:

- `GOOGLE_SEARCH_API_KEY` - API key from [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials)
- `GOOGLE_SEARCH_ENGINE_ID` - Search engine ID from [Programmable Search Engine](https://programmablesearchengine.google.com/)

## Usage

```typescript
import { googleSearch } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-google-search';

const result = await googleSearch.execute({ query: 'TypeScript best practices' });
const dated = await googleSearch.execute({ query: 'latest news', numResults: 5, sort: 'date' });
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| googleSearch | Search the web using Google Custom Search API and return top results |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| query | string | Yes | The search query to execute |
| numResults | number | No | Number of results to return (1-10, default: 3) |
| sort | string | No | Sort order: "date" for recency or "relevance" for best match (default: relevance) |

## Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| results | array | Array of search result objects |
| results[].title | string | Title of the search result |
| results[].link | string | URL of the search result |
| results[].snippet | string | Text snippet from the search result |
| totalResults | string | Total number of matching results |
| searchTime | number | Time taken for the search in seconds |
| query | string | The original search query |
