Make HTTP requests to any API endpoint with configurable method, headers, authentication, and body.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-http-request
```

## Setup

No environment variables required. Authentication credentials are provided per-request.

## Usage

```typescript
import { httpRequest } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-http-request';

// Simple GET request
const get = await httpRequest.execute({ url: 'https://api.example.com/data', method: 'GET' });

// POST with JSON body
const post = await httpRequest.execute({
  url: 'https://api.example.com/items',
  method: 'POST',
  body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'New Item' }),
  headers: JSON.stringify({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
});

// Authenticated request
const auth = await httpRequest.execute({
  url: 'https://api.example.com/protected',
  method: 'GET',
  authType: 'bearer',
  authToken: 'your-token-here',
});
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| httpRequest | Make an HTTP request to any API endpoint with configurable method, headers, and authentication |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| url | string | Yes | The full URL of the API endpoint to call |
| method | string | Yes | HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, or PATCH |
| headers | string | No | Additional HTTP headers as a JSON string |
| body | string | No | Request body as a JSON string (ignored for GET) |
| authType | string | No | Authentication type: "none", "basic", or "bearer" (default: none) |
| authToken | string | No | Bearer token (required when authType is "bearer") |
| username | string | No | Username for Basic auth (required when authType is "basic") |
| password | string | No | Password for Basic auth (required when authType is "basic") |
| query | string | No | Query parameters as key=value&key=value string |

## Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| success | boolean | Whether the request returned a 2xx status code |
| status | number | HTTP status code |
| statusText | string | HTTP status text |
| data | unknown | Response body (parsed as JSON if possible, otherwise raw text) |
| headers | object | Response headers as key-value pairs |

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-openai-tts
```

## Setup

Set the `OPENAI_API_KEY` environment variable. Get your API key from [OpenAI Platform](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys).

## Usage

```typescript
import { textToSpeech } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-openai-tts';

// Basic usage

const custom = await textToSpeech.execute({
  text: 'Welcome to our application.',
  voice: 'nova',
  speed: 1.2,
  model: 'tts-1-hd',
});

// Decode the audio
const audioBuffer = Buffer.from(result.audioContent, 'base64');
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|

|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| text | string | Yes | Text to convert to speech (maximum 4096 characters) |
| voice | string | No | Voice: alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, or shimmer (default: alloy) |
| speed | number | No | Playback speed from 0.25 to 4.0 (default: 1.0) |
| model | string | No | Model: "tts-1" for standard or "tts-1-hd" for high definition (default: tts-1) |

## Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| audioContent | string | Base64-encoded MP3 audio data |
| contentType | string | MIME type of the audio (always "audio/mpeg") |
| textLength | number | Length of the input text in characters |
| voice | string | The voice that was used for synthesis |

Create and send Stripe invoices with support for single or multiple line items.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-stripe-invoice
```

## Setup

Set the `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` environment variable. Get your secret key from the [Stripe Dashboard](https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys).

## Usage

```typescript
import { createStripeInvoice } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-stripe-invoice';

// Single line item
const invoice = await createStripeInvoice.execute({
  customerEmail: 'customer@example.com',
  dueDate: '2026-03-15',
  description: 'Web Development Services',
  amount: 50000, // $500.00 in cents
});

// Multiple line items
const multiInvoice = await createStripeInvoice.execute({
  customerEmail: 'customer@example.com',
  dueDate: '2026-03-15',
  currency: 'EUR',
  lineItems: JSON.stringify([
    { description: 'Design Services', amount: 30000 },
    { description: 'Development Services', amount: 70000 },
    { description: 'Hosting (Monthly)', amount: 5000 },
  ]),
});

console.log(invoice.invoiceUrl); // Link to hosted invoice page
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| createStripeInvoice | Create and send a Stripe invoice with support for single or multiple line items |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| customerEmail | string | Yes | Email address of the customer to invoice |
| dueDate | string | Yes | Invoice due date in YYYY-MM-DD format |
| currency | string | No | Three-letter currency code: USD, EUR, GBP, or JPY (default: USD) |
| description | string | No | Description for a single line item (use with amount) |
| amount | number | No | Amount in smallest currency unit for a single line item (use with description) |
| lineItems | string | No | JSON array of line items: [{"description": "...", "amount": 1000}] |

## Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| invoiceId | string | Stripe invoice ID |
| invoiceNumber | string | Human-readable invoice number |
| invoiceUrl | string | URL to the hosted invoice payment page |
| invoicePdf | string | URL to download the invoice as PDF |
| status | string | Invoice status (e.g. "open", "sent") |
| total | number | Total amount in smallest currency unit |
| currency | string | Three-letter currency code |

    10→import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';

    12→const BASE_URL = 'https://discord.com/api/v10';

    14→// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    15→
    16→function getApiKey(): string {
    17→  const key = process.env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN;
    18→  if (!key) {
    19→    throw new Error(
    20→      'DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN environment variable is required. Get your token from https://discord.com/developers/applications'
    21→    );
    22→  }
    23→  return key;

    25→
    26→async function apiRequest<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    27→  const key = getApiKey();
    28→
    29→  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    30→    Authorization: `Bot ${key}`,
    31→    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    32→  };
    33→
    34→  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
    35→  if (body !== undefined) {
    36→    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, options);
    40→
    41→  if (!response.ok) {
    42→    await handleApiError(response);
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (response.status === 204) {
    46→    return { success: true } as T;
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  const text = await response.text();
    50→  if (!text) {
    51→    return {} as T;
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
    55→}
    56→
    57→async function handleApiError(response: Response): Promise<never> {
    58→  let errorMessage: string;
    59→  try {
    60→    const errorData = (await response.json()) as { message?: string; code?: number };
    61→    errorMessage = errorData.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    62→    if (errorData.code) {
    63→      errorMessage = `${errorMessage} (Discord Error Code: ${errorData.code})`;
    64→    }
    65→  } catch {
    66→    errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  switch (response.status) {
    70→    case 400:
    71→      throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
    72→    case 401:
    73→      throw new Error('Authentication failed: Invalid Discord bot token. Check DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.');
    74→    case 403:
    75→      throw new Error(`Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}`);
    76→    case 404:
    77→      throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}`);
    78→    case 429:
    79→      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
    80→    default:
    81→      throw new Error(`Discord API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    82→  }
    83→}

    85→function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>): string {
    86→  const entries = Object.entries(params).filter(
    87→    ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''
    88→  );
    89→  if (entries.length === 0) return '';
    90→  return (
    91→    '?' +
    92→    entries.map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`).join('&')
    93→  );
    94→}

// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getApiKey(): string {
  const key = process.env.GOOGLE_SEARCH_API_KEY;
  if (!key) {

      'GOOGLE_SEARCH_API_KEY environment variable is required. Get your API key from https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials'

  return key;
}

function getSearchEngineId(): string {
  const id = process.env.GOOGLE_SEARCH_ENGINE_ID;
  if (!id) {
    throw new Error(

    );

  return id;

  title: string;
  link: string;
  snippet: string;

        }
      }

        items?: Array<{ title: string; link: string; snippet: string }>;
        searchInformation?: { totalResults: string; searchTime: number };

      },

        description:

      },

  }),
  async execute(input: TextToSpeechInput): Promise<TextToSpeechResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.text || input.text.trim().length === 0) {
        throw new Error('text is required and must be non-empty');
      }

      if (input.text.length > 4096) {

        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },

          input: input.text,

  },

async function stripeRequest<T>(
  method: string,
  path: string,
  body?: Record<string, string>
): Promise<T> {
  const key = getApiKey();

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,

    await handleStripeError(response);

  return (await response.json()) as T;
}

async function handleStripeError(response: Response): Promise<never> {

  inputSchema: jsonSchema<CreateStripeInvoiceInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      customerEmail: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Email address of the customer to invoice.',
      },
      dueDate: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Invoice due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.',
      },
      currency: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'Three-letter currency code: USD, EUR, GBP, or JPY (default: USD).',
      },
      description: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'Description for a single line item. Use this with "amount" for simple invoices.',
      },
      amount: {
        type: 'number',
        description:
          'Amount in smallest currency unit (e.g. cents) for a single line item. Use with "description".',
      },
      lineItems: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'JSON array of line items for multi-item invoices. Each item: {"description": "...", "amount": 1000}. Amounts in smallest currency unit.',
      },
    },
    required: ['customerEmail', 'dueDate'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: CreateStripeInvoiceInput): Promise<StripeInvoiceResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.customerEmail || input.customerEmail.trim().length === 0) {
        throw new Error('customerEmail is required and must be non-empty');
      }

      if (!input.dueDate || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(input.dueDate)) {
        throw new Error('dueDate is required and must be in YYYY-MM-DD format');
      }

      const currency = (input.currency ?? 'USD').toLowerCase();
      if (!VALID_CURRENCIES.includes(currency)) {
        throw new Error(`currency must be one of: ${VALID_CURRENCIES.map((c) => c.toUpperCase()).join(', ')}`);
      }

      // Parse line items
      let items: StripeLineItem[] = [];

      if (input.lineItems) {
        try {
          items = JSON.parse(input.lineItems) as StripeLineItem[];
        } catch {
          throw new Error(
            'lineItems must be a valid JSON array (e.g. \'[{"description": "Service", "amount": 5000}]\')'
          );

        if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('lineItems must be a non-empty array');
        }

        for (const item of items) {
          if (!item.description || typeof item.amount !== 'number') {
            throw new Error(

            );
          }
          if (item.amount <= 0) {
            throw new Error('Each line item amount must be greater than 0');
          }

      } else if (input.description && input.amount !== undefined) {
        if (input.amount <= 0) {
          throw new Error('amount must be greater than 0');

      } else {
        throw new Error(
          'Provide either "description" + "amount" for a single item, or "lineItems" JSON array for multiple items'
        );
      }

      const customer = await stripeRequest<StripeCustomer>('POST', '/customers', {

      const dueDateTimestamp = Math.floor(new Date(input.dueDate).getTime() / 1000);

        currency,

Search the web using Google Custom Search API. Returns structured results with titles, links, and snippets.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-search
```

## Setup

Set the following environment variables:

- `GOOGLE_SEARCH_API_KEY` - API key from [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials)
- `GOOGLE_SEARCH_ENGINE_ID` - Search engine ID from [Programmable Search Engine](https://programmablesearchengine.google.com/)

## Usage

```typescript
import { googleSearch } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-google-search';

const result = await googleSearch.execute({ query: 'TypeScript best practices' });
const dated = await googleSearch.execute({ query: 'latest news', numResults: 5, sort: 'date' });
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| googleSearch | Search the web using Google Custom Search API and return top results |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| query | string | Yes | The search query to execute |
| numResults | number | No | Number of results to return (1-10, default: 3) |
| sort | string | No | Sort order: "date" for recency or "relevance" for best match (default: relevance) |

## Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| results | array | Array of search result objects |
| results[].title | string | Title of the search result |
| results[].link | string | URL of the search result |
| results[].snippet | string | Text snippet from the search result |
| totalResults | string | Total number of matching results |
| searchTime | number | Time taken for the search in seconds |
| query | string | The original search query |

Make HTTP requests to any API endpoint with configurable method, headers, authentication, and body.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-http-request
```

## Setup

No environment variables required. Authentication credentials are provided per-request.

## Usage

```typescript
import { httpRequest } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-http-request';

// Simple GET request
const get = await httpRequest.execute({ url: 'https://api.example.com/data', method: 'GET' });

// POST with JSON body
const post = await httpRequest.execute({
  url: 'https://api.example.com/items',
  method: 'POST',
  body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'New Item' }),
  headers: JSON.stringify({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
});

// Authenticated request
const auth = await httpRequest.execute({
  url: 'https://api.example.com/protected',
  method: 'GET',
  authType: 'bearer',
  authToken: 'your-token-here',
});
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| httpRequest | Make an HTTP request to any API endpoint with configurable method, headers, and authentication |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| url | string | Yes | The full URL of the API endpoint to call |
| method | string | Yes | HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, or PATCH |
| headers | string | No | Additional HTTP headers as a JSON string |
| body | string | No | Request body as a JSON string (ignored for GET) |
| authType | string | No | Authentication type: "none", "basic", or "bearer" (default: none) |
| authToken | string | No | Bearer token (required when authType is "bearer") |
| username | string | No | Username for Basic auth (required when authType is "basic") |
| password | string | No | Password for Basic auth (required when authType is "basic") |
| query | string | No | Query parameters as key=value&key=value string |

## Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| success | boolean | Whether the request returned a 2xx status code |
| status | number | HTTP status code |
| statusText | string | HTTP status text |
| data | unknown | Response body (parsed as JSON if possible, otherwise raw text) |
| headers | object | Response headers as key-value pairs |

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-openai-tts
```

## Setup

Set the `OPENAI_API_KEY` environment variable. Get your API key from [OpenAI Platform](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys).

## Usage

```typescript
import { textToSpeech } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-openai-tts';

// Basic usage

const custom = await textToSpeech.execute({
  text: 'Welcome to our application.',
  voice: 'nova',
  speed: 1.2,
  model: 'tts-1-hd',
});

// Decode the audio
const audioBuffer = Buffer.from(result.audioContent, 'base64');
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|

|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| text | string | Yes | Text to convert to speech (maximum 4096 characters) |
| voice | string | No | Voice: alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, or shimmer (default: alloy) |
| speed | number | No | Playback speed from 0.25 to 4.0 (default: 1.0) |
| model | string | No | Model: "tts-1" for standard or "tts-1-hd" for high definition (default: tts-1) |

## Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| audioContent | string | Base64-encoded MP3 audio data |
| contentType | string | MIME type of the audio (always "audio/mpeg") |
| textLength | number | Length of the input text in characters |
| voice | string | The voice that was used for synthesis |

Create and send Stripe invoices with support for single or multiple line items.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-stripe-invoice
```

## Setup

Set the `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` environment variable. Get your secret key from the [Stripe Dashboard](https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys).

## Usage

```typescript
import { createStripeInvoice } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-stripe-invoice';

// Single line item
const invoice = await createStripeInvoice.execute({
  customerEmail: 'customer@example.com',
  dueDate: '2026-03-15',
  description: 'Web Development Services',
  amount: 50000, // $500.00 in cents
});

// Multiple line items
const multiInvoice = await createStripeInvoice.execute({
  customerEmail: 'customer@example.com',
  dueDate: '2026-03-15',
  currency: 'EUR',
  lineItems: JSON.stringify([
    { description: 'Design Services', amount: 30000 },
    { description: 'Development Services', amount: 70000 },
    { description: 'Hosting (Monthly)', amount: 5000 },
  ]),
});

console.log(invoice.invoiceUrl); // Link to hosted invoice page
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| createStripeInvoice | Create and send a Stripe invoice with support for single or multiple line items |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| customerEmail | string | Yes | Email address of the customer to invoice |
| dueDate | string | Yes | Invoice due date in YYYY-MM-DD format |
| currency | string | No | Three-letter currency code: USD, EUR, GBP, or JPY (default: USD) |
| description | string | No | Description for a single line item (use with amount) |
| amount | number | No | Amount in smallest currency unit for a single line item (use with description) |
| lineItems | string | No | JSON array of line items: [{"description": "...", "amount": 1000}] |

## Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| invoiceId | string | Stripe invoice ID |
| invoiceNumber | string | Human-readable invoice number |
| invoiceUrl | string | URL to the hosted invoice payment page |
| invoicePdf | string | URL to download the invoice as PDF |
| status | string | Invoice status (e.g. "open", "sent") |
| total | number | Total amount in smallest currency unit |
| currency | string | Three-letter currency code |

## Tools

### createIssue

Create a new issue in a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| title | string | Yes | Issue title |
| body | string | No | Issue body in markdown |
| labels | string | No | Comma-separated label names (e.g., "bug,high-priority") |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| number | number | Issue number |
| title | string | Issue title |
| url | string | URL to the issue on GitHub |
| state | string | Issue state (open) |

### createPullRequest

Create a new pull request in a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| title | string | Yes | Pull request title |
| body | string | No | PR description in markdown |
| head | string | Yes | Source branch name containing changes |
| base | string | No | Target branch to merge into (default: "main") |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| number | number | Pull request number |
| title | string | Pull request title |
| url | string | URL to the PR on GitHub |
| state | string | PR state (open) |
| mergeable | boolean \| null | Whether the PR can be merged (null if not yet computed) |

### getRepoInfo

Get information about a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| name | string | Repository name |
| fullName | string | Full name (owner/repo) |
| description | string \| null | Repository description |
| stars | number | Stargazer count |
| forks | number | Fork count |
| openIssues | number | Open issue count |
| language | string \| null | Primary programming language |
| defaultBranch | string | Default branch name |
| url | string | URL to the repository on GitHub |

### listPullRequests

List pull requests in a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| state | string | No | Filter: "open", "closed", or "all" (default: "open") |
| perPage | number | No | Results per page (1-100, default: 10) |

#### Output

Array of pull request objects:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| number | number | Pull request number |
| title | string | Pull request title |
| state | string | PR state (open/closed) |
| user | string | Username of the PR author |
| createdAt | string | ISO 8601 creation timestamp |
| url | string | URL to the PR on GitHub |

### getFileContent

Get the content of a file from a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| path | string | Yes | File path in the repository (e.g., "src/index.ts") |
| ref | string | No | Branch, tag, or commit SHA (default: default branch) |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| name | string | File name |
| path | string | File path in the repository |
| content | string | Decoded file content |
| size | number | File size in bytes |
| sha | string | Git blob SHA |
| url | string | URL to the file on GitHub |

### listCommits

List recent commits in a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| perPage | number | No | Number of commits (1-100, default: 10) |
| sha | string | No | Branch name or commit SHA to list from |

#### Output

Array of commit objects:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| sha | string | Full commit SHA |
| message | string | Commit message |
| author | string | Author name |
| date | string | ISO 8601 commit date |
| url | string | URL to the commit on GitHub |

## Tool 1: agnt-unsplash

**Directory:** agnt-unsplash/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-unsplash
**Description:** Search and retrieve photos from Unsplash. Requires UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** research

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "searchPhotos", "description": "Search for photos on Unsplash by keyword query."},
  {"name": "getRandomPhoto", "description": "Get a random photo from Unsplash, optionally filtered by query."},
  {"name": "getPhoto", "description": "Get detailed information about a specific Unsplash photo by ID."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
Three tools in one package:

### searchPhotos
- Env var: `UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY`
- Parameters:
  - `query` (string, required) - Search query
  - `page` (number, optional) - Page number (default 1)
  - `perPage` (number, optional) - Results per page (1-30, default 10)
  - `orientation` (string, optional) - landscape, portrait, squarish
  - `orderBy` (string, optional) - latest, relevant (default relevant)
- GET `https://api.unsplash.com/search/photos` with `Authorization: Client-ID {key}`
- Returns `{totalResults, totalPages, results: [{id, description, urls: {raw, full, regular, small, thumb}, width, height, user: {name, username}, links}]}`

### getRandomPhoto
- Parameters:
  - `query` (string, optional) - Topic/keyword filter
  - `orientation` (string, optional) - landscape, portrait, squarish
  - `count` (number, optional) - Number of photos (1-30, default 1)
- GET `https://api.unsplash.com/photos/random`
- Returns photo object(s) with same structure

### getPhoto
- Parameters:
  - `photoId` (string, required) - Photo ID
- GET `https://api.unsplash.com/photos/{photoId}`
- Returns single photo with full details

## Tool 2: agnt-firecrawl

**Directory:** agnt-firecrawl/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-firecrawl
**Description:** Scrape web content using Firecrawl API. Requires FIRECRAWL_API_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** web

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[{"name": "firecrawlScrape", "description": "Scrape a URL and extract content as markdown or HTML using Firecrawl."}]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Tool name: `firecrawlScrape`
- Env var: `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY`
- Parameters:
  - `url` (string, required) - URL to scrape
  - `format` (string, optional) - "markdown" or "html" (default "markdown")
- POST to `https://api.firecrawl.dev/v1/scrape` with `Authorization: Bearer {key}`, body `{url, formats: [format]}`
- Returns `{success, content, title, url, statusCode}`

## Tool 3: agnt-zapier-webhook

**Directory:** agnt-zapier-webhook/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-zapier-webhook
**Description:** Trigger Zapier automations by sending data to Zap webhook URLs. Connect to 6000+ apps.
**Category:** ops

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[{"name": "triggerZapierWebhook", "description": "Send JSON data to a Zapier webhook URL to trigger Zap automations."}]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Tool name: `triggerZapierWebhook`
- No env vars needed (webhook URL is per-request)
- Parameters:
  - `webhookUrl` (string, required) - Zapier "Catch Hook" webhook URL
  - `payload` (string, required) - JSON data to send
- POST to the webhookUrl with parsed JSON payload
- Validates the URL starts with `https://hooks.zapier.com/`
- Returns `{success, status, response}`

## Tool 4: agnt-github

**Directory:** agnt-github/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-github
**Description:** Interact with GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, branches, and releases. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable.
**Category:** engineering

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "createIssue", "description": "Create a new issue in a GitHub repository."},
  {"name": "createPullRequest", "description": "Create a new pull request in a GitHub repository."},
  {"name": "getRepoInfo", "description": "Get information about a GitHub repository."},
  {"name": "listPullRequests", "description": "List pull requests in a GitHub repository."},
  {"name": "getFileContent", "description": "Get the content of a file from a GitHub repository."},
  {"name": "listCommits", "description": "List recent commits in a GitHub repository."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `GITHUB_TOKEN`
- Base URL: `https://api.github.com`
- Auth header: `Authorization: Bearer {token}`
- Shared helper: `async function githubRequest<T>(method, path, body?)` that handles errors, 404s, rate limits

### createIssue
- Parameters: `owner` (string, required), `repo` (string, required), `title` (string, required), `body` (string, optional), `labels` (string, optional - comma-separated)
- POST `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues`
- Returns `{number, title, url, state}`

### createPullRequest
- Parameters: `owner`, `repo`, `title`, `body`, `head` (source branch), `base` (target branch, default "main")
- POST `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls`
- Returns `{number, title, url, state, mergeable}`

### getRepoInfo
- Parameters: `owner`, `repo`
- GET `/repos/{owner}/{repo}`
- Returns `{name, fullName, description, stars, forks, openIssues, language, defaultBranch, url}`

### listPullRequests
- Parameters: `owner`, `repo`, `state` (open/closed/all, default open), `perPage` (number, default 10)
- GET `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls`
- Returns array of `{number, title, state, user, createdAt, url}`

### getFileContent
- Parameters: `owner`, `repo`, `path`, `ref` (branch/tag, optional)
- GET `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}`
- Decodes base64 content
- Returns `{name, path, content, size, sha, url}`

### listCommits
- Parameters: `owner`, `repo`, `perPage` (default 10), `sha` (branch, optional)
- GET `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits`
- Returns array of `{sha, message, author, date, url}`

    16→function getApiKey(): string {

    26→async function apiRequest<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    27→  const key = getApiKey();
    28→
    29→  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    30→    Authorization: `Bot ${key}`,
    31→    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    32→  };
    33→
    34→  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
    35→  if (body !== undefined) {
    36→    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, options);
    40→
    41→  if (!response.ok) {
    42→    await handleApiError(response);
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (response.status === 204) {
    46→    return { success: true } as T;

    48→
    49→  const text = await response.text();

    51→    return {} as T;

    53→
    54→  return JSON.parse(text) as T;

    58→  let errorMessage: string;
    59→  try {
    60→    const errorData = (await response.json()) as { message?: string; code?: number };
    61→    errorMessage = errorData.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    62→    if (errorData.code) {
    63→      errorMessage = `${errorMessage} (Discord Error Code: ${errorData.code})`;
    64→    }

    66→    errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  switch (response.status) {
    70→    case 400:
    71→      throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
    72→    case 401:
    73→      throw new Error('Authentication failed: Invalid Discord bot token. Check DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.');

    80→    default:
    81→      throw new Error(`Discord API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);

    83→}

    85→function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>): string {

    90→  return (

import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';

const BASE_URL = 'https://api.unsplash.com';

// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getApiKey(): string {
  const key = process.env.UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY;
  if (!key) {
    throw new Error(
      'UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY environment variable is required. Get your access key from https://unsplash.com/developers'
    );
  }
  return key;
}

async function unsplashRequest<T>(method: string, path: string): Promise<T> {
  const key = getApiKey();

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Client-ID ${key}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  };

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, { method, headers });

  if (!response.ok) {
    await handleApiError(response);
  }

  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) {
    return {} as T;
  }

  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

async function handleApiError(response: Response): Promise<never> {
  let errorMessage: string;
  try {
    const errorData = (await response.json()) as { errors?: string[] };
    errorMessage = errorData.errors?.join(', ') || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
  } catch {
    errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
  }

  switch (response.status) {
    case 401:
      throw new Error(
        'Authentication failed: Invalid Unsplash access key. Check UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY.'
      );
    case 403:
      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded or access forbidden: ${errorMessage}`);
    case 404:
      throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}`);
    case 429:
      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
    default:
      throw new Error(`Unsplash API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
  }
}

function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(params).filter(
    ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''
  );
  if (entries.length === 0) return '';
  return (
    '?' +
    entries.map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`).join('&')
  );
}

  inputSchema: jsonSchema<SearchPhotosInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      query: { type: 'string', description: 'Search query to find photos.' },
      page: { type: 'number', description: 'Page number for pagination (default: 1).' },
      perPage: {
        type: 'number',
        description: 'Number of results per page (1-30, default: 10).',

      },
      orderBy: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Sort order: "latest" or "relevant" (default: "relevant").',
      },
    },
    required: ['query'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: SearchPhotosInput): Promise<SearchPhotosResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.query || input.query.trim() === '') {
        throw new Error('query is required and must be non-empty');
      }
      if (input.perPage !== undefined && (input.perPage < 1 || input.perPage > 30)) {
        throw new Error('perPage must be between 1 and 30');
      }
      if (
        input.orientation !== undefined &&
        !['landscape', 'portrait', 'squarish'].includes(input.orientation)

      if (input.orderBy !== undefined && !['latest', 'relevant'].includes(input.orderBy)) {

      }

      const qs = buildQueryString({
        query: input.query,
        page: input.page,
        per_page: input.perPage,
        orientation: input.orientation,
        order_by: input.orderBy,
      });

      const data = await unsplashRequest<UnsplashSearchResponse>('GET', `/search/photos${qs}`);

      return {
        totalResults: data.total,
        totalPages: data.total_pages,
        results: data.results.map((photo) => ({

          description: photo.description,
          alt_description: photo.alt_description,
          urls: photo.urls,
          width: photo.width,
          height: photo.height,

          links: photo.links,

import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';

const BASE_URL = 'https://api.github.com';

// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getApiKey(): string {
  const key = process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN;
  if (!key) {
    throw new Error(
      'GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable is required. Create a personal access token at https://github.com/settings/tokens'
    );
  }
  return key;
}

async function githubRequest<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const key = getApiKey();

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,
    Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28',
  };

  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
  if (body !== undefined) {
    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    await handleApiError(response);
  }

  if (response.status === 204) {
    return { success: true } as T;
  }

  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) {
    return {} as T;
  }

  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

async function handleApiError(response: Response): Promise<never> {
  let errorMessage: string;
  try {
    const errorData = (await response.json()) as {
      message?: string;
      documentation_url?: string;
    };
    errorMessage = errorData.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
  } catch {
    errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
  }

  switch (response.status) {
    case 401:
      throw new Error(
        'Authentication failed: Invalid GitHub token. Check GITHUB_TOKEN.'
      );
    case 403:
      throw new Error(
        `Access forbidden or rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}. Check token permissions.`
      );
    case 404:
      throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}. Verify the repository, owner, and path exist.`);
    case 422:
      throw new Error(`Validation error: ${errorMessage}`);
    case 429:
      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
    default:
      throw new Error(`GitHub API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
  }
}

function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(params).filter(
    ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''
  );
  if (entries.length === 0) return '';
  return (
    '?' +
    entries.map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`).join('&')
  );
}

export const createIssue = tool({
  description:
    'Create a new issue in a GitHub repository. Optionally include a body description and comma-separated labels.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<CreateIssueInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      owner: { type: 'string', description: 'The owner (user or organization) of the repository.' },
      repo: { type: 'string', description: 'The repository name.' },
      title: { type: 'string', description: 'The title of the issue.' },
      body: { type: 'string', description: 'The body content of the issue in markdown.' },
      labels: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Comma-separated list of label names to apply (e.g., "bug,high-priority").',
      },
    },
    required: ['owner', 'repo', 'title'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: CreateIssueInput): Promise<CreateIssueResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.owner || !input.repo || !input.title) {
        throw new Error('owner, repo, and title are required and must be non-empty');
      }

      const requestBody: { title: string; body?: string; labels?: string[] } = {
        title: input.title,
      };
      if (input.body) {
        requestBody.body = input.body;
      }
      if (input.labels) {
        requestBody.labels = input.labels.split(',').map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      }

      const data = await githubRequest<GitHubIssueResponse>(
        'POST',
        `/repos/${input.owner}/${input.repo}/issues`,
        requestBody
      );

      return {
        number: data.number,
        title: data.title,
        url: data.html_url,
        state: data.state,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to create issue: ${(error as Error).message}`);

  },

      } else {
        decodedContent = data.content ?? '';
      }

      return {
        name: data.name,
        path: data.path,
        content: decodedContent,
        size: data.size,
        sha: data.sha,
        url: data.html_url,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to get file content: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  },
});

// ─── listCommits ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ListCommitsInput {
  owner: string;
  repo: string;
  perPage?: number;
  sha?: string;
}

export const listCommits = tool({
  description:
    'List recent commits in a GitHub repository. Optionally filter by branch or limit the number of results.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<ListCommitsInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      owner: { type: 'string', description: 'The owner (user or organization) of the repository.' },
      repo: { type: 'string', description: 'The repository name.' },
      perPage: {
        type: 'number',
        description: 'Number of commits to return (1-100, default: 10).',
      },
      sha: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'Branch name or commit SHA to list commits from (default: repository default branch).',
      },
    },
    required: ['owner', 'repo'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: ListCommitsInput): Promise<CommitSummary[]> {
    try {
      if (!input.owner || !input.repo) {
        throw new Error('owner and repo are required and must be non-empty');
      }
      if (input.perPage !== undefined && (input.perPage < 1 || input.perPage > 100)) {
        throw new Error('perPage must be between 1 and 100');
      }

      const qs = buildQueryString({
        per_page: input.perPage ?? 10,
        sha: input.sha,
      });

      const data = await githubRequest<GitHubCommitListItem[]>(
        'GET',
        `/repos/${input.owner}/${input.repo}/commits${qs}`
      );

      return data.map((commit) => ({
        sha: commit.sha,
        message: commit.commit.message,
        author: commit.commit.author?.name ?? 'unknown',
        date: commit.commit.author?.date ?? '',
        url: commit.html_url,
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to list commits: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  },
});

};

Search and retrieve photos from Unsplash. Requires UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY environment variable.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-unsplash
```

## Setup

Set the `UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY` environment variable. Get your access key from the [Unsplash Developer Portal](https://unsplash.com/developers).

## Usage

```typescript
import { searchPhotos, getRandomPhoto, getPhoto } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-unsplash';

const results = await searchPhotos.execute({ query: 'mountain sunset' });
const random = await getRandomPhoto.execute({ query: 'nature', count: 3 });
const photo = await getPhoto.execute({ photoId: 'abc123' });
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| searchPhotos | Search for photos on Unsplash by keyword query |
| getRandomPhoto | Get random photos, optionally filtered by query |
| getPhoto | Get detailed info about a specific photo by ID |

### searchPhotos

Search for photos on Unsplash by keyword query.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| query | string | Yes | Search query to find photos |
| page | number | No | Page number for pagination (default: 1) |
| perPage | number | No | Results per page (1-30, default: 10) |
| orientation | string | No | Filter: "landscape", "portrait", or "squarish" |
| orderBy | string | No | Sort: "latest" or "relevant" (default: "relevant") |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| totalResults | number | Total number of matching photos |
| totalPages | number | Total number of pages |
| results | array | Array of photo objects |
| results[].id | string | Photo ID |
| results[].description | string \| null | Photo description |
| results[].urls | object | Photo URLs (raw, full, regular, small, thumb) |
| results[].width | number | Photo width in pixels |
| results[].height | number | Photo height in pixels |
| results[].user | object | Photographer info (name, username) |
| results[].links | object | Photo links (self, html, download) |

### getRandomPhoto

Get one or more random photos from Unsplash.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| query | string | No | Topic or keyword to filter random photos |
| orientation | string | No | Filter: "landscape", "portrait", or "squarish" |
| count | number | No | Number of photos to return (1-30, default: 1) |

#### Output

Array of photo objects with: id, description, urls, width, height, user, links.

### getPhoto

Get detailed information about a specific photo by ID.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| photoId | string | Yes | The Unsplash photo ID |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| id | string | Photo ID |
| description | string \| null | Photo description |
| urls | object | Photo URLs (raw, full, regular, small, thumb) |
| width | number | Photo width in pixels |
| height | number | Photo height in pixels |
| user | object | Photographer info (name, username) |
| links | object | Photo links (self, html, download) |
| downloads | number | Total download count |
| likes | number | Total like count |
| views | number | Total view count |
| created_at | string | ISO 8601 creation timestamp |

{"parentUuid":"ca6d9414-bddb-454d-ab81-ac2886960dcc","isSidechain":true,"userType":"external","cwd":"/Users/ajaxdavis/repos/tpmjs/tpmjs/packages/tools/official","sessionId":"5dfd6189-dead-49c2-bf77-84247314695e","version":"2.1.44","gitBranch":"main","agentId":"a18d6d3","slug":"agile-bubbling-blum","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-6","id":"msg_01B1foVRxfSUQo9XDbXqs6ML","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018Hwkqy73MMwoWQ8rqTo65c","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/ajaxdavis/repos/tpmjs/tpmjs/packages/tools/official/agnt-github/README.md","content":"# @tpmjs/official-agnt-github

Interact with GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, branches, and releases. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-github
```

## Setup

Set the `GITHUB_TOKEN` environment variable. Create a personal access token at [GitHub Settings](https://github.com/settings/tokens).

Required token scopes: `repo` (for private repos), `public_repo` (for public repos only).

## Usage

```typescript
import { getRepoInfo, createIssue, listCommits } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-github';

const repo = await getRepoInfo.execute({ owner: 'facebook', repo: 'react' });
const issue = await createIssue.execute({ owner: 'myorg', repo: 'myrepo', title: 'Bug report' });
const commits = await listCommits.execute({ owner: 'facebook', repo: 'react', perPage: 5 });
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| createIssue | Create a new issue in a repository |
| createPullRequest | Create a new pull request |
| getRepoInfo | Get repository information |
| listPullRequests | List pull requests |
| getFileContent | Get file content from a repository |
| listCommits | List recent commits |

### createIssue

Create a new issue in a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| title | string | Yes | Issue title |
| body | string | No | Issue body in markdown |
| labels | string | No | Comma-separated label names (e.g., "bug,high-priority") |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| number | number | Issue number |
| title | string | Issue title |
| url | string | URL to the issue on GitHub |
| state | string | Issue state (open) |

### createPullRequest

Create a new pull request in a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| title | string | Yes | Pull request title |
| body | string | No | PR description in markdown |
| head | string | Yes | Source branch name containing changes |
| base | string | No | Target branch to merge into (default: "main") |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| number | number | Pull request number |
| title | string | Pull request title |
| url | string | URL to the PR on GitHub |
| state | string | PR state (open) |
| mergeable | boolean \| null | Whether the PR can be merged (null if not yet computed) |

### getRepoInfo

Get information about a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| name | string | Repository name |
| fullName | string | Full name (owner/repo) |
| description | string \| null | Repository description |
| stars | number | Stargazer count |
| forks | number | Fork count |
| openIssues | number | Open issue count |
| language | string \| null | Primary programming language |
| defaultBranch | string | Default branch name |
| url | string | URL to the repository on GitHub |

### listPullRequests

List pull requests in a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| state | string | No | Filter: "open", "closed", or "all" (default: "open") |
| perPage | number | No | Results per page (1-100, default: 10) |

#### Output

Array of pull request objects:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| number | number | Pull request number |
| title | string | Pull request title |
| state | string | PR state (open/closed) |
| user | string | Username of the PR author |
| createdAt | string | ISO 8601 creation timestamp |
| url | string | URL to the PR on GitHub |

### getFileContent

Get the content of a file from a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| path | string | Yes | File path in the repository (e.g., "src/index.ts") |
| ref | string | No | Branch, tag, or commit SHA (default: default branch) |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| name | string | File name |
| path | string | File path in the repository |
| content | string | Decoded file content |
| size | number | File size in bytes |
| sha | string | Git blob SHA |
| url | string | URL to the file on GitHub |

### listCommits

List recent commits in a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| perPage | number | No | Number of commits (1-100, default: 10) |
| sha | string | No | Branch name or commit SHA to list from |

#### Output

Array of commit objects:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| sha | string | Full commit SHA |
| message | string | Commit message |
| author | string | Author name |
| date | string | ISO 8601 commit date |
| url | string | URL to the commit on GitHub |

Follow these EXACT patterns from the existing discord tool:
- Use `import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';` 
- Use `inputSchema: jsonSchema<Type>({...})` (NOT `parameters:`)
- Export each tool as both named export AND include in default export object
- Export all interfaces
- `additionalProperties: false` on all schemas
- Description on every property
- Try-catch with descriptive errors in every execute function
- Get API keys from environment variables with clear error messages

## Tool 1: agnt-unsplash

**Directory:** agnt-unsplash/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-unsplash
**Description:** Search and retrieve photos from Unsplash. Requires UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** research

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "searchPhotos", "description": "Search for photos on Unsplash by keyword query."},
  {"name": "getRandomPhoto", "description": "Get a random photo from Unsplash, optionally filtered by query."},
  {"name": "getPhoto", "description": "Get detailed information about a specific Unsplash photo by ID."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
Three tools in one package:

### searchPhotos
- Env var: `UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY`
- Parameters:
  - `query` (string, required) - Search query
  - `page` (number, optional) - Page number (default 1)
  - `perPage` (number, optional) - Results per page (1-30, default 10)
  - `orientation` (string, optional) - landscape, portrait, squarish
  - `orderBy` (string, optional) - latest, relevant (default relevant)
- GET `https://api.unsplash.com/search/photos` with `Authorization: Client-ID {key}`
- Returns `{totalResults, totalPages, results: [{id, description, urls: {raw, full, regular, small, thumb}, width, height, user: {name, username}, links}]}`

### getRandomPhoto
- Parameters:
  - `query` (string, optional) - Topic/keyword filter
  - `orientation` (string, optional) - landscape, portrait, squarish
  - `count` (number, optional) - Number of photos (1-30, default 1)
- GET `https://api.unsplash.com/photos/random`
- Returns photo object(s) with same structure

### getPhoto
- Parameters:
  - `photoId` (string, required) - Photo ID
- GET `https://api.unsplash.com/photos/{photoId}`
- Returns single photo with full details

---

## Tool 2: agnt-firecrawl

**Directory:** agnt-firecrawl/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-firecrawl
**Description:** Scrape web content using Firecrawl API. Requires FIRECRAWL_API_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** web

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[{"name": "firecrawlScrape", "description": "Scrape a URL and extract content as markdown or HTML using Firecrawl."}]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Tool name: `firecrawlScrape`
- Env var: `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY`
- Parameters:
  - `url` (string, required) - URL to scrape
  - `format` (string, optional) - "markdown" or "html" (default "markdown")
- POST to `https://api.firecrawl.dev/v1/scrape` with `Authorization: Bearer {key}`, body `{url, formats: [format]}`
- Returns `{success, content, title, url, statusCode}`

---

## Tool 3: agnt-zapier-webhook

**Directory:** agnt-zapier-webhook/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-zapier-webhook
**Description:** Trigger Zapier automations by sending data to Zap webhook URLs. Connect to 6000+ apps.
**Category:** ops

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[{"name": "triggerZapierWebhook", "description": "Send JSON data to a Zapier webhook URL to trigger Zap automations."}]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Tool name: `triggerZapierWebhook`
- No env vars needed (webhook URL is per-request)
- Parameters:
  - `webhookUrl` (string, required) - Zapier "Catch Hook" webhook URL
  - `payload` (string, required) - JSON data to send
- POST to the webhookUrl with parsed JSON payload
- Validates the URL starts with `https://hooks.zapier.com/`
- Returns `{success, status, response}`

---

## Tool 4: agnt-github

**Directory:** agnt-github/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-github
**Description:** Interact with GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, branches, and releases. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable.
**Category:** engineering

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "createIssue", "description": "Create a new issue in a GitHub repository."},
  {"name": "createPullRequest", "description": "Create a new pull request in a GitHub repository."},
  {"name": "getRepoInfo", "description": "Get information about a GitHub repository."},
  {"name": "listPullRequests", "description": "List pull requests in a GitHub repository."},
  {"name": "getFileContent", "description": "Get the content of a file from a GitHub repository."},
  {"name": "listCommits", "description": "List recent commits in a GitHub repository."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `GITHUB_TOKEN`
- Base URL: `https://api.github.com`
- Auth header: `Authorization: Bearer {token}`
- Shared helper: `async function githubRequest<T>(method, path, body?)` that handles errors, 404s, rate limits

### createIssue
- Parameters: `owner` (string, required), `repo` (string, required), `title` (string, required), `body` (string, optional), `labels` (string, optional - comma-separated)
- POST `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues`
- Returns `{number, title, url, state}`

### createPullRequest
- Parameters: `owner`, `repo`, `title`, `body`, `head` (source branch), `base` (target branch, default "main")
- POST `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls`
- Returns `{number, title, url, state, mergeable}`

### getRepoInfo
- Parameters: `owner`, `repo`
- GET `/repos/{owner}/{repo}`
- Returns `{name, fullName, description, stars, forks, openIssues, language, defaultBranch, url}`

### listPullRequests
- Parameters: `owner`, `repo`, `state` (open/closed/all, default open), `perPage` (number, default 10)
- GET `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls`
- Returns array of `{number, title, state, user, createdAt, url}`

### getFileContent
- Parameters: `owner`, `repo`, `path`, `ref` (branch/tag, optional)
- GET `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}`
- Decodes base64 content
- Returns `{name, path, content, size, sha, url}`

### listCommits
- Parameters: `owner`, `repo`, `perPage` (default 10), `sha` (branch, optional)
- GET `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits`
- Returns array of `{sha, message, author, date, url}`

{"parentUuid":"f2a54dc3-3345-4379-8a94-bf44d0696ad6","isSidechain":true,"userType":"external","cwd":"/Users/ajaxdavis/repos/tpmjs/tpmjs/packages/tools/official","sessionId":"5dfd6189-dead-49c2-bf77-84247314695e","version":"2.1.44","gitBranch":"main","agentId":"a18d6d3","slug":"agile-bubbling-blum","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-6","id":"msg_01PngbJmWy9atcULPyUH2byR","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"REDACTED","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/ajaxdavis/repos/tpmjs/tpmjs/packages/tools/official/agnt-unsplash/src/index.ts","content":"/**

 *
 * Search and retrieve photos from the Unsplash API.

import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';

const BASE_URL = 'https://api.unsplash.com';

// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getApiKey(): string {
  const key = process.env.UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY;
  if (!key) {
    throw new Error(
      'UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY environment variable is required. Get your access key from https://unsplash.com/developers'
    );
  }
  return key;
}

async function unsplashRequest<T>(method: string, path: string): Promise<T> {
  const key = getApiKey();

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Client-ID ${key}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  };

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, { method, headers });

  if (!response.ok) {
    await handleApiError(response);
  }

  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) {
    return {} as T;
  }

  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

async function handleApiError(response: Response): Promise<never> {
  let errorMessage: string;
  try {
    const errorData = (await response.json()) as { errors?: string[] };
    errorMessage = errorData.errors?.join(', ') || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
  } catch {
    errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
  }

  switch (response.status) {
    case 401:
      throw new Error(
        'Authentication failed: Invalid Unsplash access key. Check UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY.'
      );
    case 403:
      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded or access forbidden: ${errorMessage}`);
    case 404:
      throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}`);
    case 429:
      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
    default:
      throw new Error(`Unsplash API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
  }
}

function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(params).filter(
    ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''
  );
  if (entries.length === 0) return '';
  return (
    '?' +
    entries.map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`).join('&')
  );
}

interface UnsplashSearchResponse {

  total_pages: number;
  results: UnsplashPhoto[];
}

// ─── searchPhotos ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface SearchPhotosInput {
  query: string;
  page?: number;
  perPage?: number;
  orientation?: string;
  orderBy?: string;
}

export const searchPhotos = tool({
  description:
    'Search for photos on Unsplash by keyword query. Returns photo URLs, dimensions, and photographer info.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<SearchPhotosInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      query: { type: 'string', description: 'Search query to find photos.' },
      page: { type: 'number', description: 'Page number for pagination (default: 1).' },
      perPage: {
        type: 'number',
        description: 'Number of results per page (1-30, default: 10).',
      },
      orientation: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Photo orientation filter: "landscape", "portrait", or "squarish".',
      },
      orderBy: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Sort order: "latest" or "relevant" (default: "relevant").',
      },
    },
    required: ['query'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: SearchPhotosInput): Promise<SearchPhotosResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.query || input.query.trim() === '') {
        throw new Error('query is required and must be non-empty');
      }
      if (input.perPage !== undefined && (input.perPage < 1 || input.perPage > 30)) {
        throw new Error('perPage must be between 1 and 30');
      }
      if (
        input.orientation !== undefined &&
        !['landscape', 'portrait', 'squarish'].includes(input.orientation)
      ) {
        throw new Error('orientation must be "landscape", "portrait", or "squarish"');
      }
      if (input.orderBy !== undefined && !['latest', 'relevant'].includes(input.orderBy)) {
        throw new Error('orderBy must be "latest" or "relevant"');
      }

      const qs = buildQueryString({
        query: input.query,
        page: input.page,
        per_page: input.perPage,
        orientation: input.orientation,
        order_by: input.orderBy,
      });

      const data = await unsplashRequest<UnsplashSearchResponse>('GET', `/search/photos${qs}`);

      return {
        totalResults: data.total,
        totalPages: data.total_pages,
        results: data.results.map((photo) => ({
          id: photo.id,
          description: photo.description,
          alt_description: photo.alt_description,
          urls: photo.urls,
          width: photo.width,
          height: photo.height,
          user: { name: photo.user.name, username: photo.user.username },
          links: photo.links,
        })),
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to search photos: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  },
});

}

export const getRandomPhoto = tool({
  description:
    'Get one or more random photos from Unsplash, optionally filtered by a keyword query or orientation.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<GetRandomPhotoInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      query: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional topic or keyword to filter random photos.' },
      orientation: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Photo orientation filter: "landscape", "portrait", or "squarish".',
      },
      count: {
        type: 'number',
        description: 'Number of random photos to return (1-30, default: 1).',
      },
    },
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: GetRandomPhotoInput): Promise<UnsplashPhoto[]> {
    try {
      if (input.count !== undefined && (input.count < 1 || input.count > 30)) {
        throw new Error('count must be between 1 and 30');
      }
      if (
        input.orientation !== undefined &&
        !['landscape', 'portrait', 'squarish'].includes(input.orientation)
      ) {
        throw new Error('orientation must be "landscape", "portrait", or "squarish"');
      }

      const qs = buildQueryString({
        query: input.query,
        orientation: input.orientation,
        count: input.count ?? 1,
      });

      const data = await unsplashRequest<UnsplashPhoto | UnsplashPhoto[]>(
        'GET',
        `/photos/random${qs}`
      );

      // Unsplash returns a single object when count=1, array otherwise
      const photos = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [data];

      return photos.map((photo) => ({
        id: photo.id,
        description: photo.description,
        alt_description: photo.alt_description,
        urls: photo.urls,
        width: photo.width,
        height: photo.height,
        user: { name: photo.user.name, username: photo.user.username },
        links: photo.links,
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to get random photo: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  },
});

// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getApiKey(): string {
  const key = process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN;
  if (!key) {
    throw new Error(
      'GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable is required. Create a personal access token at https://github.com/settings/tokens'
    );
  }
  return key;
}

async function githubRequest<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const key = getApiKey();

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,
    Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28',
  };

  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
  if (body !== undefined) {

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    await handleApiError(response);
  }

  if (response.status === 204) {
    return { success: true } as T;
  }

  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) {
    return {} as T;
  }

  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

async function handleApiError(response: Response): Promise<never> {
  let errorMessage: string;
  try {
    const errorData = (await response.json()) as {
      message?: string;
      documentation_url?: string;
    };
    errorMessage = errorData.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
  } catch {
    errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
  }

  switch (response.status) {
    case 401:
      throw new Error(
        'Authentication failed: Invalid GitHub token. Check GITHUB_TOKEN.'
      );
    case 403:
      throw new Error(
        `Access forbidden or rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}. Check token permissions.`
      );
    case 404:
      throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}. Verify the repository, owner, and path exist.`);
    case 422:
      throw new Error(`Validation error: ${errorMessage}`);
    case 429:
      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
    default:
      throw new Error(`GitHub API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
  }
}

function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(params).filter(
    ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''
  );
  if (entries.length === 0) return '';
  return (
    '?' +
    entries.map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`).join('&')
  );
}

  description:
    'List pull requests in a GitHub repository. Filter by state (open, closed, or all) and limit the number of results.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<ListPullRequestsInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      owner: { type: 'string', description: 'The owner (user or organization) of the repository.' },

        type: 'string',

  async execute(input: ListPullRequestsInput): Promise<PullRequestSummary[]> {

      if (!input.owner || !input.repo) {

      if (input.state !== undefined && !['open', 'closed', 'all'].includes(input.state)) {

      }
      if (input.perPage !== undefined && (input.perPage < 1 || input.perPage > 100)) {
        throw new Error('perPage must be between 1 and 100');
      }

      const qs = buildQueryString({
        state: input.state ?? 'open',
        per_page: input.perPage ?? 10,
      });

      const data = await githubRequest<GitHubPullListItem[]>(
        'GET',
        `/repos/${input.owner}/${input.repo}/pulls${qs}`
      );

      return data.map((pr) => ({
        number: pr.number,
        title: pr.title,
        state: pr.state,
        user: pr.user?.login ?? 'unknown',
        createdAt: pr.created_at,
        url: pr.html_url,

export interface GetFileContentInput {

  path: string;

}

export const getFileContent = tool({
  description:
    'Get the content of a file from a GitHub repository. Optionally specify a branch or tag ref.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<GetFileContentInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      owner: { type: 'string', description: 'The owner (user or organization) of the repository.' },
      repo: { type: 'string', description: 'The repository name.' },
      path: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'The file path within the repository (e.g., "src/index.ts").',
      },
      ref: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'The branch name, tag, or commit SHA to read the file from (default: repository default branch).',
      },
    },
    required: ['owner', 'repo', 'path'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: GetFileContentInput): Promise<FileContentResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.owner || !input.repo || !input.path) {
        throw new Error('owner, repo, and path are required and must be non-empty');
      }

      const qs = buildQueryString({ ref: input.ref });

      const data = await githubRequest<GitHubContentResponse>(
        'GET',
        `/repos/${input.owner}/${input.repo}/contents/${input.path}${qs}`
      );

      // Decode base64 content
      let decodedContent: string;
      if (data.encoding === 'base64' && data.content) {
        // Remove newlines that GitHub inserts in base64 content
        const cleanBase64 = data.content.replace(/\n/g, '');
        decodedContent = atob(cleanBase64);
      } else {
        decodedContent = data.content ?? '';
      }

      return {
        name: data.name,
        path: data.path,
        content: decodedContent,
        size: data.size,
        sha: data.sha,
        url: data.html_url,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to get file content: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  },
});

Search and retrieve photos from Unsplash. Requires UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY environment variable.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-unsplash
```

## Setup

Set the `UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY` environment variable. Get your access key from the [Unsplash Developer Portal](https://unsplash.com/developers).

## Usage

```typescript
import { searchPhotos, getRandomPhoto, getPhoto } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-unsplash';

const results = await searchPhotos.execute({ query: 'mountain sunset' });
const random = await getRandomPhoto.execute({ query: 'nature', count: 3 });
const photo = await getPhoto.execute({ photoId: 'abc123' });
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| searchPhotos | Search for photos on Unsplash by keyword query |
| getRandomPhoto | Get random photos, optionally filtered by query |
| getPhoto | Get detailed info about a specific photo by ID |

### searchPhotos

Search for photos on Unsplash by keyword query.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| query | string | Yes | Search query to find photos |
| page | number | No | Page number for pagination (default: 1) |
| perPage | number | No | Results per page (1-30, default: 10) |
| orientation | string | No | Filter: "landscape", "portrait", or "squarish" |
| orderBy | string | No | Sort: "latest" or "relevant" (default: "relevant") |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| totalResults | number | Total number of matching photos |
| totalPages | number | Total number of pages |
| results | array | Array of photo objects |
| results[].id | string | Photo ID |
| results[].description | string \| null | Photo description |
| results[].urls | object | Photo URLs (raw, full, regular, small, thumb) |
| results[].width | number | Photo width in pixels |
| results[].height | number | Photo height in pixels |
| results[].user | object | Photographer info (name, username) |
| results[].links | object | Photo links (self, html, download) |

### getRandomPhoto

Get one or more random photos from Unsplash.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| query | string | No | Topic or keyword to filter random photos |
| orientation | string | No | Filter: "landscape", "portrait", or "squarish" |
| count | number | No | Number of photos to return (1-30, default: 1) |

#### Output

Array of photo objects with: id, description, urls, width, height, user, links.

### getPhoto

Get detailed information about a specific photo by ID.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| photoId | string | Yes | The Unsplash photo ID |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| id | string | Photo ID |
| description | string \| null | Photo description |
| urls | object | Photo URLs (raw, full, regular, small, thumb) |
| width | number | Photo width in pixels |
| height | number | Photo height in pixels |
| user | object | Photographer info (name, username) |
| links | object | Photo links (self, html, download) |
| downloads | number | Total download count |
| likes | number | Total like count |
| views | number | Total view count |
| created_at | string | ISO 8601 creation timestamp |
