Interact with GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, branches, and releases. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-github
```

## Setup

Set the `GITHUB_TOKEN` environment variable. Create a personal access token at [GitHub Settings](https://github.com/settings/tokens).

Required token scopes: `repo` (for private repos), `public_repo` (for public repos only).

## Usage

```typescript
import { getRepoInfo, createIssue, listCommits } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-github';

const repo = await getRepoInfo.execute({ owner: 'facebook', repo: 'react' });
const issue = await createIssue.execute({ owner: 'myorg', repo: 'myrepo', title: 'Bug report' });
const commits = await listCommits.execute({ owner: 'facebook', repo: 'react', perPage: 5 });
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| createIssue | Create a new issue in a repository |
| createPullRequest | Create a new pull request |
| getRepoInfo | Get repository information |
| listPullRequests | List pull requests |
| getFileContent | Get file content from a repository |
| listCommits | List recent commits |

### createIssue

Create a new issue in a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| title | string | Yes | Issue title |
| body | string | No | Issue body in markdown |
| labels | string | No | Comma-separated label names (e.g., "bug,high-priority") |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| number | number | Issue number |
| title | string | Issue title |
| url | string | URL to the issue on GitHub |
| state | string | Issue state (open) |

### createPullRequest

Create a new pull request in a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| title | string | Yes | Pull request title |
| body | string | No | PR description in markdown |
| head | string | Yes | Source branch name containing changes |
| base | string | No | Target branch to merge into (default: "main") |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| number | number | Pull request number |
| title | string | Pull request title |
| url | string | URL to the PR on GitHub |
| state | string | PR state (open) |
| mergeable | boolean \| null | Whether the PR can be merged (null if not yet computed) |

### getRepoInfo

Get information about a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| name | string | Repository name |
| fullName | string | Full name (owner/repo) |
| description | string \| null | Repository description |
| stars | number | Stargazer count |
| forks | number | Fork count |
| openIssues | number | Open issue count |
| language | string \| null | Primary programming language |
| defaultBranch | string | Default branch name |
| url | string | URL to the repository on GitHub |

### listPullRequests

List pull requests in a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| state | string | No | Filter: "open", "closed", or "all" (default: "open") |
| perPage | number | No | Results per page (1-100, default: 10) |

#### Output

Array of pull request objects:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| number | number | Pull request number |
| title | string | Pull request title |
| state | string | PR state (open/closed) |
| user | string | Username of the PR author |
| createdAt | string | ISO 8601 creation timestamp |
| url | string | URL to the PR on GitHub |

### getFileContent

Get the content of a file from a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| path | string | Yes | File path in the repository (e.g., "src/index.ts") |
| ref | string | No | Branch, tag, or commit SHA (default: default branch) |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| name | string | File name |
| path | string | File path in the repository |
| content | string | Decoded file content |
| size | number | File size in bytes |
| sha | string | Git blob SHA |
| url | string | URL to the file on GitHub |

### listCommits

List recent commits in a GitHub repository.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| owner | string | Yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| repo | string | Yes | Repository name |
| perPage | number | No | Number of commits (1-100, default: 10) |
| sha | string | No | Branch name or commit SHA to list from |

#### Output

Array of commit objects:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| sha | string | Full commit SHA |
| message | string | Commit message |
| author | string | Author name |
| date | string | ISO 8601 commit date |
| url | string | URL to the commit on GitHub |

import { postTweet, searchTweets, getUserProfile, getUserTweets } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-twitter';

Search videos, get video details, list channel videos, and retrieve transcriptions from YouTube. Built for AI agents using the Vercel AI SDK.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-youtube
```

## Setup

Set the `YOUTUBE_API_KEY` environment variable to your YouTube Data API v3 key.

1. Go to [Google Cloud Console Credentials](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials).
2. Create an API key.
3. Enable the YouTube Data API v3 in your project.

```bash
export YOUTUBE_API_KEY='AIza...'
```

## Usage

```typescript
import { searchVideos, getVideoDetails, listChannelVideos, getTranscript } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-youtube';

// List channel videos

```

|-------|------|-------------|

| channelTitle | string | The channel name. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| results | array | Array of videos with videoId, title, description, publishedAt, thumbnailUrl. |

### getTranscript

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|

## Tool 1: agnt-google-sheets

**Directory:** agnt-google-sheets/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-sheets
**Description:** Read, write, append, and clear Google Sheets data. Requires GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY or GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** data

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "readSheet", "description": "Read data from a Google Sheets range."},
  {"name": "writeSheet", "description": "Write data to a Google Sheets range."},
  {"name": "appendSheet", "description": "Append rows to a Google Sheet."},
  {"name": "clearSheet", "description": "Clear data from a Google Sheets range."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` (JSON string of service account credentials) — parse it to get `client_email` and `private_key`, then create a JWT to get an access token from `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token` with scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets`
- Base URL: `https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets`
- Shared helper: `async function getAccessToken()` and `async function sheetsRequest<T>(method, path, body?)`

Helper for JWT: Create a JWT with header `{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT"}`, payload `{"iss": client_email, "scope": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets", "aud": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", "exp": now+3600, "iat": now}`. Sign with the private key using Node's `crypto.createSign('RSA-SHA256')`. Then exchange for access token via POST to `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token` with `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer&assertion={jwt}`.

### readSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:B5")
- GET `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}`
- Returns `{range, values: string[][], rowCount, columnCount}`

### writeSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required), `values` (string, required - JSON array of arrays)
- PUT `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED` with body `{values: parsed}`
- Returns `{updatedRange, updatedRows, updatedColumns, updatedCells}`

### appendSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required), `values` (string, required - JSON array of arrays)
- POST `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:append?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED` with body `{values: parsed}`
- Returns `{updatedRange, updatedRows, updatedColumns, updatedCells}`

### clearSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required)
- POST `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:clear`
- Returns `{clearedRange}`

## Tool 2: agnt-notion

**Directory:** agnt-notion/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-notion
**Description:** Interact with Notion databases, pages, and blocks. Requires NOTION_API_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** data

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "notionSearch", "description": "Search for pages and databases in Notion."},
  {"name": "notionQueryDatabase", "description": "Query a Notion database with optional filters and sorts."},
  {"name": "notionGetPage", "description": "Get the content of a Notion page."},
  {"name": "notionCreatePage", "description": "Create a new page in a Notion database or as a child of another page."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `NOTION_API_KEY`
- Base URL: `https://api.notion.com/v1`
- Headers: `Authorization: Bearer {key}`, `Notion-Version: 2022-06-28`, `Content-Type: application/json`
- Shared helper: `async function notionRequest<T>(method, path, body?)`

### notionSearch
- Parameters: `query` (string, required), `filter` (string, optional - "page" or "database"), `pageSize` (number, optional, default 10)
- POST `/search` with body `{query, filter: {property: "object", value: filter}, page_size}`
- Returns `{results: [{id, type, title, url, lastEdited}], hasMore, nextCursor}`

### notionQueryDatabase
- Parameters: `databaseId` (string, required), `filter` (string, optional - JSON filter object), `sorts` (string, optional - JSON sorts array), `pageSize` (number, optional, default 10)
- POST `/databases/{databaseId}/query` with parsed filter/sorts
- Returns `{results: [{id, properties, url, createdTime, lastEditedTime}], hasMore, nextCursor}`

### notionGetPage
- Parameters: `pageId` (string, required)
- GET `/pages/{pageId}` AND GET `/blocks/{pageId}/children`
- Returns `{id, properties, url, content: blocks[], createdTime, lastEditedTime}`

### notionCreatePage
- Parameters: `parentId` (string, required), `parentType` (string, optional - "database" or "page", default "database"), `title` (string, required), `properties` (string, optional - JSON properties object), `content` (string, optional - JSON array of blocks)
- POST `/pages` with appropriate parent structure
- Returns `{id, url, createdTime}`

## Tool 3: agnt-twitter

**Directory:** agnt-twitter/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-twitter
**Description:** Post tweets, search tweets, and manage Twitter/X profiles. Requires TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN for read operations and TWITTER_API_KEY, TWITTER_API_SECRET, TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN, TWITTER_ACCESS_SECRET for write operations.
**Category:** marketing

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "postTweet", "description": "Post a new tweet to Twitter/X."},
  {"name": "searchTweets", "description": "Search for tweets on Twitter/X."},
  {"name": "getUserProfile", "description": "Get a Twitter/X user's profile information."},
  {"name": "getUserTweets", "description": "Get recent tweets from a Twitter/X user."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- For read: `TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN` with `Authorization: Bearer {token}`
- For write: Need OAuth 1.0a signature using `TWITTER_API_KEY`, `TWITTER_API_SECRET`, `TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `TWITTER_ACCESS_SECRET`
- Base URL: `https://api.twitter.com/2`

For OAuth 1.0a signing (POST tweet):
Use Node's `crypto` module:
1. Create base string: `POST&{encoded_url}&{encoded_params}`
2. Create signing key: `{encoded_api_secret}&{encoded_access_secret}`
3. Create signature: HMAC-SHA1 of base string with signing key, then base64 encode
4. Build Authorization header: `OAuth oauth_consumer_key="...", oauth_nonce="...", oauth_signature="...", oauth_signature_method="HMAC-SHA1", oauth_timestamp="...", oauth_token="...", oauth_version="1.0"`

### postTweet
- Parameters: `text` (string, required, max 280 chars), `replyToId` (string, optional)
- POST `https://api.twitter.com/2/tweets` with OAuth 1.0a
- Returns `{tweetId, text, url}`

### searchTweets
- Parameters: `query` (string, required), `maxResults` (number, optional, 10-100, default 10), `sortOrder` (string, optional - "recency" or "relevancy")
- GET `/tweets/search/recent` with Bearer token
- Returns `{tweets: [{id, text, authorId, createdAt}], resultCount}`

### getUserProfile
- Parameters: `username` (string, required)
- GET `/users/by/username/{username}?user.fields=description,public_metrics,profile_image_url,created_at`
- Returns `{id, name, username, description, followers, following, tweetCount, profileImageUrl}`

### getUserTweets
- Parameters: `userId` (string, required), `maxResults` (number, optional, default 10)
- GET `/users/{userId}/tweets?max_results={maxResults}&tweet.fields=created_at,public_metrics`
- Returns `{tweets: [{id, text, createdAt, likes, retweets, replies}]}`

## Tool 4: agnt-youtube

**Directory:** agnt-youtube/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-youtube
**Description:** Search videos, get video details, list channel videos, and retrieve transcriptions from YouTube. Requires YOUTUBE_API_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** research

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "searchVideos", "description": "Search for videos on YouTube."},
  {"name": "getVideoDetails", "description": "Get detailed information about a YouTube video."},
  {"name": "listChannelVideos", "description": "List recent videos from a YouTube channel."},
  {"name": "getTranscript", "description": "Get the transcript/captions of a YouTube video."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `YOUTUBE_API_KEY`
- Base URL: `https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3`
- Auth: `?key={apiKey}` query parameter

### searchVideos
- Parameters: `query` (string, required), `maxResults` (number, optional, default 10)
- GET `/search?part=snippet&type=video&q={query}&maxResults={maxResults}&key={key}`
- Returns `{results: [{videoId, title, description, channelTitle, publishedAt, thumbnailUrl}], totalResults}`

### getVideoDetails
- Parameters: `videoId` (string, required) - Video ID (auto-extract from URLs like youtube.com/watch?v=XXX)
- GET `/videos?part=snippet,statistics,contentDetails&id={videoId}&key={key}`
- Returns `{title, description, channelTitle, publishedAt, viewCount, likeCount, commentCount, duration, thumbnailUrl}`

### listChannelVideos
- Parameters: `channelId` (string, required), `maxResults` (number, optional, default 10)
- GET `/search?part=snippet&channelId={channelId}&type=video&order=date&maxResults={maxResults}&key={key}`
- Returns `{results: [{videoId, title, description, publishedAt, thumbnailUrl}]}`

### getTranscript
- Parameters: `videoId` (string, required)

    34→  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
    35→  if (body !== undefined) {
    36→    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, options);
    40→
    41→  if (!response.ok) {
    42→    await handleApiError(response);
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (response.status === 204) {
    46→    return { success: true } as T;
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  const text = await response.text();
    50→  if (!text) {
    51→    return {} as T;
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
    55→}
    56→
    57→async function handleApiError(response: Response): Promise<never> {
    58→  let errorMessage: string;
    59→  try {
    60→    const errorData = (await response.json()) as { message?: string; code?: number };
    61→    errorMessage = errorData.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    62→    if (errorData.code) {
    63→      errorMessage = `${errorMessage} (Discord Error Code: ${errorData.code})`;
    64→    }
    65→  } catch {
    66→    errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  switch (response.status) {
    70→    case 400:
    71→      throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
    72→    case 401:
    73→      throw new Error('Authentication failed: Invalid Discord bot token. Check DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.');
    74→    case 403:
    75→      throw new Error(`Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}`);
    76→    case 404:
    77→      throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}`);
    78→    case 429:
    79→      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
    80→    default:
    81→      throw new Error(`Discord API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    82→  }
    83→}
    84→
    85→function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>): string {
    86→  const entries = Object.entries(params).filter(
    87→    ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''
    88→  );
    89→  if (entries.length === 0) return '';
    90→  return (
    91→    '?' +
    92→    entries.map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`).join('&')
    93→  );
    94→}

{"parentUuid":"31f75439-be47-474f-8858-a046c5ada9d3","isSidechain":true,"userType":"external","cwd":"/Users/ajaxdavis/repos/tpmjs/tpmjs/packages/tools/official","sessionId":"5dfd6189-dead-49c2-bf77-84247314695e","version":"2.1.44","gitBranch":"main","agentId":"acf78c2","slug":"agile-bubbling-blum","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-6","id":"msg_012EnRXBDQkQQ4CMRYp7tQKG","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"REDACTED","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/ajaxdavis/repos/tpmjs/tpmjs/packages/tools/official/agnt-google-sheets/src/index.ts","content":"/**
 * @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-sheets — Google Sheets Tools for AI Agents
 *
 * Read, write, append, and clear data in Google Sheets spreadsheets.
 *
 * @requires GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable (JSON string of service account credentials)
 */

import { createSign } from 'node:crypto';
import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';

const BASE_URL = 'https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets';

// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface ServiceAccountCredentials {
  client_email: string;
  private_key: string;
}

function getServiceAccountCredentials(): ServiceAccountCredentials {
  const raw = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY;
  if (!raw) {
    throw new Error(
      'GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable is required. Set it to the JSON string of your Google service account credentials. See https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs/creating-managing-service-account-keys'
    );
  }
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as ServiceAccountCredentials;
    if (!parsed.client_email || !parsed.private_key) {
      throw new Error('Missing client_email or private_key in credentials');
    }
    return parsed;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as Error).message.includes('Missing client_email')) {
      throw error;
    }
    throw new Error(
      'GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY must be a valid JSON string containing client_email and private_key'
    );
  }
}

function base64urlEncode(data: string | Buffer): string {
  const buf = typeof data === 'string' ? Buffer.from(data) : data;
  return buf.toString('base64').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
}

function createJwt(credentials: ServiceAccountCredentials): string {
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const header = { alg: 'RS256', typ: 'JWT' };
  const payload = {
    iss: credentials.client_email,
    scope: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets',
    aud: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
    exp: now + 3600,
    iat: now,
  };

  const encodedHeader = base64urlEncode(JSON.stringify(header));
  const encodedPayload = base64urlEncode(JSON.stringify(payload));
  const signatureInput = `${encodedHeader}.${encodedPayload}`;

  const signer = createSign('RSA-SHA256');
  signer.update(signatureInput);
  const signature = signer.sign(credentials.private_key);
  const encodedSignature = base64urlEncode(signature);

  return `${signatureInput}.${encodedSignature}`;
}

let cachedToken: { token: string; expiresAt: number } | null = null;

async function getAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
  if (cachedToken && Date.now() < cachedToken.expiresAt) {
    return cachedToken.token;
  }

  const credentials = getServiceAccountCredentials();
  const jwt = createJwt(credentials);

  const response = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
    body: `grant_type=${encodeURIComponent('urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer')}&assertion=${encodeURIComponent(jwt)}`,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorText = await response.text();
    throw new Error(`Failed to obtain access token: ${response.status} ${errorText}`);
  }

  const data = (await response.json()) as { access_token: string; expires_in: number };
  cachedToken = {
    token: data.access_token,
    expiresAt: Date.now() + (data.expires_in - 60) * 1000,
  };

  return cachedToken.token;
}

async function sheetsRequest<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const token = await getAccessToken();

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  };

  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
  if (body !== undefined) {
    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    let errorMessage: string;
    try {
      const errorData = (await response.json()) as { error?: { message?: string } };
      errorMessage = errorData.error?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    } catch {
      errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    }

    switch (response.status) {
      case 400:
        throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 401:
        throw new Error(
          'Authentication failed: Invalid or expired credentials. Check GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.'
        );
      case 403:
        throw new Error(
          `Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}. Ensure the service account has access to the spreadsheet.`
        );
      case 404:
        throw new Error(`Spreadsheet or range not found: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 429:
        throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
      default:
        throw new Error(`Google Sheets API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    }
  }

  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) {
    return {} as T;
  }

  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

export interface ReadSheetResult {
  range: string;
  values: string[][];
  rowCount: number;
  columnCount: number;
}

}

// ─── readSheet ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ReadSheetInput {
  spreadsheetId: string;
  range: string;
}

export const readSheet = tool({
  description:
    'Read data from a Google Sheets range. Returns the values as a 2D array of strings.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<ReadSheetInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      spreadsheetId: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'The ID of the spreadsheet to read from.',
      },
      range: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'The A1 notation range to read, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:B5" or "Sheet1" for the entire sheet.',
      },
    },
    required: ['spreadsheetId', 'range'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: ReadSheetInput): Promise<ReadSheetResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.spreadsheetId) {
        throw new Error('spreadsheetId is required and must be non-empty');
      }
      if (!input.range) {
        throw new Error('range is required and must be non-empty');
      }

      const encodedRange = encodeURIComponent(input.range);
      const data = await sheetsRequest<{ range: string; values?: string[][] }>(
        'GET',
        `/${input.spreadsheetId}/values/${encodedRange}`
      );

      const values = data.values || [];
      return {
        range: data.range || input.range,
        values,
        rowCount: values.length,
        columnCount: values.length > 0 ? Math.max(...values.map((row) => row.length)) : 0,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to read sheet: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  },
});

// ─── writeSheet ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface WriteSheetInput {
  spreadsheetId: string;
  range: string;
  values: string;
}

export const writeSheet = tool({
  description:
    'Write data to a Google Sheets range. Overwrites existing data in the specified range.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<WriteSheetInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      spreadsheetId: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'The ID of the spreadsheet to write to.',
      },
      range: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'The A1 notation range to write to, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:B5".',
      },
      values: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'JSON array of arrays representing the rows and columns to write, e.g. \'[["Name","Age"],["Alice","30"]]\'.',
      },
    },
    required: ['spreadsheetId', 'range', 'values'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: WriteSheetInput): Promise<WriteSheetResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.spreadsheetId) {
        throw new Error('spreadsheetId is required and must be non-empty');
      }
      if (!input.range) {
        throw new Error('range is required and must be non-empty');
      }
      if (!input.values) {
        throw new Error('values is required and must be non-empty');
      }

      let parsedValues: string[][];
      try {
        parsedValues = JSON.parse(input.values) as string[][];
      } catch {
        throw new Error(
          'values must be a valid JSON array of arrays, e.g. \'[["Name","Age"],["Alice","30"]]\''
        );
      }

      if (!Array.isArray(parsedValues) || !parsedValues.every((row) => Array.isArray(row))) {
        throw new Error('values must be a JSON array of arrays');
      }

      const encodedRange = encodeURIComponent(input.range);
      const data = await sheetsRequest<{
        updatedRange: string;
        updatedRows: number;
        updatedColumns: number;
        updatedCells: number;
      }>(
        'PUT',
        `/${input.spreadsheetId}/values/${encodedRange}?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED`,
        { values: parsedValues }
      );

      return {
        updatedRange: data.updatedRange,
        updatedRows: data.updatedRows,
        updatedColumns: data.updatedColumns,
        updatedCells: data.updatedCells,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to write sheet: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  },
});

function getApiKey(): string {

    throw new Error(
      'NOTION_API_KEY environment variable is required. Get your integration token from https://www.notion.so/my-integrations'

}

async function notionRequest<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const key = getApiKey();

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,
    'Notion-Version': NOTION_VERSION,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  };

  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
  if (body !== undefined) {
    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    let errorMessage: string;
    try {
      const errorData = (await response.json()) as { message?: string; code?: string };
      errorMessage = errorData.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
      if (errorData.code) {
        errorMessage = `${errorMessage} (code: ${errorData.code})`;
      }
    } catch {
      errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    }

    switch (response.status) {
      case 400:
        throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 401:
        throw new Error(
          'Authentication failed: Invalid Notion API key. Check NOTION_API_KEY.'
        );
      case 403:
        throw new Error(
          `Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}. Ensure the integration has access to the resource.`
        );
      case 404:
        throw new Error(`Resource not found: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 429:
        throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
      default:
        throw new Error(`Notion API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    }
  }

  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) {
    return {} as T;
  }

  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

// ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface NotionRichText {
  type: string;
  plain_text: string;
}

interface NotionTitleProperty {
  type: 'title';
  title: NotionRichText[];
}

interface NotionProperties {
  [key: string]: NotionTitleProperty | { type: string; [key: string]: unknown };
}

interface NotionPage {
  id: string;
  object: string;
  url: string;
  created_time: string;
  last_edited_time: string;
  properties: NotionProperties;
}

interface NotionBlock {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  has_children: boolean;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

function extractTitle(properties: NotionProperties): string {
  for (const value of Object.values(properties)) {
    if (value.type === 'title' && 'title' in value) {
      const titleProp = value as NotionTitleProperty;
      return titleProp.title.map((t) => t.plain_text).join('');
    }
  }
  return '';
}

function simplifyProperties(
  properties: NotionProperties
): Record<string, unknown> {
  const simplified: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(properties)) {
    simplified[key] = { type: value.type, value };
  }
  return simplified;
}

      },
    },
    required: ['parentId', 'title'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: NotionCreatePageInput): Promise<NotionCreatePageResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.parentId) {
        throw new Error('parentId is required and must be non-empty');
      }
      if (!input.title) {
        throw new Error('title is required and must be non-empty');

      if (parentType !== 'database' && parentType !== 'page') {
        throw new Error('parentType must be either "database" or "page"');

      if (parentType === 'database') {

        body.properties = properties;

        body.parent = { page_id: input.parentId };
        body.properties = {
          title: {
            title: [{ text: { content: input.title } }],
          },
        };
      }

      if (input.content) {
        try {
          body.children = JSON.parse(input.content);
        } catch {
          throw new Error('content must be a valid JSON string representing an array of block objects');
        }
      }

      const page = await notionRequest<NotionPage>('POST', '/pages', body);

      return {
        id: page.id,
        url: page.url,
        createdTime: page.created_time,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to create Notion page: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  },
});

function percentEncode(str: string): string {

function generateOAuthSignature(

  return `OAuth ${headerParts}`;

async function twitterBearerRequest<T>(path: string): Promise<T> {
  const token = getBearerToken();

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, {
    method: 'GET',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    },
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    await handleTwitterError(response);
  }

  return (await response.json()) as T;
}

async function twitterOAuthRequest<T>(
  method: string,
  url: string,
  body?: unknown
): Promise<T> {
  const credentials = getOAuthCredentials();
  const authHeader = buildOAuthHeader(method, url, credentials);

  const options: RequestInit = {
    method,
    headers: {
      Authorization: authHeader,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
  };

  if (body !== undefined) {
    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  const response = await fetch(url, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    await handleTwitterError(response);
  }

  return (await response.json()) as T;
}

async function handleTwitterError(response: Response): Promise<never> {
  let errorMessage: string;
  try {
    const errorData = (await response.json()) as {
      detail?: string;
      title?: string;
      errors?: { message: string }[];
    };
    errorMessage =
      errorData.detail ||
      errorData.title ||
      errorData.errors?.[0]?.message ||
      `HTTP ${response.status}`;
  } catch {
    errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
  }

  switch (response.status) {
    case 400:
      throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
    case 401:
      throw new Error(
        'Authentication failed: Invalid Twitter credentials. Check your API keys and tokens.'
      );
    case 403:
      throw new Error(`Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}`);
    case 404:
      throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}`);
    case 429:
      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
    default:
      throw new Error(`Twitter API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
  }
}

function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(params).filter(
    ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''
  );
  if (entries.length === 0) return '';
  return (
    '?' +
    entries
      .map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`)
      .join('&')
  );
}

import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';

const BASE_URL = 'https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3';

// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getApiKey(): string {
  const key = process.env.YOUTUBE_API_KEY;
  if (!key) {
    throw new Error(
      'YOUTUBE_API_KEY environment variable is required. Get your API key from https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials'
    );
  }
  return key;
}

function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(params).filter(
    ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''
  );
  if (entries.length === 0) return '';
  return (
    '?' +
    entries
      .map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`)
      .join('&')
  );
}

async function youtubeRequest<T>(path: string, params: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<T> {
  const key = getApiKey();
  const allParams = { ...params, key };
  const qs = buildQueryString(allParams);

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}${qs}`, {
    method: 'GET',
    headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    let errorMessage: string;
    try {
      const errorData = (await response.json()) as {
        error?: { message?: string; errors?: { reason: string }[] };
      };
      errorMessage = errorData.error?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    } catch {
      errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    }

    switch (response.status) {
      case 400:
        throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 401:
        throw new Error(
          'Authentication failed: Invalid YouTube API key. Check YOUTUBE_API_KEY.'
        );
      case 403:
        throw new Error(`Access forbidden or quota exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 404:
        throw new Error(`Resource not found: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 429:
        throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
      default:
        throw new Error(`YouTube API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    }
  }

  return (await response.json()) as T;
}

// ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function extractVideoId(input: string): string {
  const urlPatterns = [
    /(?:youtube\.com\/watch\?v=|youtu\.be\/|youtube\.com\/embed\/|youtube\.com\/v\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/,
    /^([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})$/,
  ];

  for (const pattern of urlPatterns) {
    const match = input.match(pattern);
    if (match?.[1]) {
      return match[1];
    }
  }

  return input;
}

// ─── getTranscript ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface GetTranscriptInput {
  videoId: string;
}

function parseTimedTextXml(xml: string): TranscriptSegment[] {
  const segments: TranscriptSegment[] = [];
  const textRegex = /<text\s+start="([^"]*)"(?:\s+dur="([^"]*)")?[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/text>/g;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  while ((match = textRegex.exec(xml)) !== null) {
    const start = parseFloat(match[1]) || 0;
    const duration = parseFloat(match[2]) || 0;
    const rawText = match[3]
      .replace(/&/g, '&')
      .replace(/</g, '<')
      .replace(/>/g, '>')
      .replace(/"/g, '"')
      .replace(/'/g, "'")
      .replace(/'/g, "'")
      .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '')
      .replace(/\n/g, ' ')
      .trim();

    if (rawText) {
      segments.push({ text: rawText, start, duration });
    }
  }

  return segments;
}

export const getTranscript = tool({
  description:
    'Get the transcript/captions of a YouTube video. Extracts auto-generated or manual captions with timestamps.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<GetTranscriptInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      videoId: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'The YouTube video ID or full URL (e.g. "dQw4w9WgXcQ" or "https://youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ").',
      },
    },
    required: ['videoId'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: GetTranscriptInput): Promise<TranscriptResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.videoId) {
        throw new Error('videoId is required and must be non-empty');
      }

      const videoId = extractVideoId(input.videoId);

      const watchUrl = `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${videoId}`;
      const pageResponse = await fetch(watchUrl, {
        headers: {
          'User-Agent':
            'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
          'Accept-Language': 'en-US,en;q=0.9',
        },
      });

      if (!pageResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to fetch video page: HTTP ${pageResponse.status}`);
      }

      const pageHtml = await pageResponse.text();

      const playerResponseMatch = pageHtml.match(
        /ytInitialPlayerResponse\s*=\s*(\{.+?\})\s*;(?:\s*var\s|\s*<\/script>)/
      );

      if (!playerResponseMatch?.[1]) {
        throw new Error(
          'Could not find player response data. The video may be private, age-restricted, or unavailable.'
        );
      }

      let playerResponse: {
        captions?: {
          playerCaptionsTracklistRenderer?: {
            captionTracks?: {
              baseUrl: string;
              languageCode: string;
              kind?: string;
              name?: { simpleText?: string };
            }[];
          };
        };
      };

      try {
        playerResponse = JSON.parse(playerResponseMatch[1]);
      } catch {
        throw new Error('Failed to parse video player data');
      }

      const captionTracks =
        playerResponse.captions?.playerCaptionsTracklistRenderer?.captionTracks;

      if (!captionTracks || captionTracks.length === 0) {
        throw new Error(
          'No captions available for this video. The video may not have subtitles enabled.'
        );
      }

      const englishTrack =
        captionTracks.find((t) => t.languageCode === 'en' && t.kind !== 'asr') ||
        captionTracks.find((t) => t.languageCode === 'en') ||
        captionTracks.find((t) => t.languageCode.startsWith('en')) ||
        captionTracks[0];

      const captionUrl = englishTrack.baseUrl;
      const captionResponse = await fetch(captionUrl);

      if (!captionResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to fetch caption data: HTTP ${captionResponse.status}`);
      }

      const captionXml = await captionResponse.text();
      const segments = parseTimedTextXml(captionXml);

      if (segments.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('Caption data was empty or could not be parsed');
      }

      const fullText = segments.map((s) => s.text).join(' ');

      return {
        text: fullText,
        segments,
        language: englishTrack.languageCode,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to get transcript: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  },
});

export default {
  searchVideos,
  getVideoDetails,
  listChannelVideos,
  getTranscript,
};

Read, write, append, and clear Google Sheets data. Built for AI agents using the Vercel AI SDK.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-sheets
```

## Setup

Set the `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` environment variable to the JSON string of your Google service account credentials. The service account must have access to the target spreadsheets.

1. Create a service account in [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/serviceaccounts).
2. Create a JSON key for the service account.
3. Enable the Google Sheets API in your project.
4. Share your spreadsheet with the service account email address.
5. Set the key as an environment variable:

```bash
export GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY='{"client_email":"...","private_key":"...",...}'
```

## Usage

```typescript
import { readSheet, writeSheet, appendSheet, clearSheet } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-google-sheets';

// Read data from a range
const data = await readSheet.execute({ spreadsheetId: 'abc123', range: 'Sheet1!A1:C10' });

// Write data to a range
const result = await writeSheet.execute({
  spreadsheetId: 'abc123',
  range: 'Sheet1!A1:B2',
  values: '[["Name","Age"],["Alice","30"]]',
});

// Append rows
const appended = await appendSheet.execute({
  spreadsheetId: 'abc123',
  range: 'Sheet1!A1',
  values: '[["Bob","25"],["Carol","28"]]',
});

// Clear a range
const cleared = await clearSheet.execute({ spreadsheetId: 'abc123', range: 'Sheet1!A1:C10' });
```

## Tools

### readSheet

Read data from a Google Sheets range.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| spreadsheetId | string | Yes | The ID of the spreadsheet to read from. |
| range | string | Yes | The A1 notation range to read, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:B5". |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| range | string | The actual range that was read. |
| values | string[][] | 2D array of cell values. |
| rowCount | number | Number of rows returned. |
| columnCount | number | Number of columns returned. |

### writeSheet

Write data to a Google Sheets range, overwriting existing content.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| spreadsheetId | string | Yes | The ID of the spreadsheet to write to. |
| range | string | Yes | The A1 notation range to write to. |
| values | string | Yes | JSON array of arrays, e.g. '[["Name","Age"],["Alice","30"]]'. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| updatedRange | string | The range that was updated. |
| updatedRows | number | Number of rows updated. |
| updatedColumns | number | Number of columns updated. |
| updatedCells | number | Total number of cells updated. |

### appendSheet

Append rows to the end of a Google Sheet.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| spreadsheetId | string | Yes | The ID of the spreadsheet to append to. |
| range | string | Yes | The A1 notation range indicating where to start looking for data. |
| values | string | Yes | JSON array of arrays representing the rows to append. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| updatedRange | string | The range that was appended to. |
| updatedRows | number | Number of rows appended. |
| updatedColumns | number | Number of columns appended. |
| updatedCells | number | Total number of cells appended. |

### clearSheet

Clear all values from a Google Sheets range.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| spreadsheetId | string | Yes | The ID of the spreadsheet to clear. |
| range | string | Yes | The A1 notation range to clear. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| clearedRange | string | The range that was cleared. |

```typescript

  parentId: 'database-id',

## Installation

## Usage

```typescript
import { postTweet, searchTweets, getUserProfile, getUserTweets } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-twitter';

// Post a tweet
const tweet = await postTweet.execute({ text: 'Hello from my AI agent!' });

// Search tweets
const results = await searchTweets.execute({ query: 'AI agents', maxResults: 20 });

// Get user profile
const profile = await getUserProfile.execute({ username: 'elonmusk' });

// Get user tweets
const tweets = await getUserTweets.execute({ userId: profile.id });
```

## Tools

### postTweet

Post a new tweet to Twitter/X.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| text | string | Yes | The text content of the tweet (max 280 characters). |
| replyToId | string | No | The ID of an existing tweet to reply to. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| tweetId | string | The ID of the posted tweet. |
| text | string | The text of the posted tweet. |
| url | string | URL to view the tweet. |

### searchTweets

Search for tweets on Twitter/X.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| query | string | Yes | The search query string. Supports Twitter search operators. |
| maxResults | number | No | Maximum results to return (10-100, default: 10). |
| sortOrder | string | No | Sort order: "recency" or "relevancy". |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| tweets | array | Array of tweets with id, text, authorId, createdAt. |
| resultCount | number | Total number of results returned. |

### getUserProfile

Get a Twitter/X user's profile information.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| username | string | Yes | The Twitter/X username (without the @ symbol). |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| id | string | The user's numeric ID. |
| name | string | The user's display name. |
| username | string | The user's handle. |
| description | string | The user's bio. |
| followers | number | Number of followers. |
| following | number | Number of accounts followed. |
| tweetCount | number | Total number of tweets. |
| profileImageUrl | string | URL of the profile image. |

### getUserTweets

Get recent tweets from a Twitter/X user.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| userId | string | Yes | The Twitter/X user ID (numeric). |
| maxResults | number | No | Maximum tweets to return (5-100, default: 10). |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| tweets | array | Array of tweets with id, text, createdAt, likes, retweets, replies. |

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-youtube
```

## Setup

Set the `YOUTUBE_API_KEY` environment variable to your YouTube Data API v3 key.

1. Go to [Google Cloud Console Credentials](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials).
2. Create an API key.
3. Enable the YouTube Data API v3 in your project.

```bash
export YOUTUBE_API_KEY='AIza...'
```

## Usage

```typescript
import { searchVideos, getVideoDetails, listChannelVideos, getTranscript } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-youtube';

const results = await searchVideos.execute({ query: 'TypeScript tutorial', maxResults: 5 });

const details = await getVideoDetails.execute({ videoId: 'dQw4w9WgXcQ' });

// List channel videos

```

## Tools

### searchVideos

Search for videos on YouTube.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| query | string | Yes | The search query to find videos. |
| maxResults | number | No | Maximum results to return (1-50, default: 10). |

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| results | array | Array of videos with videoId, title, description, channelTitle, publishedAt, thumbnailUrl. |
| totalResults | number | Total number of matching videos. |

### getVideoDetails

Get detailed information about a YouTube video.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| Field | Type | Description |

| channelTitle | string | The channel name. |

### listChannelVideos

List recent videos from a YouTube channel.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| results | array | Array of videos with videoId, title, description, publishedAt, thumbnailUrl. |

### getTranscript

Get the transcript/captions of a YouTube video.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| videoId | string | Yes | The video ID or full YouTube URL. |

| text | string | Full transcript as a single string. |
| segments | array | Array of segments with text, start (seconds), and duration (seconds). |
| language | string | Language code of the transcript (e.g. "en"). |

## Tool 1: agnt-google-sheets

**Directory:** agnt-google-sheets/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-sheets
**Description:** Read, write, append, and clear Google Sheets data. Requires GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY or GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** data

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "readSheet", "description": "Read data from a Google Sheets range."},
  {"name": "writeSheet", "description": "Write data to a Google Sheets range."},
  {"name": "appendSheet", "description": "Append rows to a Google Sheet."},
  {"name": "clearSheet", "description": "Clear data from a Google Sheets range."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` (JSON string of service account credentials) — parse it to get `client_email` and `private_key`, then create a JWT to get an access token from `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token` with scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets`
- Base URL: `https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets`
- Shared helper: `async function getAccessToken()` and `async function sheetsRequest<T>(method, path, body?)`

Helper for JWT: Create a JWT with header `{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT"}`, payload `{"iss": client_email, "scope": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets", "aud": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", "exp": now+3600, "iat": now}`. Sign with the private key using Node's `crypto.createSign('RSA-SHA256')`. Then exchange for access token via POST to `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token` with `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer&assertion={jwt}`.

### readSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:B5")
- GET `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}`
- Returns `{range, values: string[][], rowCount, columnCount}`

### writeSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required), `values` (string, required - JSON array of arrays)
- PUT `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED` with body `{values: parsed}`
- Returns `{updatedRange, updatedRows, updatedColumns, updatedCells}`

### appendSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required), `values` (string, required - JSON array of arrays)
- POST `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:append?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED` with body `{values: parsed}`
- Returns `{updatedRange, updatedRows, updatedColumns, updatedCells}`

### clearSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required)
- POST `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:clear`
- Returns `{clearedRange}`

## Tool 2: agnt-notion

**Directory:** agnt-notion/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-notion
**Description:** Interact with Notion databases, pages, and blocks. Requires NOTION_API_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** data

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "notionSearch", "description": "Search for pages and databases in Notion."},
  {"name": "notionQueryDatabase", "description": "Query a Notion database with optional filters and sorts."},
  {"name": "notionGetPage", "description": "Get the content of a Notion page."},
  {"name": "notionCreatePage", "description": "Create a new page in a Notion database or as a child of another page."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `NOTION_API_KEY`
- Base URL: `https://api.notion.com/v1`
- Headers: `Authorization: Bearer {key}`, `Notion-Version: 2022-06-28`, `Content-Type: application/json`
- Shared helper: `async function notionRequest<T>(method, path, body?)`

### notionSearch
- Parameters: `query` (string, required), `filter` (string, optional - "page" or "database"), `pageSize` (number, optional, default 10)
- POST `/search` with body `{query, filter: {property: "object", value: filter}, page_size}`
- Returns `{results: [{id, type, title, url, lastEdited}], hasMore, nextCursor}`

### notionQueryDatabase
- Parameters: `databaseId` (string, required), `filter` (string, optional - JSON filter object), `sorts` (string, optional - JSON sorts array), `pageSize` (number, optional, default 10)
- POST `/databases/{databaseId}/query` with parsed filter/sorts
- Returns `{results: [{id, properties, url, createdTime, lastEditedTime}], hasMore, nextCursor}`

### notionGetPage
- Parameters: `pageId` (string, required)
- GET `/pages/{pageId}` AND GET `/blocks/{pageId}/children`
- Returns `{id, properties, url, content: blocks[], createdTime, lastEditedTime}`

### notionCreatePage
- Parameters: `parentId` (string, required), `parentType` (string, optional - "database" or "page", default "database"), `title` (string, required), `properties` (string, optional - JSON properties object), `content` (string, optional - JSON array of blocks)
- POST `/pages` with appropriate parent structure
- Returns `{id, url, createdTime}`

## Tool 3: agnt-twitter

**Directory:** agnt-twitter/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-twitter
**Description:** Post tweets, search tweets, and manage Twitter/X profiles. Requires TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN for read operations and TWITTER_API_KEY, TWITTER_API_SECRET, TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN, TWITTER_ACCESS_SECRET for write operations.
**Category:** marketing

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "postTweet", "description": "Post a new tweet to Twitter/X."},
  {"name": "searchTweets", "description": "Search for tweets on Twitter/X."},
  {"name": "getUserProfile", "description": "Get a Twitter/X user's profile information."},
  {"name": "getUserTweets", "description": "Get recent tweets from a Twitter/X user."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- For read: `TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN` with `Authorization: Bearer {token}`
- For write: Need OAuth 1.0a signature using `TWITTER_API_KEY`, `TWITTER_API_SECRET`, `TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `TWITTER_ACCESS_SECRET`
- Base URL: `https://api.twitter.com/2`

For OAuth 1.0a signing (POST tweet):
Use Node's `crypto` module:
1. Create base string: `POST&{encoded_url}&{encoded_params}`
2. Create signing key: `{encoded_api_secret}&{encoded_access_secret}`
3. Create signature: HMAC-SHA1 of base string with signing key, then base64 encode
4. Build Authorization header: `OAuth oauth_consumer_key="...", oauth_nonce="...", oauth_signature="...", oauth_signature_method="HMAC-SHA1", oauth_timestamp="...", oauth_token="...", oauth_version="1.0"`

### postTweet
- Parameters: `text` (string, required, max 280 chars), `replyToId` (string, optional)
- POST `https://api.twitter.com/2/tweets` with OAuth 1.0a
- Returns `{tweetId, text, url}`

### searchTweets
- Parameters: `query` (string, required), `maxResults` (number, optional, 10-100, default 10), `sortOrder` (string, optional - "recency" or "relevancy")
- GET `/tweets/search/recent` with Bearer token
- Returns `{tweets: [{id, text, authorId, createdAt}], resultCount}`

### getUserProfile
- Parameters: `username` (string, required)
- GET `/users/by/username/{username}?user.fields=description,public_metrics,profile_image_url,created_at`
- Returns `{id, name, username, description, followers, following, tweetCount, profileImageUrl}`

### getUserTweets
- Parameters: `userId` (string, required), `maxResults` (number, optional, default 10)
- GET `/users/{userId}/tweets?max_results={maxResults}&tweet.fields=created_at,public_metrics`
- Returns `{tweets: [{id, text, createdAt, likes, retweets, replies}]}`

## Tool 4: agnt-youtube

**Directory:** agnt-youtube/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-youtube
**Description:** Search videos, get video details, list channel videos, and retrieve transcriptions from YouTube. Requires YOUTUBE_API_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** research

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "searchVideos", "description": "Search for videos on YouTube."},
  {"name": "getVideoDetails", "description": "Get detailed information about a YouTube video."},
  {"name": "listChannelVideos", "description": "List recent videos from a YouTube channel."},
  {"name": "getTranscript", "description": "Get the transcript/captions of a YouTube video."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `YOUTUBE_API_KEY`
- Base URL: `https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3`
- Auth: `?key={apiKey}` query parameter

### searchVideos
- Parameters: `query` (string, required), `maxResults` (number, optional, default 10)
- GET `/search?part=snippet&type=video&q={query}&maxResults={maxResults}&key={key}`
- Returns `{results: [{videoId, title, description, channelTitle, publishedAt, thumbnailUrl}], totalResults}`

### getVideoDetails
- Parameters: `videoId` (string, required) - Video ID (auto-extract from URLs like youtube.com/watch?v=XXX)
- GET `/videos?part=snippet,statistics,contentDetails&id={videoId}&key={key}`
- Returns `{title, description, channelTitle, publishedAt, viewCount, likeCount, commentCount, duration, thumbnailUrl}`

### listChannelVideos
- Parameters: `channelId` (string, required), `maxResults` (number, optional, default 10)
- GET `/search?part=snippet&channelId={channelId}&type=video&order=date&maxResults={maxResults}&key={key}`
- Returns `{results: [{videoId, title, description, publishedAt, thumbnailUrl}]}`

### getTranscript
- Parameters: `videoId` (string, required)
- GET `/captions?part=snippet&videoId={videoId}&key={key}` to get caption list
- Note: YouTube Data API doesn't allow direct caption download without OAuth. Instead, fetch from `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={videoId}`, parse the page for `ytInitialPlayerResponse`, extract `captionTracks` array, fetch the first caption URL (timedtext), parse the XML to extract text segments
- Returns `{text (full transcript), segments: [{text, start, duration}], language}`

- Shared helper: `async function getAccessToken()` and `async function sheetsRequest<T>(method, path, body?)`

Helper for JWT: Create a JWT with header `{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT"}`, payload `{"iss": client_email, "scope": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets", "aud": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", "exp": now+3600, "iat": now}`. Sign with the private key using Node's `crypto.createSign('RSA-SHA256')`. Then exchange for access token via POST to `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token` with `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer&assertion={jwt}`.

### readSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:B5")
- GET `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}`
- Returns `{range, values: string[][], rowCount, columnCount}`

### writeSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required), `values` (string, required - JSON array of arrays)
- PUT `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED` with body `{values: parsed}`
- Returns `{updatedRange, updatedRows, updatedColumns, updatedCells}`

### appendSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required), `values` (string, required - JSON array of arrays)
- POST `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:append?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED` with body `{values: parsed}`
- Returns `{updatedRange, updatedRows, updatedColumns, updatedCells}`

### clearSheet
- Parameters: `spreadsheetId` (string, required), `range` (string, required)
- POST `/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:clear`
- Returns `{clearedRange}`

## Tool 2: agnt-notion

**Directory:** agnt-notion/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-notion
**Description:** Interact with Notion databases, pages, and blocks. Requires NOTION_API_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** data

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "notionSearch", "description": "Search for pages and databases in Notion."},
  {"name": "notionQueryDatabase", "description": "Query a Notion database with optional filters and sorts."},
  {"name": "notionGetPage", "description": "Get the content of a Notion page."},
  {"name": "notionCreatePage", "description": "Create a new page in a Notion database or as a child of another page."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `NOTION_API_KEY`
- Base URL: `https://api.notion.com/v1`
- Headers: `Authorization: Bearer {key}`, `Notion-Version: 2022-06-28`, `Content-Type: application/json`
- Shared helper: `async function notionRequest<T>(method, path, body?)`

### notionSearch
- Parameters: `query` (string, required), `filter` (string, optional - "page" or "database"), `pageSize` (number, optional, default 10)
- POST `/search` with body `{query, filter: {property: "object", value: filter}, page_size}`
- Returns `{results: [{id, type, title, url, lastEdited}], hasMore, nextCursor}`

### notionQueryDatabase
- Parameters: `databaseId` (string, required), `filter` (string, optional - JSON filter object), `sorts` (string, optional - JSON sorts array), `pageSize` (number, optional, default 10)
- POST `/databases/{databaseId}/query` with parsed filter/sorts
- Returns `{results: [{id, properties, url, createdTime, lastEditedTime}], hasMore, nextCursor}`

### notionGetPage
- Parameters: `pageId` (string, required)
- GET `/pages/{pageId}` AND GET `/blocks/{pageId}/children`
- Returns `{id, properties, url, content: blocks[], createdTime, lastEditedTime}`

### notionCreatePage
- Parameters: `parentId` (string, required), `parentType` (string, optional - "database" or "page", default "database"), `title` (string, required), `properties` (string, optional - JSON properties object), `content` (string, optional - JSON array of blocks)
- POST `/pages` with appropriate parent structure
- Returns `{id, url, createdTime}`

## Tool 3: agnt-twitter

**Directory:** agnt-twitter/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-twitter
**Description:** Post tweets, search tweets, and manage Twitter/X profiles. Requires TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN for read operations and TWITTER_API_KEY, TWITTER_API_SECRET, TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN, TWITTER_ACCESS_SECRET for write operations.
**Category:** marketing

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "postTweet", "description": "Post a new tweet to Twitter/X."},
  {"name": "searchTweets", "description": "Search for tweets on Twitter/X."},
  {"name": "getUserProfile", "description": "Get a Twitter/X user's profile information."},
  {"name": "getUserTweets", "description": "Get recent tweets from a Twitter/X user."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- For read: `TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN` with `Authorization: Bearer {token}`
- For write: Need OAuth 1.0a signature using `TWITTER_API_KEY`, `TWITTER_API_SECRET`, `TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `TWITTER_ACCESS_SECRET`
- Base URL: `https://api.twitter.com/2`

For OAuth 1.0a signing (POST tweet):
Use Node's `crypto` module:
1. Create base string: `POST&{encoded_url}&{encoded_params}`
2. Create signing key: `{encoded_api_secret}&{encoded_access_secret}`
3. Create signature: HMAC-SHA1 of base string with signing key, then base64 encode
4. Build Authorization header: `OAuth oauth_consumer_key="...", oauth_nonce="...", oauth_signature="...", oauth_signature_method="HMAC-SHA1", oauth_timestamp="...", oauth_token="...", oauth_version="1.0"`

### postTweet
- Parameters: `text` (string, required, max 280 chars), `replyToId` (string, optional)
- POST `https://api.twitter.com/2/tweets` with OAuth 1.0a
- Returns `{tweetId, text, url}`

### searchTweets
- Parameters: `query` (string, required), `maxResults` (number, optional, 10-100, default 10), `sortOrder` (string, optional - "recency" or "relevancy")
- GET `/tweets/search/recent` with Bearer token
- Returns `{tweets: [{id, text, authorId, createdAt}], resultCount}`

### getUserProfile
- Parameters: `username` (string, required)
- GET `/users/by/username/{username}?user.fields=description,public_metrics,profile_image_url,created_at`
- Returns `{id, name, username, description, followers, following, tweetCount, profileImageUrl}`

### getUserTweets
- Parameters: `userId` (string, required), `maxResults` (number, optional, default 10)
- GET `/users/{userId}/tweets?max_results={maxResults}&tweet.fields=created_at,public_metrics`
- Returns `{tweets: [{id, text, createdAt, likes, retweets, replies}]}`

## Tool 4: agnt-youtube

**Directory:** agnt-youtube/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-youtube
**Description:** Search videos, get video details, list channel videos, and retrieve transcriptions from YouTube. Requires YOUTUBE_API_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** research

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "searchVideos", "description": "Search for videos on YouTube."},
  {"name": "getVideoDetails", "description": "Get detailed information about a YouTube video."},
  {"name": "listChannelVideos", "description": "List recent videos from a YouTube channel."},
  {"name": "getTranscript", "description": "Get the transcript/captions of a YouTube video."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `YOUTUBE_API_KEY`
- Base URL: `https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3`
- Auth: `?key={apiKey}` query parameter

### searchVideos
- Parameters: `query` (string, required), `maxResults` (number, optional, default 10)
- GET `/search?part=snippet&type=video&q={query}&maxResults={maxResults}&key={key}`
- Returns `{results: [{videoId, title, description, channelTitle, publishedAt, thumbnailUrl}], totalResults}`

### getVideoDetails
- Parameters: `videoId` (string, required) - Video ID (auto-extract from URLs like youtube.com/watch?v=XXX)
- GET `/videos?part=snippet,statistics,contentDetails&id={videoId}&key={key}`
- Returns `{title, description, channelTitle, publishedAt, viewCount, likeCount, commentCount, duration, thumbnailUrl}`

### listChannelVideos
- Parameters: `channelId` (string, required), `maxResults` (number, optional, default 10)
- GET `/search?part=snippet&channelId={channelId}&type=video&order=date&maxResults={maxResults}&key={key}`
- Returns `{results: [{videoId, title, description, publishedAt, thumbnailUrl}]}`

### getTranscript
- Parameters: `videoId` (string, required)
- GET `/captions?part=snippet&videoId={videoId}&key={key}` to get caption list
- Note: YouTube Data API doesn't allow direct caption download without OAuth. Instead, fetch from `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={videoId}`, parse the page for `ytInitialPlayerResponse`, extract `captionTracks` array, fetch the first caption URL (timedtext), parse the XML to extract text segments
- Returns `{text (full transcript), segments: [{text, start, duration}], language}`

    10→import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';

    12→const BASE_URL = 'https://discord.com/api/v10';
    13→
    14→// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    15→
    16→function getApiKey(): string {
    17→  const key = process.env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN;
    18→  if (!key) {
    19→    throw new Error(
    20→      'DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN environment variable is required. Get your token from https://discord.com/developers/applications'
    21→    );
    22→  }
    23→  return key;
    24→}
    25→
    26→async function apiRequest<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    27→  const key = getApiKey();
    28→
    29→  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    30→    Authorization: `Bot ${key}`,
    31→    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    32→  };
    33→
    34→  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
    35→  if (body !== undefined) {
    36→    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, options);
    40→
    41→  if (!response.ok) {
    42→    await handleApiError(response);
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (response.status === 204) {
    46→    return { success: true } as T;
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  const text = await response.text();
    50→  if (!text) {
    51→    return {} as T;
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
    55→}
    56→
    57→async function handleApiError(response: Response): Promise<never> {
    58→  let errorMessage: string;
    59→  try {
    60→    const errorData = (await response.json()) as { message?: string; code?: number };
    61→    errorMessage = errorData.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    62→    if (errorData.code) {
    63→      errorMessage = `${errorMessage} (Discord Error Code: ${errorData.code})`;
    64→    }
    65→  } catch {
    66→    errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  switch (response.status) {
    70→    case 400:
    71→      throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
    72→    case 401:
    73→      throw new Error('Authentication failed: Invalid Discord bot token. Check DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.');
    74→    case 403:
    75→      throw new Error(`Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}`);
    76→    case 404:
    77→      throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}`);
    78→    case 429:
    79→      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
    80→    default:
    81→      throw new Error(`Discord API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    82→  }
    83→}

    85→function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>): string {
    86→  const entries = Object.entries(params).filter(
    87→    ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''
    88→  );
    89→  if (entries.length === 0) return '';
    90→  return (
    91→    '?' +
    92→    entries.map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`).join('&')
    93→  );
    94→}

interface ServiceAccountCredentials {
  client_email: string;
  private_key: string;

function getServiceAccountCredentials(): ServiceAccountCredentials {
  const raw = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY;
  if (!raw) {
    throw new Error(
      'GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable is required. Set it to the JSON string of your Google service account credentials. See https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs/creating-managing-service-account-keys'

    if (!parsed.client_email || !parsed.private_key) {
      throw new Error('Missing client_email or private_key in credentials');

    return parsed;
  } catch (error) {

      throw error;
    }
    throw new Error(
      'GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY must be a valid JSON string containing client_email and private_key'
    );
  }
}

function base64urlEncode(data: string | Buffer): string {
  const buf = typeof data === 'string' ? Buffer.from(data) : data;
  return buf.toString('base64').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
}

    scope: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets',
    aud: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
    exp: now + 3600,
    iat: now,
  };

  const signature = signer.sign(credentials.private_key);
  const encodedSignature = base64urlEncode(signature);

  return `${signatureInput}.${encodedSignature}`;
}

let cachedToken: { token: string; expiresAt: number } | null = null;

async function getAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
  if (cachedToken && Date.now() < cachedToken.expiresAt) {
    return cachedToken.token;
  }

  const credentials = getServiceAccountCredentials();
  const jwt = createJwt(credentials);

  const response = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
    body: `grant_type=${encodeURIComponent('urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer')}&assertion=${encodeURIComponent(jwt)}`,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorText = await response.text();
    throw new Error(`Failed to obtain access token: ${response.status} ${errorText}`);
  }

  const data = (await response.json()) as { access_token: string; expires_in: number };
  cachedToken = {
    token: data.access_token,
    expiresAt: Date.now() + (data.expires_in - 60) * 1000,
  };

  return cachedToken.token;
}

async function sheetsRequest<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const token = await getAccessToken();

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  };

  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
  if (body !== undefined) {
    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    let errorMessage: string;
    try {
      const errorData = (await response.json()) as { error?: { message?: string } };
      errorMessage = errorData.error?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    } catch {
      errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    }

    switch (response.status) {
      case 400:
        throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 401:
        throw new Error(
          'Authentication failed: Invalid or expired credentials. Check GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.'
        );
      case 403:
        throw new Error(
          `Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}. Ensure the service account has access to the spreadsheet.`
        );
      case 404:
        throw new Error(`Spreadsheet or range not found: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 429:
        throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
      default:
        throw new Error(`Google Sheets API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    }
  }

  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) {
    return {} as T;
  }

  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getApiKey(): string {
  const key = process.env.NOTION_API_KEY;
  if (!key) {
    throw new Error(
      'NOTION_API_KEY environment variable is required. Get your integration token from https://www.notion.so/my-integrations'
    );
  }
  return key;
}

async function notionRequest<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const key = getApiKey();

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,
    'Notion-Version': NOTION_VERSION,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  };

  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
  if (body !== undefined) {
    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    let errorMessage: string;
    try {
      const errorData = (await response.json()) as { message?: string; code?: string };
      errorMessage = errorData.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
      if (errorData.code) {
        errorMessage = `${errorMessage} (code: ${errorData.code})`;
      }
    } catch {
      errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    }

    switch (response.status) {
      case 400:
        throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 401:
        throw new Error(
          'Authentication failed: Invalid Notion API key. Check NOTION_API_KEY.'
        );
      case 403:
        throw new Error(
          `Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}. Ensure the integration has access to the resource.`
        );
      case 404:
        throw new Error(`Resource not found: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 429:
        throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
      default:
        throw new Error(`Notion API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    }
  }

  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) {
    return {} as T;
  }

  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

// ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface NotionRichText {
  type: string;
  plain_text: string;
}

interface NotionTitleProperty {
  type: 'title';
  title: NotionRichText[];
}

interface NotionProperties {
  [key: string]: NotionTitleProperty | { type: string; [key: string]: unknown };
}

interface NotionPage {
  id: string;
  object: string;
  url: string;
  created_time: string;
  last_edited_time: string;
  properties: NotionProperties;
}

interface NotionBlock {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  has_children: boolean;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

function extractTitle(properties: NotionProperties): string {
  for (const value of Object.values(properties)) {
    if (value.type === 'title' && 'title' in value) {
      const titleProp = value as NotionTitleProperty;
      return titleProp.title.map((t) => t.plain_text).join('');
    }
  }
  return '';
}

function simplifyProperties(
  properties: NotionProperties
): Record<string, unknown> {
  const simplified: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(properties)) {
    simplified[key] = { type: value.type, value };
  }
  return simplified;
}
