Manage files and folders in Dropbox. List, upload, download, delete, create folders, and generate shared links.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-dropbox
```

## Setup

Set the `DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable. Get your token from the [Dropbox App Console](https://www.dropbox.com/developers/apps).

## Usage

```typescript
import { listFolder, uploadFile, downloadFile } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-dropbox';

// List root folder
const files = await listFolder.execute({ path: '' });

// Upload a file
const uploaded = await uploadFile.execute({ path: '/hello.txt', content: 'Hello, world!' });

// Download a file
const downloaded = await downloadFile.execute({ path: '/hello.txt' });
```

## Tools

### listFolder

List files and folders in a Dropbox directory.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| path | string | Yes | The folder path (use "" for root or "/Documents" for a subfolder). |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| entries | array | List of items with name, pathDisplay, tag (file/folder), size, modified. |
| hasMore | boolean | Whether there are more results to fetch. |

### uploadFile

Upload a file to Dropbox.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| path | string | Yes | The destination path (e.g. "/test.txt"). |
| content | string | Yes | The file content to upload. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| name | string | The file name. |
| pathDisplay | string | The full display path. |
| size | number | File size in bytes. |
| modified | string | Last modified timestamp. |
| contentHash | string | Dropbox content hash. |

### downloadFile

Download a file from Dropbox.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| path | string | Yes | The file path to download. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| name | string | The file name. |
| path | string | The full file path. |
| content | string | The file content as text. |
| size | number | File size in bytes. |

### deleteFile

Delete a file or folder from Dropbox.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| path | string | Yes | The file or folder path to delete. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| name | string | The deleted item name. |
| pathDisplay | string | The full display path. |
| tag | string | The item type (file or folder). |

### createFolder

Create a new folder in Dropbox.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| path | string | Yes | The path for the new folder (e.g. "/NewFolder"). |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| name | string | The folder name. |
| pathDisplay | string | The full display path. |

### createSharedLink

Create a shared link for a Dropbox file.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| path | string | Yes | The file or folder path to share. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| url | string | The shared link URL. |
| name | string | The file or folder name. |
| pathDisplay | string | The full display path. |

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-drive
```

## Setup

Set the `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` environment variable to the JSON string of your Google service account key. The service account must have access to the target Drive files/folders (share them with the service account email).

## Usage

```typescript
import { listDriveFiles, uploadDriveFile, downloadDriveFile } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-google-drive';

// List files in root

// Upload a file

// Download a file

```

## Tools

### listDriveFiles

List files in a Google Drive folder.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| folderId | string | No | The folder ID to list files from (default: "root"). |
| pageSize | number | No | Maximum number of files to return (default: 20). |
| query | string | No | Additional Drive search query (e.g. "name contains 'report'"). |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| files | array | List of files with id, name, mimeType, size, modifiedTime, webViewLink. |
| nextPageToken | string or null | Token for fetching the next page of results. |

### uploadDriveFile

Upload a file to Google Drive.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | The name for the uploaded file. |
| content | string | Yes | The file content to upload. |
| folderId | string | No | The destination folder ID (default: "root"). |
| mimeType | string | No | The MIME type of the file (default: "text/plain"). |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| id | string | The uploaded file ID. |
| name | string | The file name. |
| mimeType | string | The file MIME type. |
| webViewLink | string or null | URL to view the file in Google Drive. |

### downloadDriveFile

Download a file from Google Drive.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| fileId | string | Yes | The ID of the file to download. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| content | string | The file content as text. |
| fileId | string | The file ID that was downloaded. |

### createDriveFolder

Create a new folder in Google Drive.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | The name for the new folder. |
| parentId | string | No | The parent folder ID (default: "root"). |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| id | string | The new folder ID. |
| name | string | The folder name. |
| webViewLink | string or null | URL to view the folder in Google Drive. |

### shareDriveFile

Share a Google Drive file with another user.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| fileId | string | Yes | The ID of the file or folder to share. |
| email | string | Yes | The email address of the user to share with. |
| role | string | No | Permission role: "reader", "writer", or "commenter" (default: "reader"). |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| permissionId | string | The created permission ID. |
| role | string | The assigned role. |
| email | string | The email address shared with. |

Create and manage Google Slides presentations. Create new presentations, retrieve presentation details, and add slides with content.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-slides
```

## Setup

Set the `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` environment variable to the JSON string of your Google service account key. The service account needs access to the Google Slides API. For existing presentations, share them with the service account email address.

## Usage

```typescript
import { createPresentation, getPresentation, addSlide } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-google-slides';

// Create a new presentation
const pres = await createPresentation.execute({ title: 'Q1 Report' });

// Get presentation info
const info = await getPresentation.execute({ presentationId: pres.presentationId });

// Add a slide with title and body
const slide = await addSlide.execute({
  presentationId: pres.presentationId,
  layoutType: 'TITLE_AND_BODY',
  title: 'Revenue Overview',
  body: 'Revenue grew 25% quarter over quarter.',
});
```

## Tools

### createPresentation

Create a new Google Slides presentation.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| title | string | Yes | The title for the new presentation. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| presentationId | string | The ID of the created presentation. |
| title | string | The presentation title. |
| slidesCount | number | Number of slides in the presentation. |
| url | string | URL to open the presentation in Google Slides. |

### getPresentation

Get information about a Google Slides presentation.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| presentationId | string | Yes | The ID of the presentation to retrieve. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| presentationId | string | The presentation ID. |
| title | string | The presentation title. |
| slidesCount | number | Total number of slides. |
| slides | array | List of slides with objectId and pageType. |
| url | string | URL to open the presentation in Google Slides. |

### addSlide

Add a new slide to a Google Slides presentation.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| presentationId | string | Yes | The ID of the presentation to add a slide to. |
| layoutType | string | No | Slide layout: "BLANK", "TITLE", "TITLE_AND_BODY", etc. (default: "BLANK"). |
| title | string | No | Title text to insert on the slide. |
| body | string | No | Body text to insert on the slide. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| slideId | string | The ID of the newly created slide. |
| presentationId | string | The presentation ID. |

## Tool 1: agnt-gmail

**Directory:** agnt-gmail/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-gmail
**Description:** Search, read, send, and manage Gmail emails. Requires GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY and GMAIL_USER_EMAIL environment variables.
**Category:** ops

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "searchEmails", "description": "Search Gmail emails using Gmail search syntax."},
  {"name": "readEmail", "description": "Read the full content of a specific Gmail email."},
  {"name": "sendGmail", "description": "Send an email via Gmail."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env vars: `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` (JSON string), `GMAIL_USER_EMAIL` (email to impersonate)
- Use service account with domain-wide delegation: create JWT with `sub` = GMAIL_USER_EMAIL, scope = `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify`
- Base URL: `https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me`

JWT auth helper (same pattern as google-sheets): parse the service account JSON for `client_email` and `private_key`. Create JWT with `{"iss": client_email, "sub": userEmail, "scope": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify", "aud": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", "exp": now+3600, "iat": now}`. Sign with RS256 using `crypto.createSign('RSA-SHA256')`. Exchange at `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token`.

### searchEmails
- Parameters: `query` (string, required - Gmail search syntax e.g. "from:user@example.com is:unread"), `maxResults` (number, optional, default 10)
- GET `/messages?q={query}&maxResults={maxResults}`
- For each message ID returned, GET `/messages/{id}?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=From&metadataHeaders=To&metadataHeaders=Subject&metadataHeaders=Date`
- Returns `{messages: [{id, threadId, from, to, subject, date, snippet}], resultCount}`

### readEmail
- Parameters: `messageId` (string, required)
- GET `/messages/{messageId}?format=full`
- Parse headers for From, To, Subject, Date. Extract body from payload (handle multipart/alternative, get text/plain or text/html)
- Returns `{id, threadId, from, to, subject, date, body, snippet, labels}`

### sendGmail
- Parameters: `to` (string, required), `subject` (string, required), `body` (string, required), `isHtml` (boolean, optional, default false)
- Create RFC 2822 email message: `From: {userEmail}\r\nTo: {to}\r\nSubject: {subject}\r\nContent-Type: {text/plain or text/html}; charset=utf-8\r\n\r\n{body}`
- Base64url encode the message
- POST `/messages/send` with body `{raw: base64urlMessage}`
- Returns `{messageId, threadId}`

## Tool 3: agnt-google-drive

**Directory:** agnt-google-drive/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-drive
**Description:** Manage files and folders in Google Drive. Requires GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** data

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "listDriveFiles", "description": "List files in a Google Drive folder."},
  {"name": "uploadDriveFile", "description": "Upload a file to Google Drive."},
  {"name": "downloadDriveFile", "description": "Download a file from Google Drive."},
  {"name": "createDriveFolder", "description": "Create a new folder in Google Drive."},
  {"name": "shareDriveFile", "description": "Share a Google Drive file with another user."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` (JSON)
- Scope: `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive`
- Base URL: `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3`
- Upload URL: `https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3`

Use same JWT auth pattern as google-sheets/gmail (create JWT, sign with RS256, exchange for token).

### listDriveFiles
- Parameters: `folderId` (string, optional, default "root"), `pageSize` (number, optional, default 20), `query` (string, optional - Drive search query)
- GET `/files?q='${folderId}'+in+parents&pageSize=${pageSize}&fields=files(id,name,mimeType,size,modifiedTime,webViewLink)`
- If query provided, add to the q parameter
- Returns `{files: [{id, name, mimeType, size, modifiedTime, webViewLink}], nextPageToken}`

### uploadDriveFile
- Parameters: `name` (string, required), `content` (string, required), `folderId` (string, optional, default "root"), `mimeType` (string, optional, default "text/plain")
- Multipart upload: POST upload URL `/files?uploadType=multipart`
- Body is multipart with metadata part (JSON: {name, parents: [folderId]}) and content part
- Returns `{id, name, mimeType, webViewLink}`

### downloadDriveFile
- Parameters: `fileId` (string, required)
- GET `/files/${fileId}?alt=media`
- Returns `{content (text), fileId}`

### createDriveFolder
- Parameters: `name` (string, required), `parentId` (string, optional, default "root")
- POST `/files` with `{name, mimeType: "application/vnd.google-apps.folder", parents: [parentId]}`
- Returns `{id, name, webViewLink}`

### shareDriveFile
- Parameters: `fileId` (string, required), `email` (string, required), `role` (string, optional - "reader", "writer", "commenter", default "reader")
- POST `/files/${fileId}/permissions` with `{type: "user", role, emailAddress: email}`
- Returns `{permissionId, role, email}`

## Tool 1: agnt-gmail

**Directory:** agnt-gmail/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-gmail
**Description:** Search, read, send, and manage Gmail emails. Requires GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY and GMAIL_USER_EMAIL environment variables.
**Category:** ops

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "searchEmails", "description": "Search Gmail emails using Gmail search syntax."},
  {"name": "readEmail", "description": "Read the full content of a specific Gmail email."},
  {"name": "sendGmail", "description": "Send an email via Gmail."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env vars: `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` (JSON string), `GMAIL_USER_EMAIL` (email to impersonate)
- Use service account with domain-wide delegation: create JWT with `sub` = GMAIL_USER_EMAIL, scope = `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify`
- Base URL: `https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me`

JWT auth helper (same pattern as google-sheets): parse the service account JSON for `client_email` and `private_key`. Create JWT with `{"iss": client_email, "sub": userEmail, "scope": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify", "aud": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", "exp": now+3600, "iat": now}`. Sign with RS256 using `crypto.createSign('RSA-SHA256')`. Exchange at `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token`.

### searchEmails
- Parameters: `query` (string, required - Gmail search syntax e.g. "from:user@example.com is:unread"), `maxResults` (number, optional, default 10)
- GET `/messages?q={query}&maxResults={maxResults}`
- For each message ID returned, GET `/messages/{id}?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=From&metadataHeaders=To&metadataHeaders=Subject&metadataHeaders=Date`
- Returns `{messages: [{id, threadId, from, to, subject, date, snippet}], resultCount}`

### readEmail
- Parameters: `messageId` (string, required)
- GET `/messages/{messageId}?format=full`
- Parse headers for From, To, Subject, Date. Extract body from payload (handle multipart/alternative, get text/plain or text/html)
- Returns `{id, threadId, from, to, subject, date, body, snippet, labels}`

### sendGmail
- Parameters: `to` (string, required), `subject` (string, required), `body` (string, required), `isHtml` (boolean, optional, default false)
- Create RFC 2822 email message: `From: {userEmail}\r\nTo: {to}\r\nSubject: {subject}\r\nContent-Type: {text/plain or text/html}; charset=utf-8\r\n\r\n{body}`
- Base64url encode the message
- POST `/messages/send` with body `{raw: base64urlMessage}`
- Returns `{messageId, threadId}`

## Tool 2: agnt-dropbox

**Directory:** agnt-dropbox/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-dropbox
**Description:** Manage files and folders in Dropbox. Requires DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable.
**Category:** data

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "listFolder", "description": "List files and folders in a Dropbox directory."},
  {"name": "uploadFile", "description": "Upload a file to Dropbox."},
  {"name": "downloadFile", "description": "Download a file from Dropbox."},
  {"name": "deleteFile", "description": "Delete a file or folder from Dropbox."},
  {"name": "createFolder", "description": "Create a new folder in Dropbox."},
  {"name": "createSharedLink", "description": "Create a shared link for a Dropbox file."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN`
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer {token}`
- Content API: `https://content.dropboxapi.com/2`
- API: `https://api.dropboxapi.com/2`

### listFolder
- Parameters: `path` (string, required, e.g. "" for root or "/Documents")
- POST `api/files/list_folder` with `{path, limit: 100}`
- Returns `{entries: [{name, pathDisplay, tag (file/folder), size, modified}], hasMore}`

### uploadFile
- Parameters: `path` (string, required, e.g. "/test.txt"), `content` (string, required - file content)
- POST `content/files/upload` with header `Dropbox-API-Arg: {path, mode: "overwrite"}` and body as content
- Returns `{name, pathDisplay, size, modified, contentHash}`

### downloadFile
- Parameters: `path` (string, required)
- POST `content/files/download` with header `Dropbox-API-Arg: {path}`
- Returns `{name, path, content (text), size}`

### deleteFile
- Parameters: `path` (string, required)
- POST `api/files/delete_v2` with `{path}`
- Returns `{name, pathDisplay, tag}`

### createFolder
- Parameters: `path` (string, required)
- POST `api/files/create_folder_v2` with `{path}`
- Returns `{name, pathDisplay}`

### createSharedLink
- Parameters: `path` (string, required)
- POST `api/sharing/create_shared_link_with_settings` with `{path}`
- Returns `{url, name, pathDisplay}`

## Tool 3: agnt-google-drive

**Directory:** agnt-google-drive/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-drive
**Description:** Manage files and folders in Google Drive. Requires GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** data

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "listDriveFiles", "description": "List files in a Google Drive folder."},
  {"name": "uploadDriveFile", "description": "Upload a file to Google Drive."},
  {"name": "downloadDriveFile", "description": "Download a file from Google Drive."},
  {"name": "createDriveFolder", "description": "Create a new folder in Google Drive."},
  {"name": "shareDriveFile", "description": "Share a Google Drive file with another user."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` (JSON)
- Scope: `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive`
- Base URL: `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3`
- Upload URL: `https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3`

Use same JWT auth pattern as google-sheets/gmail (create JWT, sign with RS256, exchange for token).

### listDriveFiles
- Parameters: `folderId` (string, optional, default "root"), `pageSize` (number, optional, default 20), `query` (string, optional - Drive search query)
- GET `/files?q='${folderId}'+in+parents&pageSize=${pageSize}&fields=files(id,name,mimeType,size,modifiedTime,webViewLink)`
- If query provided, add to the q parameter
- Returns `{files: [{id, name, mimeType, size, modifiedTime, webViewLink}], nextPageToken}`

### uploadDriveFile
- Parameters: `name` (string, required), `content` (string, required), `folderId` (string, optional, default "root"), `mimeType` (string, optional, default "text/plain")
- Multipart upload: POST upload URL `/files?uploadType=multipart`
- Body is multipart with metadata part (JSON: {name, parents: [folderId]}) and content part
- Returns `{id, name, mimeType, webViewLink}`

### downloadDriveFile
- Parameters: `fileId` (string, required)
- GET `/files/${fileId}?alt=media`
- Returns `{content (text), fileId}`

### createDriveFolder
- Parameters: `name` (string, required), `parentId` (string, optional, default "root")
- POST `/files` with `{name, mimeType: "application/vnd.google-apps.folder", parents: [parentId]}`
- Returns `{id, name, webViewLink}`

### shareDriveFile
- Parameters: `fileId` (string, required), `email` (string, required), `role` (string, optional - "reader", "writer", "commenter", default "reader")
- POST `/files/${fileId}/permissions` with `{type: "user", role, emailAddress: email}`
- Returns `{permissionId, role, email}`

## Tool 4: agnt-google-slides

**Directory:** agnt-google-slides/
**Package name:** @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-slides
**Description:** Create and manage Google Slides presentations. Requires GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable.
**Category:** data

**package.json tpmjs.tools:**
```json
[
  {"name": "createPresentation", "description": "Create a new Google Slides presentation."},
  {"name": "getPresentation", "description": "Get information about a Google Slides presentation."},
  {"name": "addSlide", "description": "Add a new slide to a Google Slides presentation."}
]
```

**Implementation (src/index.ts):**
- Env var: `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` (JSON)
- Scope: `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/presentations`
- Base URL: `https://slides.googleapis.com/v1/presentations`

Use same JWT auth pattern.

### createPresentation
- Parameters: `title` (string, required)
- POST base URL with body `{title}`
- Returns `{presentationId, title, slidesCount, url}` where url = `https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/{presentationId}`

### getPresentation
- Parameters: `presentationId` (string, required)
- GET `/{presentationId}`
- Returns `{presentationId, title, slidesCount, slides: [{objectId, pageType}], url}`

### addSlide
- Parameters: `presentationId` (string, required), `layoutType` (string, optional - "BLANK", "TITLE", "TITLE_AND_BODY", default "BLANK"), `title` (string, optional), `body` (string, optional)
- POST `/{presentationId}:batchUpdate` with requests array:
  - `{createSlide: {slideLayoutReference: {predefinedLayout: layoutType}}}` to create
  - Then if title/body provided, add text insert requests
- Returns `{slideId, presentationId}`

    12→const BASE_URL = 'https://discord.com/api/v10';
    13→
    14→// ─── Client Infrastructure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    15→
    16→function getApiKey(): string {
    17→  const key = process.env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN;
    18→  if (!key) {
    19→    throw new Error(
    20→      'DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN environment variable is required. Get your token from https://discord.com/developers/applications'
    21→    );
    22→  }
    23→  return key;
    24→}
    25→
    26→async function apiRequest<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    27→  const key = getApiKey();
    28→
    29→  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    30→    Authorization: `Bot ${key}`,
    31→    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    32→  };
    33→
    34→  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
    35→  if (body !== undefined) {
    36→    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, options);
    40→
    41→  if (!response.ok) {
    42→    await handleApiError(response);
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (response.status === 204) {
    46→    return { success: true } as T;
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  const text = await response.text();
    50→  if (!text) {
    51→    return {} as T;
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
    55→}
    56→
    57→async function handleApiError(response: Response): Promise<never> {
    58→  let errorMessage: string;
    59→  try {
    60→    const errorData = (await response.json()) as { message?: string; code?: number };
    61→    errorMessage = errorData.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    62→    if (errorData.code) {
    63→      errorMessage = `${errorMessage} (Discord Error Code: ${errorData.code})`;
    64→    }
    65→  } catch {
    66→    errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  switch (response.status) {
    70→    case 400:
    71→      throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
    72→    case 401:
    73→      throw new Error('Authentication failed: Invalid Discord bot token. Check DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.');
    74→    case 403:
    75→      throw new Error(`Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}`);
    76→    case 404:
    77→      throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}`);
    78→    case 429:
    79→      throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
    80→    default:
    81→      throw new Error(`Discord API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    82→  }
    83→}
    84→
    85→function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>): string {
    86→  const entries = Object.entries(params).filter(
    87→    ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''
    88→  );
    89→  if (entries.length === 0) return '';
    90→  return (
    91→    '?' +
    92→    entries.map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`).join('&')
    93→  );
    94→}

{"parentUuid":"0f6eaefe-d18d-48ed-87b1-8d5ebc4b3bf6","isSidechain":true,"userType":"external","cwd":"/Users/ajaxdavis/repos/tpmjs/tpmjs/packages/tools/official","sessionId":"5dfd6189-dead-49c2-bf77-84247314695e","version":"2.1.44","gitBranch":"main","agentId":"ab81a14","slug":"agile-bubbling-blum","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-6","id":"msg_013yYzBfft5ps4aKxZyYgaDG","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"REDACTED","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/ajaxdavis/repos/tpmjs/tpmjs/packages/tools/official/agnt-gmail/src/index.ts","content":"/**
 * @tpmjs/official-agnt-gmail — Gmail API Tools for AI Agents
 *
 * Search, read, send, and manage Gmail emails using Google service account
 * with domain-wide delegation.
 *
 * @requires GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable (JSON string)
 * @requires GMAIL_USER_EMAIL environment variable (email to impersonate)

import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';

const BASE_URL = 'https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me';

// ─── Auth Infrastructure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface ServiceAccountKey {
  client_email: string;
  private_key: string;
}

function getServiceAccountKey(): ServiceAccountKey {
  const keyJson = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY;
  if (!keyJson) {
    throw new Error(
      'GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable is required. Provide the JSON string of your Google service account key.'
    );
  }
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(keyJson) as ServiceAccountKey;
    if (!parsed.client_email || !parsed.private_key) {
      throw new Error('Invalid service account key: missing client_email or private_key');
    }
    return parsed;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as Error).message.includes('Invalid service account')) {
      throw error;
    }
    throw new Error(
      'GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY is not valid JSON. Provide the full service account key JSON string.'
    );
  }
}

function getUserEmail(): string {
  const email = process.env.GMAIL_USER_EMAIL;
  if (!email) {
    throw new Error(
      'GMAIL_USER_EMAIL environment variable is required. Set it to the email address of the user to impersonate via domain-wide delegation.'
    );
  }
  return email;
}

function base64url(input: string | Buffer): string {
  const buf = typeof input === 'string' ? Buffer.from(input) : input;
  return buf.toString('base64').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
}

async function getAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
  const sa = getServiceAccountKey();
  const userEmail = getUserEmail();
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);

  const header = base64url(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'RS256', typ: 'JWT' }));
  const payload = base64url(
    JSON.stringify({
      iss: sa.client_email,
      sub: userEmail,
      scope: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify',
      aud: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
      exp: now + 3600,
      iat: now,
    })
  );

  const signInput = `${header}.${payload}`;
  const signer = crypto.createSign('RSA-SHA256');
  signer.update(signInput);
  const signature = base64url(signer.sign(sa.private_key));

  const jwt = `${signInput}.${signature}`;

  const tokenResponse = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
    body: `grant_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Agrant-type%3Ajwt-bearer&assertion=${jwt}`,
  });

  if (!tokenResponse.ok) {
    const errorText = await tokenResponse.text();
    throw new Error(`Failed to obtain access token: ${errorText}`);
  }

  const tokenData = (await tokenResponse.json()) as { access_token: string };
  return tokenData.access_token;
}

// ─── API Request Helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function apiRequest<T>(
  method: string,
  path: string,
  body?: unknown,
  contentType?: string
): Promise<T> {
  const token = await getAccessToken();

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  };

  if (contentType) {
    headers['Content-Type'] = contentType;
  } else if (body !== undefined) {
    headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
  }

  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
  if (body !== undefined) {
    options.body = typeof body === 'string' ? body : JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  const url = path.startsWith('http') ? path : `${BASE_URL}${path}`;
  const response = await fetch(url, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    let errorMessage: string;
    try {
      const errorData = (await response.json()) as { error?: { message?: string } };
      errorMessage = errorData.error?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    } catch {
      errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    }

    switch (response.status) {
      case 401:
        throw new Error(
          `Authentication failed: ${errorMessage}. Check GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY and GMAIL_USER_EMAIL.`
        );
      case 403:
        throw new Error(
          `Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}. Ensure domain-wide delegation is configured for the service account.`
        );
      case 404:
        throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 429:
        throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
      default:
        throw new Error(`Gmail API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    }
  }

  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) {
    return {} as T;
  }

  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

// ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getHeader(
  headers: Array<{ name: string; value: string }>,
  name: string
): string {
  const header = headers.find((h) => h.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase());
  return header?.value || '';
}

function extractBody(payload: GmailPayload): string {
  if (payload.body?.data) {
    return Buffer.from(payload.body.data, 'base64').toString('utf-8');
  }

  if (payload.parts) {
    // Prefer text/plain, fall back to text/html
    const textPart = payload.parts.find((p) => p.mimeType === 'text/plain');
    if (textPart?.body?.data) {
      return Buffer.from(textPart.body.data, 'base64').toString('utf-8');
    }

    const htmlPart = payload.parts.find((p) => p.mimeType === 'text/html');
    if (htmlPart?.body?.data) {
      return Buffer.from(htmlPart.body.data, 'base64').toString('utf-8');
    }

    // Recursively check nested multipart
    for (const part of payload.parts) {
      if (part.parts) {
        const nested = extractBody(part);
        if (nested) return nested;
      }
    }
  }

  return '';
}

// ─── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface GmailPayload {
  mimeType?: string;
  headers?: Array<{ name: string; value: string }>;
  body?: { data?: string; size?: number };
  parts?: GmailPayload[];
}

interface GmailMessage {
  id: string;
  threadId: string;
  snippet?: string;
  labelIds?: string[];
  payload?: GmailPayload;
}

interface GmailMessageList {
  messages?: Array<{ id: string; threadId: string }>;
  resultSizeEstimate?: number;
}

export interface SearchEmailsResult {
  messages: Array<{
    id: string;
    threadId: string;
    from: string;
    to: string;
    subject: string;
    date: string;
    snippet: string;
  }>;
  resultCount: number;
}

export interface ReadEmailResult {
  id: string;
  threadId: string;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  date: string;
  body: string;
  snippet: string;
  labels: string[];
}

export interface SendGmailResult {
  messageId: string;
  threadId: string;
}

// ─── searchEmails ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface SearchEmailsInput {
  query: string;
  maxResults?: number;
}

export const searchEmails = tool({
  description:
    'Search Gmail emails using Gmail search syntax (e.g. "from:user@example.com is:unread", "subject:invoice after:2024/01/01").',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<SearchEmailsInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      query: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'Gmail search query using Gmail search syntax (e.g. "from:user@example.com is:unread").',
      },
      maxResults: {
        type: 'number',
        description: 'Maximum number of results to return (default: 10).',
      },
    },
    required: ['query'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: SearchEmailsInput): Promise<SearchEmailsResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.query) {
        throw new Error('query is required and must be non-empty');
      }
      const maxResults = input.maxResults ?? 10;

      const listResult = await apiRequest<GmailMessageList>(
        'GET',
        `/messages?q=${encodeURIComponent(input.query)}&maxResults=${maxResults}`
      );

      if (!listResult.messages || listResult.messages.length === 0) {
        return { messages: [], resultCount: 0 };
      }

      const messages = await Promise.all(
        listResult.messages.map(async (msg) => {
          const detail = await apiRequest<GmailMessage>(
            'GET',
            `/messages/${msg.id}?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=From&metadataHeaders=To&metadataHeaders=Subject&metadataHeaders=Date`
          );

          const headers = detail.payload?.headers || [];
          return {
            id: detail.id,
            threadId: detail.threadId,
            from: getHeader(headers, 'From'),
            to: getHeader(headers, 'To'),
            subject: getHeader(headers, 'Subject'),
            date: getHeader(headers, 'Date'),
            snippet: detail.snippet || '',
          };
        })
      );

      return {
        messages,
        resultCount: listResult.resultSizeEstimate || messages.length,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to search emails: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  },
});

// ─── readEmail ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ReadEmailInput {
  messageId: string;
}

export const readEmail = tool({
  description:
    'Read the full content of a specific Gmail email including body text, headers, and labels.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<ReadEmailInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      messageId: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'The Gmail message ID to read.',
      },
    },
    required: ['messageId'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: ReadEmailInput): Promise<ReadEmailResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.messageId) {
        throw new Error('messageId is required and must be non-empty');
      }

      const message = await apiRequest<GmailMessage>(
        'GET',
        `/messages/${input.messageId}?format=full`
      );

      const headers = message.payload?.headers || [];
      const body = message.payload ? extractBody(message.payload) : '';

      return {
        id: message.id,
        threadId: message.threadId,
        from: getHeader(headers, 'From'),
        to: getHeader(headers, 'To'),
        subject: getHeader(headers, 'Subject'),
        date: getHeader(headers, 'Date'),
        body,
        snippet: message.snippet || '',
        labels: message.labelIds || [],
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to read email: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  },
});

// ─── sendGmail ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface SendGmailInput {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  body: string;
  isHtml?: boolean;
}

export const sendGmail = tool({
  description: 'Send an email via Gmail using the configured service account and impersonated user.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<SendGmailInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      to: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Recipient email address.',
      },
      subject: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Email subject line.',
      },
      body: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Email body content (plain text or HTML).',
      },
      isHtml: {
        type: 'boolean',
        description: 'Whether the body is HTML content (default: false).',
      },
    },
    required: ['to', 'subject', 'body'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: SendGmailInput): Promise<SendGmailResult> {
    try {
      if (!input.to || !input.subject || !input.body) {
        throw new Error('to, subject, and body are required and must be non-empty');
      }

      const userEmail = getUserEmail();
      const contentType = input.isHtml ? 'text/html' : 'text/plain';

      const emailLines = [
        `From: ${userEmail}`,
        `To: ${input.to}`,
        `Subject: ${input.subject}`,
        `Content-Type: ${contentType}; charset=utf-8`,
        '',
        input.body,
      ];
      const rawMessage = emailLines.join('\r\n');

      const encoded = Buffer.from(rawMessage)
        .toString('base64')
        .replace(/\+/g, '-')
        .replace(/\//g, '_')
        .replace(/=+$/, '');

      const result = await apiRequest<{ id: string; threadId: string }>(
        'POST',
        '/messages/send',
        { raw: encoded }
      );

      return {
        messageId: result.id,
        threadId: result.threadId,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to send email: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  },
});

export default {
  searchEmails,
  readEmail,

function getAccessToken(): string {

async function apiRequest<T>(
  url: string,
  body?: unknown,
  headers?: Record<string, string>
): Promise<T> {
  const token = getAccessToken();

  const requestHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    ...headers,
  };

  if (body !== undefined && !requestHeaders['Content-Type']) {

  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    await handleApiError(response);
  }

  if (!text) {

  }

  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

async function handleApiError(response: Response): Promise<never> {

    const errorData = (await response.json()) as {

      error?: { [key: string]: unknown };
    };
    errorMessage = errorData.error_summary || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
  } catch {
    errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;

  switch (response.status) {
    case 400:
      throw new Error(`Bad request: ${errorMessage}`);
    case 401:
      throw new Error(
        'Authentication failed: Invalid Dropbox access token. Check DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN.'

  }
}

import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';

const BASE_URL = 'https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3';
const UPLOAD_URL = 'https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3';

// ─── Auth Infrastructure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface ServiceAccountKey {
  client_email: string;
  private_key: string;
}

function getServiceAccountKey(): ServiceAccountKey {
  const keyJson = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY;
  if (!keyJson) {
    throw new Error(
      'GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable is required. Provide the JSON string of your Google service account key.'
    );
  }
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(keyJson) as ServiceAccountKey;
    if (!parsed.client_email || !parsed.private_key) {
      throw new Error('Invalid service account key: missing client_email or private_key');
    }
    return parsed;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as Error).message.includes('Invalid service account')) {
      throw error;
    }
    throw new Error(
      'GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY is not valid JSON. Provide the full service account key JSON string.'
    );
  }
}

function base64url(input: string | Buffer): string {
  const buf = typeof input === 'string' ? Buffer.from(input) : input;
  return buf.toString('base64').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
}

async function getAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
  const sa = getServiceAccountKey();
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);

  const header = base64url(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'RS256', typ: 'JWT' }));
  const payload = base64url(
    JSON.stringify({
      iss: sa.client_email,
      scope: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive',
      aud: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
      exp: now + 3600,
      iat: now,
    })
  );

  const signInput = `${header}.${payload}`;
  const signer = crypto.createSign('RSA-SHA256');
  signer.update(signInput);
  const signature = base64url(signer.sign(sa.private_key));

  const jwt = `${signInput}.${signature}`;

  const tokenResponse = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
    body: `grant_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Agrant-type%3Ajwt-bearer&assertion=${jwt}`,
  });

  if (!tokenResponse.ok) {
    const errorText = await tokenResponse.text();
    throw new Error(`Failed to obtain access token: ${errorText}`);
  }

  const tokenData = (await tokenResponse.json()) as { access_token: string };
  return tokenData.access_token;
}

// ─── API Request Helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function apiRequest<T>(
  method: string,
  url: string,
  body?: unknown,
  headers?: Record<string, string>
): Promise<T> {
  const token = await getAccessToken();

  const requestHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    ...headers,
  };

  if (body !== undefined && !requestHeaders['Content-Type']) {
    requestHeaders['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
  }

  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers: requestHeaders };
  if (body !== undefined) {
    options.body = typeof body === 'string' ? body : JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  const response = await fetch(url, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    let errorMessage: string;
    try {
      const errorData = (await response.json()) as { error?: { message?: string } };
      errorMessage = errorData.error?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    } catch {
      errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    }

    switch (response.status) {
      case 401:
        throw new Error(
          `Authentication failed: ${errorMessage}. Check GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.`
        );
      case 403:
        throw new Error(`Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}. Ensure the service account has access to the file or folder.`);
      case 404:
        throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 429:
        throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
      default:
        throw new Error(`Google Drive API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    }
  }

  if (response.status === 204) {
    return {} as T;
  }

  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) {
    return {} as T;
  }

  return JSON.parse(text) as T;

  description:
    'Upload a file to Google Drive with the given name and content. Supports specifying a target folder and MIME type.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<UploadDriveFileInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      name: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'The name for the uploaded file.',
      },
      content: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'The file content to upload.',
      },
      folderId: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'The ID of the destination folder (default: "root").',
      },
      mimeType: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'The MIME type of the file (default: "text/plain").',
      },
    },
    required: ['name', 'content'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: UploadDriveFileInput): Promise<UploadDriveFileOutput> {
    try {
      if (!input.name || !input.content) {
        throw new Error('name and content are required and must be non-empty');
      }

      const token = await getAccessToken();
      const folderId = input.folderId || 'root';
      const mimeType = input.mimeType || 'text/plain';
      const boundary = '---tpmjs-boundary-' + Date.now();

      const metadata = JSON.stringify({
        name: input.name,
        parents: [folderId],
      });

      const multipartBody = [
        `--${boundary}`,
        'Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8',
        '',
        metadata,
        `--${boundary}`,
        `Content-Type: ${mimeType}`,
        '',
        input.content,
        `--${boundary}--`,
      ].join('\r\n');

      const response = await fetch(
        `${UPLOAD_URL}/files?uploadType=multipart&fields=id,name,mimeType,webViewLink`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
            'Content-Type': `multipart/related; boundary=${boundary}`,
          },
          body: multipartBody,
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        let errorMessage: string;
        try {
          const errorData = (await response.json()) as { error?: { message?: string } };
          errorMessage = errorData.error?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
        } catch {
          errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
        }
        throw new Error(`Google Drive upload error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
      }

      const result = (await response.json()) as DriveFile;

      return {
        id: result.id,
        name: result.name,
        mimeType: result.mimeType,
        webViewLink: result.webViewLink ?? null,
      };

      throw new Error(`Failed to upload Drive file: ${(error as Error).message}`);

  },

import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { jsonSchema, tool } from 'ai';

const BASE_URL = 'https://slides.googleapis.com/v1/presentations';

// ─── Auth Infrastructure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface ServiceAccountKey {
  client_email: string;
  private_key: string;
}

function getServiceAccountKey(): ServiceAccountKey {
  const keyJson = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY;
  if (!keyJson) {
    throw new Error(
      'GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable is required. Provide the JSON string of your Google service account key.'
    );
  }
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(keyJson) as ServiceAccountKey;
    if (!parsed.client_email || !parsed.private_key) {
      throw new Error('Invalid service account key: missing client_email or private_key');
    }
    return parsed;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as Error).message.includes('Invalid service account')) {
      throw error;
    }
    throw new Error(
      'GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY is not valid JSON. Provide the full service account key JSON string.'
    );
  }
}

function base64url(input: string | Buffer): string {
  const buf = typeof input === 'string' ? Buffer.from(input) : input;
  return buf.toString('base64').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
}

async function getAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
  const sa = getServiceAccountKey();
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);

  const header = base64url(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'RS256', typ: 'JWT' }));
  const payload = base64url(
    JSON.stringify({
      iss: sa.client_email,
      scope: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/presentations https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive',
      aud: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
      exp: now + 3600,
      iat: now,
    })
  );

  const signInput = `${header}.${payload}`;
  const signer = crypto.createSign('RSA-SHA256');
  signer.update(signInput);
  const signature = base64url(signer.sign(sa.private_key));

  const jwt = `${signInput}.${signature}`;

  const tokenResponse = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
    body: `grant_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Agrant-type%3Ajwt-bearer&assertion=${jwt}`,
  });

  if (!tokenResponse.ok) {
    const errorText = await tokenResponse.text();
    throw new Error(`Failed to obtain access token: ${errorText}`);
  }

  const tokenData = (await tokenResponse.json()) as { access_token: string };
  return tokenData.access_token;
}

// ─── API Request Helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function apiRequest<T>(method: string, url: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const token = await getAccessToken();

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  };

  const options: RequestInit = { method, headers };
  if (body !== undefined) {
    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  const response = await fetch(url, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    let errorMessage: string;
    try {
      const errorData = (await response.json()) as { error?: { message?: string } };
      errorMessage = errorData.error?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    } catch {
      errorMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
    }

    switch (response.status) {
      case 401:
        throw new Error(
          `Authentication failed: ${errorMessage}. Check GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.`
        );
      case 403:
        throw new Error(
          `Access forbidden: ${errorMessage}. Ensure the service account has access to the presentation.`
        );
      case 404:
        throw new Error(`Not found: ${errorMessage}`);
      case 429:
        throw new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: ${errorMessage}`);
      default:
        throw new Error(`Google Slides API error (${response.status}): ${errorMessage}`);
    }
  }

  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) {
    return {} as T;
  }

  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

// ─── addSlide ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface AddSlideInput {
  presentationId: string;
  layoutType?: string;
  title?: string;
  body?: string;
}

const VALID_LAYOUTS = ['BLANK', 'TITLE', 'TITLE_AND_BODY', 'TITLE_AND_TWO_COLUMNS', 'TITLE_ONLY', 'ONE_COLUMN_TEXT', 'MAIN_POINT', 'SECTION_HEADER', 'SECTION_TITLE_AND_DESCRIPTION', 'BIG_NUMBER', 'CAPTION_ONLY'];

export const addSlide = tool({
  description:
    'Add a new slide to a Google Slides presentation with an optional layout, title text, and body text.',
  inputSchema: jsonSchema<AddSlideInput>({
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      presentationId: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'The ID of the presentation to add a slide to.',
      },
      layoutType: {
        type: 'string',
        description:
          'The slide layout type: "BLANK", "TITLE", "TITLE_AND_BODY", etc. (default: "BLANK").',
      },
      title: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Optional title text to insert on the slide.',
      },
      body: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Optional body text to insert on the slide.',
      },
    },
    required: ['presentationId'],
    additionalProperties: false,
  }),
  async execute(input: AddSlideInput): Promise<AddSlideOutput> {
    try {
      if (!input.presentationId) {
        throw new Error('presentationId is required and must be non-empty');
      }

      const layoutType = input.layoutType || 'BLANK';
      if (!VALID_LAYOUTS.includes(layoutType)) {
        throw new Error(
          `Invalid layoutType "${layoutType}". Must be one of: ${VALID_LAYOUTS.join(', ')}`
        );
      }

      const slideObjectId = `slide_${Date.now()}`;

      const requests: unknown[] = [
        {
          createSlide: {
            objectId: slideObjectId,
            slideLayoutReference: {
              predefinedLayout: layoutType,
            },
          },
        },
      ];

      // Create the slide first to get its placeholders
      const createResult = await apiRequest<BatchUpdateResponse>(
        'POST',
        `${BASE_URL}/${input.presentationId}:batchUpdate`,
        { requests }
      );

      const createdSlideId =
        createResult.replies?.[0]?.createSlide?.objectId || slideObjectId;

      // If title or body text is provided, we need to find placeholder IDs
      if (input.title || input.body) {
        // Get the presentation to find placeholder element IDs on the new slide
        const presentation = await apiRequest<SlidesPresentation>(
          'GET',
          `${BASE_URL}/${input.presentationId}`
        );

        const newSlide = presentation.slides?.find((s) => s.objectId === createdSlideId);

        if (newSlide?.pageElements) {
          const textRequests: unknown[] = [];

          for (const element of newSlide.pageElements as Array<{
            objectId: string;
            shape?: {
              placeholder?: { type: string };
            };
          }>) {
            if (element.shape?.placeholder?.type === 'TITLE' && input.title) {
              textRequests.push({
                insertText: {
                  objectId: element.objectId,
                  text: input.title,
                  insertionIndex: 0,
                },
              });
            } else if (element.shape?.placeholder?.type === 'BODY' && input.body) {
              textRequests.push({
                insertText: {
                  objectId: element.objectId,
                  text: input.body,
                  insertionIndex: 0,
                },
              });
            } else if (
              element.shape?.placeholder?.type === 'SUBTITLE' &&
              input.body &&
              layoutType === 'TITLE'
            ) {
              textRequests.push({
                insertText: {

Search, read, send, and manage Gmail emails. Uses Google service account with domain-wide delegation.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-gmail
```

## Setup

Set the following environment variables:

- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` - JSON string of your Google service account key with domain-wide delegation enabled.
- `GMAIL_USER_EMAIL` - The email address of the user to impersonate.

The service account must have domain-wide delegation configured with the scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify`.

## Usage

```typescript
import { searchEmails, readEmail, sendGmail } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-gmail';

// Search for emails
const results = await searchEmails.execute({ query: 'from:user@example.com is:unread' });

// Read a specific email
const email = await readEmail.execute({ messageId: '18a1b2c3d4e5f6' });

// Send an email
const sent = await sendGmail.execute({
  to: 'recipient@example.com',
  subject: 'Hello',
  body: 'This is a test email.',
});
```

|-------|------|-------------|

### readEmail

**Parameters:**

**Output:**

| to | string | Recipient email address. |
| subject | string | Email subject line. |
| date | string | Date the email was sent. |
| body | string | Email body content (plain text or HTML). |
| snippet | string | Short snippet of the email. |
| labels | string[] | Gmail label IDs applied to the message. |

### sendGmail

Send an email via Gmail.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| to | string | Yes | Recipient email address. |
| subject | string | Yes | Email subject line. |
| body | string | Yes | Email body content (plain text or HTML). |
| isHtml | boolean | No | Whether the body is HTML content (default: false). |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| messageId | string | The ID of the sent message. |
| threadId | string | The thread ID of the sent message. |

Create and manage Google Slides presentations. Create new presentations, retrieve presentation details, and add slides with content.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @tpmjs/official-agnt-google-slides
```

## Setup

Set the `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` environment variable to the JSON string of your Google service account key. The service account needs access to the Google Slides API. For existing presentations, share them with the service account email address.

## Usage

```typescript
import { createPresentation, getPresentation, addSlide } from '@tpmjs/official-agnt-google-slides';

// Create a new presentation
const pres = await createPresentation.execute({ title: 'Q1 Report' });

// Get presentation info
const info = await getPresentation.execute({ presentationId: pres.presentationId });

// Add a slide with title and body
const slide = await addSlide.execute({
  presentationId: pres.presentationId,
  layoutType: 'TITLE_AND_BODY',
  title: 'Revenue Overview',
  body: 'Revenue grew 25% quarter over quarter.',
});
```

## Tools

### createPresentation

Create a new Google Slides presentation.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| title | string | Yes | The title for the new presentation. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| presentationId | string | The ID of the created presentation. |
| title | string | The presentation title. |
| slidesCount | number | Number of slides in the presentation. |
| url | string | URL to open the presentation in Google Slides. |

### getPresentation

Get information about a Google Slides presentation.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| presentationId | string | Yes | The ID of the presentation to retrieve. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| presentationId | string | The presentation ID. |
| title | string | The presentation title. |
| slidesCount | number | Total number of slides. |
| slides | array | List of slides with objectId and pageType. |
| url | string | URL to open the presentation in Google Slides. |

### addSlide

Add a new slide to a Google Slides presentation.

**Parameters:**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| presentationId | string | Yes | The ID of the presentation to add a slide to. |
| layoutType | string | No | Slide layout: "BLANK", "TITLE", "TITLE_AND_BODY", etc. (default: "BLANK"). |
| title | string | No | Title text to insert on the slide. |
| body | string | No | Body text to insert on the slide. |

**Output:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| slideId | string | The ID of the newly created slide. |
| presentationId | string | The presentation ID. |
